ex.cn: 他的八字须下面，牙齿晶莹发亮。

syn: n. 微光；闪光；瞬息的一现：glimmer, stroboflash
vi. 闪烁；隐约地闪现：spark, coruscate

t: v. 去掉， 减损
en: If one thing detracts from another, it makes it seem less good or impressive

ex.en: They feared that the publicity surrounding him would detract from their own election campaigns.
ex.cn: 他们担心围绕他的宣传会有损他们自已的竞选活动。

syn: vt. 转移，使分心：shift, divert from
vi. 贬低；减去：thumb down, play down
rm: de(向下) + tract(拉) → 向下拉 → 去掉， 减损

t: n. 意见； 审判； 判断
en: the ability to make sensible decisions about what to do and when to do it

ex.en: I’ve known him for years and I trust his judgment.
ex.cn: 我与他相识多年，相信他的判断力。

ex.en: a decision based on sound judgment
ex.cn: 以良好的判断力为基础的决定

ph.cn: 终审；最终判决；终局判决；最后判决

syn: n. 判断；裁判；判决书；辨别力：estimate, refree

t: n. 慈善； 施舍； 慈善机构
en: an organization that gives money, goods, or help to people who are poor, sick etc

ex.en: Several charities sent aid to the flood victims.
ex.cn: 有几家慈善机构已向洪灾灾民送去了救援物资。

syn: n. 慈善；施舍；慈善团体；宽容；施舍物：tolerance, mercy

t: n. 简要， 概略
en: A compendium is a short but detailed collection of information, usually in a book

ex.en: The Roman Catholic Church has issued a compendium of its teachings.
ex.cn: 罗马天主教会已经发行了一份其教义的概略。

syn: n. 纲要；概略：schemata, rundown
rm: com(共同) + pend(悬挂) + ium → 把重要的部分抽出来挂在一起 → 简要， 概略

t: n. 文具
en: materials that you use for writing, such as paper, pens, pencils etc

ex.en: ...envelopes and other office stationery.
ex.cn: …信封及其他办公文具。

syn: n. [轻]文具；信纸：writing materials, letter pad

t: n. 矿物， 矿石
en: a substance that is formed naturally in the earth, such as coal, salt, stone, or gold. Minerals can be dug out of the ground and used

ex.en: The area is very rich in minerals .
ex.cn: 该地区矿产非常丰富。

ex.en: a country with few mineral resources
ex.cn: 矿产资源稀少的国家

syn: n. [矿物]矿物；（英）矿泉水；无机物；苏打水（常用复数表示）：table-water, inorganics
rm: mine(矿) + ral → 矿物， 矿石

t: v. 储备；adj. 常备的；n. 储备品；股票；〈总称〉家畜
en: if a shop stocks a particular product, it keeps a supply of it to sell

ex.en: We stock a wide range of kitchen equipment.
ex.cn: 我们备有各种厨房用品。

ph.cn: 股票市场；证券市场；股票交易

syn: n. [金融]股份，股票；[贸易]库存；血统；树干：birth, blood, stem
adj. [贸易]存货的，常备的；平凡的：ordinary, mediocre

t: n. 确认

ex.en: Prepare - Research what you want to sell using Completed Listings. Have credit card and bank information ready for verification.
ex.cn: 准备-通过调查已经发布的广告确认你究竟要卖什么，拥有供查证的信用卡和银行信息。

ex.en: The General Dynamics-led team will provide training for hardware and software, and also furnish independent verification and validation of sensors and systems.
ex.cn: 通用动力公司领导的团队将提供硬件和软件训练，也将提供传感器和系统的独立查证和确认。

syn: n. 确认，查证；[审计]核实：confirmation, validation

t: vt. 吊， 悬挂； 推迟； 暂停， 中止
en: to officially stop something from continuing, especially for a short time

ex.en: Sales of the drug will be suspended until more tests are completed.
ex.cn: 这种药品在完成进一步检验之前将暂停销售。

ex.en: Talks between the two countries have now been suspended.
ex.cn: 两国间的对话现已中止。

syn: vt. 使暂停；延缓，推迟；使悬浮：wait, phase back
rm: sus(在…下面) + pend(悬挂) → 悬挂于之下 → 暂停

t: prep&ad. 在下方

ex.en: Far beneath them, the trees of the forest sighed in the breeze.
ex.cn: 远在他们的下方，森林中的树木在微风中悲泣。

ex.en: They must all be drowning beneath him, in the watery caves of the rock!
ex.cn: 他们一定是在他下面的水里，就在那岩石充满了水的洞中游泳了！

syn: prep. 在…之下：neath
adv. 在下方：under
rm: be + neath(在…之下) → 在下方

t: v&n. 交换
en: to give something to someone and get something in return

ex.en: Do you want to swap umbrellas?
ex.cn: 你想交换雨伞吗？

syn: n. [计]交换；交换之物：exchange, reciprocation
vi. [计]交换；交易：trade, traffic

t: v. 蜂拥而出；波动，涌动；n. 洋溢； 猛增
en: to suddenly move very quickly in a particular direction

ex.en: She could feel anger surging inside her.
ex.cn: 她感到怒火中烧。

ex.en: Specialists see various reasons for the recent surge in inflation.
ex.cn: 专家认为最近通货膨胀加剧有各种原因。

ph.cn: 缓冲槽；平衡水箱；通风油箱（等于surge chamber）

syn: n. 大浪；汹涌澎湃；巨涌：very rough seas
vi. 激增；汹涌：sharp rise, balloon
rm: s + urge(急迫的) → 水流湍急 → 波动， 涌动； 洋溢

t: n. 典礼，仪式；例行公事，
en: a ceremony that is always performed in the same way, in order to mark an important religious or social occasion

ex.en: ancient pagan rituals
ex.cn: 古老的异教仪式

ex.en: the importance of religion and ritual in our lives
ex.cn: 我们生活中宗教和宗教仪式的重要性

syn: n. 仪式；惯例；礼制：tradition, ceremony, convention, usage, service
adj. 仪式的；例行的；礼节性的：routine, ceremonial
rm: rit(e)(典礼， 仪式) + ual → 典礼， 仪式

t: vt. 分发， 分配； 提供
en: to give something to people, especially in fixed amounts

ex.en: a machine for dispensing cash
ex.cn: 取款机

syn: vt. 分配，分发；免除；执行：perform, implement, portion, discharge, part
vi. 免除，豁免：get free of, exempt from
rm: dis(分开) + pens(重量) + e → 把重量分开 → 分配

t: n. 基础； 根据； 原则
en: the facts, ideas, or things from which something can be developed

ex.en: Their claim had no basis in fact (=  it was not true  ) .
ex.cn: 他们的说法没有事实根据。

syn: n. 基础；底部；主要成分；基本原则或原理：elements, foundation, base, bed, bottom

t: n. 家庭教师，私人教师；v. 给…当家庭教师；指导
en: someone who gives private lessons to one student or a small group, and is paid directly by them

ex.en: The children were educated at home by a succession of tutors.
ex.cn: 这些孩子在家接受教育，连续请过几任家庭教师。

syn: vt. 辅导；约束：restrict, hold oneself in
n. 导师；家庭教师；助教：mentors, teacher counselor

t: vt. 引诱； 吸引
en: to make someone want to have or do something, even though they know they really should not

ex.en: If you leave valuables in your car it will tempt thieves.
ex.cn: 如果把贵重物品留在车上，会招来小偷的。

syn: vt. 诱惑；引起；冒…的风险；使感兴趣：attract, produce, cause, operate, occasion
rm: 本身为词根， 意为“尝试” → 受到诱惑而尝试 → 吸引； 引诱

t: adj. 临床的； 冷静客观的； 简朴的， 不装饰的
en: relating to treating or testing people who are sick

ex.en: The drug has undergone extensive clinical trials (= tests to see if it is effective in treating people ) .
ex.cn: 该药已经过大量的临床试验。

ex.en: The therapy has helped people with clinical depression (= a strong feeling of sadness, for which you need medical help ) .
ex.cn: 该疗法对临床抑郁症病人有帮助。

rm: clinic(诊所) + al → 临床的

t: v. 回报， 回应； 报答
en: to do or give something, because something similar has been done or given to you

ex.en: When he spoke I was expected to reciprocate with some remark of my own.
ex.cn: 他在说话时，我也应该说点什么回应他。

syn: vt. 报答；互换；互给：return, requite
vi. [机]往复运动；互换；酬答；互给：to and fro motion, alternate motion

t: v. 缠绕；捻；扭曲，弯曲；n. 弯曲
en: to bend or turn something, such as wire, hair, or cloth, into a particular shape

ex.en: Her hands began to twist the handles of the bag she carried.
ex.cn: 她的双手开始拧她拎着的那个包的拎柄。

syn: vt. 捻；拧；扭伤；编织；使苦恼：screw, harry
n. [力]扭曲；拧；扭伤：distortion, strain
rm: tw(看作two， 两个) + ist(表人) → 两个人扭打在一起 → 缠绕

t: adj. 即将到来的
en: a forthcoming event, meeting etc is one that has been planned to happen soon

ex.en: the forthcoming elections
ex.cn: 即将到来的选举

ex.en: Keep an eye on the noticeboards for forthcoming events .
ex.cn: 请注意布告牌上的活动预告。

syn: adj. 即将来临的：upcoming, imminent
n. 来临：oncoming
rm: forth(往前) + coming(就要来的) → 即将到来的

t: vt. 使困惑； 使复杂化
en: if something perplexes you, it makes you feel confused and worried because it is difficult to understand

ex.en: Shea’s symptoms perplexed the doctors.
ex.cn: 谢伊的症状令医生们困惑。

syn: vt. 使困惑，使为难；使复杂化：bepuzzle, confuse
rm: per(完全) + plex(重叠) → 完全重叠在一起 → 使困惑； 使复杂化

t: n. 大石头； 鹅卵石

ex.en: It required superhuman effort to lift the huge boulder .
ex.cn: 要搬起这块大石头需要有超人的力量。

syn: n. [建]卵石，大圆石；[地质]巨砾：ratchel, grait

t: v. 耽搁， 拖延
en: to delay doing something that you ought to do, usually because you do not want to do it

ex.en: People often procrastinate when it comes to paperwork.
ex.cn: 遇到文书工作，人们常常会拖拖拉拉。

syn: vt. 耽搁，延迟：time delay, detain
vi. 耽搁，延迟：wait, time delay
rm: pro(向前) + crastin(明天) + ate → 拖到明天再干 → 耽搁， 拖延

t: vt. 找到； 位于； 使坐落于； 把…设置在
en: to find the exact position of something

ex.en: We couldn’t locate the source of the radio signal.
ex.cn: 我们无法确定无线电信号的来源。

ph.cn: 在某一点设置；在…定居；坐落于

syn: vt. 位于；查找…的地点：lie on, stand on
vi. 定位；定居：beach, make one's pitch
rm: loc(地点) + ate(动词后缀) → 发现地点 → 找到； 位于

t: n. 战斗，搏斗；vt. 战斗， 与…搏斗； 防止
en: fighting, especially during a war

ex.en: We flew over 200 combat missions in the war.
ex.cn: 我们在战争中执行过两百多次战斗飞行任务。

ex.en: training in unarmed combat
ex.cn: 徒手格斗训练

syn: vt. 反对；与…战斗：sit down on, to oppose
vi. 战斗；搏斗：fight, conflict
rm: com(共同) + bat(打) → 战斗， 搏斗

t: n. 二氧化物
en: a chemical  compound  that contains two atoms of oxygen and one atom of another chemical  element

ex.en: She is your indispensable oxygen, carbon dioxide is not essential you me.
ex.cn: 她是你不可缺少的氧气，我是你可有可无的二氧化碳。

ex.en: This all has to do with photosynthesis, the process in which plants turn sunlight, carbon dioxide and water into food.
ex.cn: 这一切都与光合作用有关，在这一过程中，植物将阳光、二氧化碳和水转变为食物。

rm: di(二) + oxide(氧化物) → 二氧化物

t: v. 沉溺于， 纵情于； 满足； 放纵， 听任
en: to let someone have or do whatever they want, even if it is bad for them

ex.en: His mother spoiled him, indulging his every whim.
ex.cn: 他母亲对他纵容娇惯，百依百顺。

syn: vt. 满足；纵容；使高兴；使沉迷于…：meet, fulfill, fill, please, baby
vi. 沉溺；满足；放任：luxuriate, to satisfy
rm: in + dulg(屈服， 让步) + e → 屈服于欲望 → 满足(欲望等)； 放纵

t: vt. 津贴， 资助

ex.en: Now the questions are: why should northern European taxpayers be required to subsidise Greek voters given their failure to control their own government?
ex.cn: 现在的问题是：希腊的选民未能看管好自己的政府，为什么要北欧国家的纳税人去资助他们？

syn: vi. 消退；下沉；平息：cool, sink
vt. 资助（等于subsidize）；给...补助金：fund, stake
rm: 来自subsidy(n. 津贴， 补助金)

t: adj. 庸俗的， 粗俗的， 下流的， 缺乏教养的； 大众的， 通俗的
en: remarks, jokes etc that are vulgar deal with sex in a very rude and offensive way

ex.en: vulgar behaviour
ex.cn: 粗俗的行为

syn: adj. 粗俗的；通俗的；本土的：popular, low, mainland, coarse, informal
n. 平民，百姓：populace, common man
rm: vulg(人们， 大众) + ar → 大众的， 通俗的

t: n. 大灾难
en: a terrible event in which there is a lot of destruction, suffering, or death

ex.en: From all points of view, war would be a catastrophe.
ex.cn: 从各个方面来看，战争都会是一场灾难。

syn: n. 大灾难；大祸；惨败：fiasco, smashup
rm: cat(a)(落下) + astro(星星) + phe → 星星坠落， 古人认为星星坠落预示大难临头 → 大灾难

t: adv. 额外地， 另外； 特别地；adj. 额外的；特别的
en: in addition to the usual things or the usual amount

ex.en: They need to offer something extra to attract customers.
ex.cn: 他们需要提供额外的东西以吸引顾客。

ph.cn: 额外的钱；[英国俚语]超速罚款单

syn: adv. 特别地，非常；另外：specifically, particularly, badly, highly, greatly, too
n. 临时演员；号外；额外的事物；上等产品：walker-on, special edition
rm: 本身为词根， 意为“额外的； 特别的”

t: vt. 传送， 运送； 表达， 传递
en: to communicate or express something, with or without using words

ex.en: All this information can be conveyed in a simple diagram.
ex.cn: 所有这些信息可以通过一张简单的图表来表示。

ex.en: Ads convey the message that thin is beautiful.
ex.cn: 广告传递的信息是: 瘦就是美。

syn: vt. 传达；运输；让与：communicate, release, transport
rm: con + vey(搬运) → 传送， 运送

t: v. 设计； 谋划， 构思；n. 设计，构想；图样，图案；企图，图谋
en: to make a drawing or plan of something that will be made or built

ex.en: The tower was designed by Gilbert Scott.
ex.cn: 这座塔楼是吉尔伯特·斯科特设计的。

syn: vt. 设计；计划；构思：project, engineer, style, schedule, frame
n. 设计；图案：programming, device, pattern
rm: de + sign(标记) → 做标记 → 设计

t: n. 牺牲者； 受害者
en: someone who has been attacked, robbed, or murdered

ex.en: The victim received head injuries from which she died a week later.
ex.cn: 受害人头部受伤，一周后死亡。

ex.en: a credit card fraud ring that stole millions of dollars from unsuspecting victims
ex.cn: 从毫无戒心的受害者手中盗取数百万美元的信用卡诈骗团伙

ph.cn: 成为…的牺牲品；成为…的受害者；屈服于…；被…降服

syn: n. 受害人；牺牲品；牺牲者：sacrificial lamb
rm: 胜利者(victor)的荣耀是牺牲者(victim)的鲜血换来的。

t: n. 通风

ex.en: Stale. Lack of bouquet and freshness of a wine through too much aeration or infection with film yeasts.
ex.cn: 走味的、沉滞的：由于通风过度或受产膜酵母的侵染，葡萄酒变得缺乏香气及新鲜爽口感。

ph.cn: 饱气带；含气层；曝气区；通气带

syn: n. [环境]曝气；通风；充气：perflation, airiness
rm: aer(空气) + ation → 能通空气 → 通风

t: n. 报酬
en: the pay you give someone for something they have done for you

ex.en: high rates of remuneration
ex.cn: 很高的报酬

ph.cn: 薪酬福利条件；薪酬利益；酬金方案

syn: n. [劳经]报酬；酬劳，赔偿：compensation, payment, consideration, satisfaction, reward

t: n. 符合， 一致
en: in a way that obeys rules, customs etc

ex.en: We must act in conformity with local regulations.
ex.cn: 我们必须按当地的法规行事。

ph.cn: 与…相符，符合；遵照；和…相适应
合格评定；符合性评估；型式评价

syn: n. 一致，适合；符合；相似：accordance, unity, agreement, identity, consensus

t: n. 颅骨； 脑袋
en: the bones of a person’s or animal’s head

ex.en: He can’t seem to get it into his skull that I’m just not interested in him.
ex.cn: 他这个笨蛋好像无法明白我根本对他不感兴趣。

syn: n. 头盖骨，脑壳：crania, braincase
rm: 据说大脑袋(skull)的人掌握技能(skill)比较快

t: vt. 污染
en: to make a place or substance dirty or harmful by putting something such as chemicals or poison in it

ex.en: Drinking water supplies are believed to have been contaminated.
ex.cn: 据信饮用水已受到污染。

syn: vt. 污染，弄脏：soil, mud, spot, dirty, poison

t: n. 小巷； 行车道
en: a narrow road in the countryside

ex.en: a quiet country lane
ex.cn: 一条宁静的乡间小路

ph.cn: （街道上的）公共汽车专用车道

syn: n. [交]车道；小巷；[航][水运]航线：vector, driveway
rm: 小巷(lane)可作行车路线(line)

t: n. 捕食性动物； 食肉动物； 奴役他人者； 剥削者， 掠夺者
en: an animal that kills and eats other animals

ex.en: a sexual predator
ex.cn: 性侵犯者

syn: n. [动]捕食者；食肉动物；掠夺者：carnivore, reiver
rm: pred(掠夺) + at + or(表人或物) → 掠夺肉食 → 食肉动物

t: n. 进入， 穿过； 洞察力， 领悟力
en: when something or someone enters or passes through something, especially when this is difficult

ex.en: Cover the entire device to prevent water penetration.
ex.cn: 把整台设备都罩住以免进水。

ph.cn: 焊透率；穿进速率；进尺速度

syn: n. 渗透；突破；侵入；洞察力：breakthrough, perception, insight, infiltration, intrusion

t: adj. 主要的； 为首的
en: highest in rank

ex.en: He was recently appointed chief economist at the Bank of Scotland.
ex.cn: 他最近被任命为苏格兰银行的首席经济学家。

ex.en: the government’s chief medical officer
ex.cn: 政府的首席卫生官员

ph.cn: 行政长官；董事长；美国总统；（美国的）州长
主要地，尤其；在首席地位

syn: n. 首领；酋长；主要部分：leader, captain, boss
adj. 首席的；主要的；主任的：primary, major, central, leading, great

t: v. 丧失，失去；n. 罚款； 代价
en: to lose a right, position, possession etc or have it taken away from you because you have broken a law or rule

ex.en: By being absent from the trial, he forfeited the right to appeal.
ex.cn: 因缺席审判，他丧失了上诉权。

ex.en: She was fined £3,000 and ordered to forfeit her car.
ex.cn: 她被罚款3000英镑并没收汽车。

syn: n. [金融]罚金；[法]没收物；丧失的东西：amercement, pecuniary penalty
adj. 因受罚而丧失的；被没收的：confiscate
rm: for(因为) + feit(看作词根fect， 做) → 因为做错事， 所以被处罚 → 罚款

t: adj. 最好的； 最重要的
en: the best or most important

ex.en: one of the country’s foremost authorities on chemical warfare
ex.cn: 该国化学战方面的最高权威之一

ex.en: Rostropovich was long considered the world’s foremost cellist.
ex.cn: 长期以来，罗斯特罗波维奇一直被视为世界上首屈一指的大提琴家。

syn: adj. 最重要的；最先的：principal, supreme, main, lead
adv. 首先；居于首位地：firstly, primarily, initially, first of all, chiefly
rm: fore(前面) + most(最) → 放在最前面的 → 最重要的

t: adj. 创业的
en: Entrepreneurial means having the qualities that are needed to succeed as an entrepreneur

ex.en: ...her prodigious entrepreneurial flair.
ex.cn: …她惊人的创业天赋。

syn: adj. 企业家的，创业者的；中间商的：enterpreneurial

t: v. 碎裂， 瓦解， 解体
en: to break up, or make something break up, into very small pieces

ex.en: The plane just disintegrated in mid-air.
ex.cn: 飞机就在半空中解体了。

syn: vt. 使分解；使碎裂；使崩溃；使衰变：collapse, dissolve
vi. 瓦解；碎裂；衰变：collapse, chip
rm: dis(不) + integrate(一体化， 使完整) → 使不完整 → (使)碎裂， 瓦解

t: prep. 不管， 尽管
en: used to say that something happens or is true even though something else might have prevented it

ex.en: Despite all our efforts to save the school, the authorities decided to close it.
ex.cn: 尽管我们竭力想保住这所学校，当局还是决定把它关闭。

syn: prep. 尽管，不管：in spite of, for all that
n. 轻视；憎恨；侮辱：hate, hatred, contempt

t: adj. 连续不断的， 连贯的
en: consecutive numbers or periods of time follow one after the other without any interruptions

ex.en: It had rained for four consecutive days.
ex.cn: 雨接连下了四天。

ex.en: Can they win the title for the third consecutive season?
ex.cn: 他们能连续第三个赛季赢得冠军称号吗？

ph.cn: 连续营业日；连续作业日

syn: adj. 连贯的；连续不断的：connected, coherent
rm: con + secut(跟随) + ive → 一个接一个的 → 连续不断的， 连贯的

t: n. 吸收； 吸收和同化的过程
en: the process of understanding and using new ideas

ex.en: Process of soaking up or assimilation of one substance by another.
ex.cn: 一种介质向另一种介质渗透和同化的过程。

ph.cn: 氮同化；氮素同化；氮素同化作用

syn: n. [生理]同化；吸收；[地质][生化]同化作用：absorption, merger

t: vi. 呻吟；叹息；n. 呻吟声， 叹息声
en: to make a long deep sound because you are in pain, upset, or disappointed, or because something is very enjoyable

ex.en: The kids all groaned when I switched off the TV.
ex.cn: 我关掉电视时，孩子们都发出不满的抱怨声。

ex.en: Richard’s jokes make you groan rather than laugh.
ex.cn: 理查德的笑话让你哭笑不得。

syn: vi. 呻吟；抱怨；发吱嘎声：beef about, repine
vt. 呻吟；抱怨：beef about, rail against
rm: 受到折磨(groan)， 发出呻吟(moan)

t: v. 指导； 管理， 实施； 指挥；n. 举止；指导；管理[kən'dʌkt]
en: to stand in front of a group of musicians or singers and direct their playing or singing

ex.en: Who will be conducting?
ex.cn: 由谁来指挥？

syn: vi. 导电；带领：lead through
vt. 管理；引导；表现：manage, run, direct, represent, aim
rm: con(表加强) + duct(引导) → 指导

t: vt. 埋葬； 埋藏， 掩藏
en: to put someone who has died in a  grave

ex.en: Electric cables are buried beneath the streets.
ex.cn: 电缆埋在街道的下面。

syn: vt. 埋葬；隐藏：lock, pocket

t: n. 生活， 生计
en: the way you earn money in order to live

ex.en: It’s difficult to earn a livelihood as an artist.
ex.cn: 搞艺术很难谋生。

ex.en: Bates says he will lose his livelihood if his driving licence is taken away.
ex.cn: 贝茨说，如果驾照被吊销，他就没有了谋生的手段。

syn: n. 生计，生活；营生：life, existence, living, keep

t: n. 重聚， 团聚； 聚会， 联谊活动
en: a social meeting of people who have not met for a long time, especially people who were at school or college together

ex.en: an annual reunion
ex.cn: 一年一度的聚会

ex.en: a family reunion
ex.cn: 家庭聚会

rm: re(再， 又) + union(联合， 结合) → 重聚， 团聚

t: adj. 极好的； 荒诞的， 奇异的； 不切实际的
en: extremely good, attractive, enjoyable etc

ex.en: You look fantastic!
ex.cn: 你看上去棒极了！

ex.en: It’s a fantastic place, really beautiful!
ex.cn: 这真是个好地方，漂亮极了！

syn: adj. 奇异的；空想的；极好的；不可思议的：wonderful, excellent, famous, super, great
n. 古怪的人：weirdo, geezer

t: n. 排水
en: the process or system by which water or waste liquid flows away

ex.en: A handful of pebbles in the bottom of a flowerpot will help drainage.
ex.cn: 在花盆底下放一把鹅卵石能够帮助排水。

ex.en: a plan to improve the town’s drainage system
ex.cn: 改善城里排水系统的计划

ph.cn: 排水系统，渠道系统；水系；引流装置

syn: n. [农工][建]排水；排水系统；污水；排水面积：wastewater, bailing
rm: drain(排水) + age(集体名词后缀) → 排水(系统)

t: adj. 得胜的； 得意洋洋的； 狂欢的
en: having gained a victory or success

ex.en: the triumphant army
ex.cn: 得胜的军队

ex.en: The Nationalists emerged triumphant from the political crisis.
ex.cn: 民族主义政党成功地渡过政治危机。

syn: adj. 成功的；得意洋洋的；狂欢的：successful, made
rm: triumph(胜利) + ant → 得胜的； 得意洋洋的

t: n. 器械， 器具， 仪器； 机构， 组织
en: the set of tools and machines that you use for a particular scientific, medical, or technical purpose

ex.en: Astronauts have special breathing apparatus.
ex.cn: 航天员有专门的呼吸装装备。

syn: n. 装置，[机]设备；[仪]仪器；器官：device, equipment, installation, furniture, facility, unit, organ
rm: ap(靠近) + para(排列) + tus → 靠近排列 → 器械， 器具

t: v. 腐烂， 腐朽； 衰败， 衰退；n. 腐烂，腐朽；衰败状态
en: to be slowly destroyed by a natural chemical process, or to make something do this

ex.en: Her body was already starting to decay.
ex.cn: 她的尸体已经开始腐烂。

ex.en: Most archaeological finds are broken, damaged, or decayed.
ex.cn: 大部分考古发现物都已破裂、损坏或腐烂。

ph.cn: 衰减率；衰变率；衰变速度

syn: vi. 衰退，[核]衰减；腐烂，[木]腐朽：fail, flag
n. 衰退，[核]衰减；腐烂，[木]腐朽：recession, downturn, decline, decomposition
rm: 骗(decoy)人变坏(decay)

t: v. 伤心
en: if something grieves you, it makes you feel very unhappy

ex.en: My aunt, it grieves me to say, gets things confused.
ex.cn: 我的姑妈，说起来我很难过，她有点颠三倒四的。

syn: vt. 使悲伤，使苦恼：harry, excruciate
vi. 悲痛，哀悼：mourn over, lament over

t: n. 断裂，折断；
en: a crack or broken part in a bone or other hard substance

ex.en: a stress fracture in his left knee
ex.cn: 他左膝上的应力性骨折

ex.en: a hairline fracture
ex.cn: 细小的裂缝

syn: n. 破裂，[力]断裂；[外科]骨折：cracking, rhexis
vi. 破裂；折断：crack, come apart at the seams
rm: fract(打碎) + ure → (使)断裂

t: n. 自由，自由权；许可，准许；
en: the freedom and the right to do whatever you want without asking permission or being afraid of authority

ex.en: the fight for liberty and equality
ex.cn: 争取自由和平等的斗争

syn: n. 自由；许可；冒失：freedom, permission, leave

t: v. 回收利用
en: to put used objects or materials through a special process so that they can be used again

ex.en: We take all our bottles to be recycled.
ex.cn: 我们把我们所有的瓶子都回收利用。

ex.en: packaging made of recycled paper
ex.cn: 再生纸包装材料

syn: n. 再生；再循环；重复利用：regeneration, breeding, rebirth
rm: re(重新) + cycle(循环) → 循环利用 → 回收利用

t: n. 沼泽； 湿地
en: an area of low flat ground that is always wet and soft

ex.en: We gonna mosh through the marsh, take us right through the doors.
ex.cn: 我们要在这沼泽中前进， 使我们的权利通过这些门。

ex.en: Long strips of glazing set vertically into white frames face out into the marsh landscape of the site.
ex.cn: 曲线形的立面朝向基地的湿地，其垂直的白色框架间镶嵌着长条的玻璃窗。

syn: n. 沼泽；[地理]湿地：wetland, cienaga
adj. [地理]沼泽的；生长在沼泽地的：palustrine, swampy
rm: mars(火星) + h → 火星上可能会有沼泽 → 沼泽

t: n. 混乱
en: a situation in which everything is happening in a confused way and nothing is organized or arranged in order

ex.en: The country was plunged into economic chaos.
ex.cn: 这个国家陷入了经济大混乱。

syn: n. [物]混沌，混乱：disorder, confusion, involvement, mix, turmoil
rm: chao(拼音“吵”) + s(音似： 死) → 吵死啦！ → 混乱

t: n. 杏树； 杏仁
en: a flat pale nut with brown skin that tastes sweet, or the tree that produces these nuts

ex.en: Stir in the ground almonds and egg.
ex.cn: 拌入碾碎的扁桃仁和鸡蛋。

syn: n. [食品]杏仁，杏树；杏仁状的东西：apricot kernel, apricot tree

t: n&vt. 预报； 预测； 预想
en: a description of what is likely to happen in the future, based on the information that you have now

ex.en: The weather forecast is good for tomorrow.
ex.cn: 天气预报说明天是晴天。

syn: vt. [气象][通信]预报，预测；预示：predict, indicate, calculate, shadow
n. 预测，[气象][通信]预报；预想：prediction, divination
rm: fore(前面) + cast(扔) → 预先扔下 → 预报； 预测； 预想

t: v. 变坏， 恶化； 退化
en: to become worse

ex.en: Ethel’s health has deteriorated.
ex.cn: 埃塞尔的健康状况恶化了。

ex.en: America’s deteriorating economy
ex.cn: 美国日渐恶化的经济

syn: vi. 恶化，变坏：go ill, change for the worse
vt. 恶化：go ill, exasperate
rm: de(向下) + ter(地) + ior + ate → 向地面下降 → 变糟糕 → 变坏

t: vt. 认出； 承认， 认可
en: to know who someone is or what something is, because you have seen, heard, experienced, or learned about them in the past

ex.en: I didn’t recognize you in your uniform.
ex.cn: 你穿上制服我认不出你了。

ex.en: It was malaria, but Dr Lee hadn’t recognized the symptoms.
ex.cn: 这是疟疾，但李医生没有认出症状。

syn: vt. 认出，识别；承认：identify, spot, accept, agree, grant
vi. 确认，承认；具结：accept, confirm on
rm: re(再， 又) + co(=com 共同) + gn(知道) + ize → 再次共同知道 → 认出； 承认

t: n. 加工机； 加工工人； 处理器
en: the central part of a computer that deals with the commands and information it is given

ex.en: US tuna processors
ex.cn: 美国的金枪鱼加工厂商

ph.cn: n. 信号处理机；讯息处理者
n. 文字处理机；文字处理软件

syn: n. 处理器；[计]处理程序；[经管]加工者：treater, processing program
rm: 来自process(vt. 处理)

t: n. 竹子
en: a tall tropical plant with hollow stems that is used for making furniture

ex.en: Do you like bamboo?
ex.cn: 你喜欢竹子吗?。

ex.en: An adult pandas eat about 20 kilograms of fresh bamboo every day.
ex.cn: 一只成年的大熊猫每天要吃20公斤左右的鲜竹。

syn: adj. 竹制的；土著居民的：Abo
rm: “颁布” → 古时颁布的法令有些是刻在竹简上的 → 竹子

t: n. 投入，输入；输入的数据；vt. 把…输入计算机
en: ideas, advice, money, or effort that you put into a job or activity in order to help it succeed

ex.en: If the input data specified it, the file will close and the process terminates.
ex.cn: 如果输入数据指定，该文件就会关闭，数据处理终止。

syn: n. 投入；输入电路：investment, introjection
vt. [计][自][电子]输入；将…输入电脑：type in, carry in
rm: 来自词组put in(投入； 输入)

t: vt. 引诱， 劝使； 引起， 导致； 感应
en: to persuade someone to do something, especially something that does not seem wise

ex.en: She had to be induced because the baby was four weeks late.
ex.cn: 她的孩子晚了四星期仍未出生，因此要给她引产。

syn: vt. 诱导；引起；引诱；感应：attract, produce, cause, operate, occasion
rm: in(内) + duc(拉) + e → 向内拉 → 引诱； 引起

t: n. 伏特
en: a unit for measuring the force of an electric current

ex.en: That is one electron volt.
ex.cn: 就是一单位的电子伏特。

ex.en: If I multiply these two, what is the coulomb times a volt?
ex.cn: 如果我把这两个乘起来，库仑乘以伏特是多少？

syn: n. 伏特（电压单位）；环骑；闪避：jook

t: adj. 机灵的； 精明的
en: good at judging what people or situations are really like

ex.en: Malcolm is a shrewd businessman.
ex.cn: 马尔科姆是个精明的商人。

ex.en: She was shrewd enough to guess who was responsible.
ex.cn: 她很精明，一猜就知道是谁干的。

syn: adj. 精明的；狡猾的；机灵的：designing, knowing, clever, subtle
n. 精明（的人）；机灵（的人）：astuteness, smartness
rm: “熟的” → 对某事很熟， 因此反应灵敏 → 机灵的

t: vt. 使困惑，难倒；n. 挡板， 隔板
en: if something baffles you, you cannot understand or explain it at all

ex.en: The question baffled me completely.
ex.cn: 这个问题把我彻底难倒了。

syn: vt. 使…困惑；使…受挫折；用挡板控制：puzzle, set back
n. [建][机][电子]挡板；困惑：confusion, checkboard
rm: 战役(battle)开始， 一向忠诚的tt反戈， 令人费解(baffle) → 使困惑

t: n. 分子
en: the smallest unit into which any substance can be divided without losing its own chemical nature, usually consisting of two or more atoms

ex.en: The molecules of oxygen gas contain just two atoms.
ex.cn: 氧分子中只有两个原子。

syn: n. [化学]分子；微小颗粒，微粒：numerator of a fraction, microne
rm: mol(摩尔) + ecule → 分子

t: n. 论证， 证明； 示范； 显示， 表露； 示威游行
en: an event at which a large group of people meet to protest or to support something in public

ex.en: Supporters staged a demonstration outside the US embassy.
ex.cn: 支持者在美国大使馆外举行了示威游行。

ex.en: Police opened fire on a peaceful demonstration.
ex.cn: 警察朝和平示威的人群开了枪。

syn: n. 示范；证明；示威游行：authentication, certification, proof, evidence, march
rm: de(完全) + monstr(展示) + ation → 论证； 示范

t: v. 冒犯； 使厌恶； 违犯
en: to make someone angry or upset by doing or saying something that they think is rude, unkind etc

ex.en: His remarks deeply offended many Scottish people.
ex.cn: 他的话严重冒犯了许多苏格兰人。

ex.en: The careful language is designed not to offend.
ex.cn: 使用谨慎的语言是为了不得罪人。

syn: vt. 冒犯；使…不愉快：give offense, gross out
vi. 违反；进攻；引起不舒服：vary, be in breach of
rm: off(离开) + end(最后) → 冒犯了她， 最后离开了 → 冒犯

t: v. 圈出； 盘旋， 环绕…移动；n. 圆；圈，环状物；圈子，阶层；周期，循环
en: to move in the shape of a circle around something, especially in the air

ex.en: The plane circled the airport before landing.
ex.cn: 飞机着陆前在机场上空盘旋。

syn: n. 循环，周期；圆；圈子；圆形物：cycle, revolution, rotation, round, recurrence
vi. 盘旋，旋转；环行：wheel, orbit, spin

t: n. 备忘录， 摘要
en: a  memo

ex.en: ...a memorandum from the Department of Defense on its role.
ex.cn: …一份来自国防部的有关其角色的备忘录。

ph.cn: n. 谅解备忘录，理解备忘录；学术合作备忘录

syn: n. 备忘录；便笺：note, minute
rm: memor(记忆) + and + um → 辅助记忆的东西 → 备忘录

t: v. 辞职； 辞去； 放弃
en: to officially announce that you have decided to leave your job or an organization

ex.en: A hospital administrator has resigned over claims he lied to get the job.
ex.cn: 一位医院主管因为有人声称他的职位是骗来的而辞职了。

syn: vt. 辞职；放弃；委托；使听从：yield, desert, refer, quit
vi. 辞职：step down, quit
rm: re(回) + sign(签名) → 要回签名 → 辞职； 放弃

t: adj. 老于世故的， 老练的； 精密的， 尖端的， 先进的； 复杂的； 高雅的， 有教养的
en: a sophisticated machine, system, method etc is very well designed and very advanced, and often works in a complicated way

ex.en: sophisticated software
ex.cn: 很先进的软件

ex.en: a highly sophisticated weapons system
ex.cn: 非常精密的武器系统

syn: adj. 复杂的；精致的；久经世故的；富有经验的：complicated, experienced, involved, detailed, exquisite
v. 使变得世故；使迷惑；篡改（sophisticate的过去分词形式）：mystified

t: n. 详细检查， 细看； 监视
en: careful and thorough examination of someone or something

ex.en: Their activities have come under police scrutiny .
ex.cn: 他们的活动受到警方的严密监视。

syn: n. 详细审查；监视；细看；选票复查：observation, monitoring, surveillance, watch
rm: scru(音似： 四顾) ＋ tiny(微小的) → 连微小的都要顾到 → 详细检查， 细看

t: v. 追捕； 追求； 雕镂
en: to quickly follow someone or something in order to catch them

ex.en: The dogs saw him running and chased him.
ex.cn: 那些狗看到他在跑就追他。

ex.en: kids chasing around the house
ex.cn: 在屋里追逐嬉戏的孩子们

ph.cn: 开门见山；提到关键问题；转入（或切入）正题

syn: vt. 追逐；追捕；试图赢得；雕镂：go after, track down
vi. 追逐；追赶；奔跑：pursue, go after
rm: 谁动了我的奶酪(cheese)， 我就去追(chase)谁

t: adj. 不可剥夺的， 不可分割的
en: an inalienable right, power etc cannot be taken from you

ex.en: inalienable human rights
ex.cn: 不可剥夺的人权

syn: adj. 不可分割的；不可剥夺的；不能让与的：indissociable, inseparable
rm: in(不) + ali(其他的) + en + able(能…的) → 不能让与他人的 → 不可剥夺的， 不可分割的

t: adj. 不兼容的， 不能和谐共存的， 不协调的， 合不来的
en: two people who are incompatible have such diffe-rent characters, beliefs etc that they cannot have a friendly relationship

ex.en: I don’t know why they ever got married. They’re totally incompatible.
ex.cn: 我不知道他们为什么结婚，他们根本合不来。

syn: adj. [数]不相容的；矛盾的；不能同时成立的：antipathic, contradictory

t: adj. 海的， 海事的； 海运的
en: relating to the sea or ships

ex.en: San Francisco has lost nearly all of its maritime industry.
ex.cn: 旧金山几乎失去了所有海运业。

ph.cn: 海上航行；水运；航海学；海洋船舶驾驶

syn: adj. [海洋]海的；海事的；沿海的；海员的：coastal, thalassic
rm: mari(海) + time(时间) → 海上的时间 → 海的， 海事的

t: n. 收到，接到；发票，收据；
en: a piece of paper that you are given which shows that you have paid for something

ex.en: Keep your receipt in case you want to bring it back.
ex.cn: 保留收据以备退货之需。

ex.en: Can you give me a receipt?
ex.cn: 你能给我一个收条吗？

syn: n. 收到；收据；收入：income, proceeds, earning
vt. 收到：receive from, to hand
rm: re + ceipt(拿， 取) → 拿到的， 取到的 → 收入， 进款

t: n. 唤起， 激起
en: excitement, especially sexual excitement
syn: n. [心理]觉醒；激励：stimulus, animation, excitation

t: n. 胶囊； 航天舱， 太空舱
en: a plastic container shaped like a very small tube with medicine inside that you swallow whole

ex.en: a space capsule orbiting the Earth
ex.cn: 沿地球轨道飞行的太空舱

ph.cn: [口语]概括地说，简单扼要地讲

syn: n. [药]胶囊；[植]蒴果；太空舱；小容器：micella
adj. 压缩的；概要的：compressive, constringent
rm: cap(帽子) + sule(音似： seal，“密封”) → 帽状物 → 胶囊； 密封舱

t: adj. 不可能的， 办不到的
en: something that is impossible cannot happen or be done

ex.en: ‘I want to speak to Mr Franks.’ ‘I’m afraid that’s impossible.’
ex.cn: “我想和弗兰克斯先生谈谈。”“恐怕不行。”

ex.en: It’s impossible to be accurate about these things.
ex.cn: 这些事情不可能准确无误。

ph.cn: 不可能的任务，棘手的任务
不可能实现的梦；不可能的梦想

syn: adj. 不可能的；不可能存在的；难以忍受的；不真实的：incorrect, unbearable
n. 不可能；不可能的事：a blue moon
rm: 汤姆·克鲁斯主演的电影《碟中谍》就是Mission Impossible

t: n. 努力， 艰难的尝试； 成就
en: an attempt to do something, especially when this involves a lot of hard work or determination

ex.en: please make an effort to be polite.
ex.cn: 请尽量礼貌些。

ex.en: Church leaders are prepared to meet the terrorists in an effort to (= in order to try to ) find peace.
ex.cn: 为寻求和平，教会领袖准备与恐怖分子会面。

syn: n. 努力；成就：achievement, success, pain, struggle, trial

t: vi. 侵犯； 擅闯； 利用； 冒犯， 触犯

ph.cn: 侵犯；非法侵入；妨碍；打扰

syn: vi. 侵入；犯罪；打扰；冒犯：sin, intrude upon
n. 罪过；非法侵入；过失；擅自进入：debt, error, mistake, sin, blame
rm: tres(=trans越过) + pass(大步走) → 越过去大步走 → 侵犯； 冒犯， 触犯

t: adj. 国际主义者的；n. 国际主义者
en: If someone has internationalist beliefs or opinions, they believe that countries should work with, help, and be friendly with one another

ex.en: ...a more genuinely internationalist view of U.S. participation in peacekeeping.
ex.cn: ...一种美国参与维和的更真诚的国际主义观点。

syn: n. 国际主义者；国际法学家：publicist
rm: international(国际的， 世界的) + ist(表人)→ 国际主义者

t: adj. 发展迅速的； 激增的
syn: adj. 兴旺的，繁荣的；大受欢迎的：prosperous, flourishing
v. 兴旺（boom的ing形式）；发出隆隆声：thriving
rm: 来自boom(n./vi. 繁荣)

t: n. 周围的事物， 环境
en: the objects, buildings, natural things etc that are around a person or thing at a particular time

ex.en: I need to work in pleasant surroundings.
ex.cn: 我需要在舒适的环境下工作。

syn: n. 环境；周围的事物：context, circumstance, setting, condition

t: adj. 穷困的， 赤贫的； 贫乏的， 贫瘠的； 枯竭的
syn: adj. 穷困的；用尽了的，无创造性的：destitute
rm: im(进入) + pover(贫困) + ish(使…) + ed → 使处于贫困中的 → 穷困的， 赤贫的； 贫乏的

t: n. 臭氧
en: a poisonous blue gas that is a type of oxygen

ex.en: Objective To observe the disinfection effect of gastroscope by ozone water.
ex.cn: 目的观察臭氧水在胃镜体的消毒效果监测。

ex.en: Their skin is weathered and tanned, as if they have fossilised themselves in ozone to keep death at bay.
ex.cn: 他们的皮肤饱经风霜被晒得黧黑，好像他们在臭氧中变成化石并在海湾边防止死亡。

t: n. 农业； 农学
en: the practice or science of farming

ex.en: More than 75% of the land is used for agriculture.
ex.cn: 75%以上的土地用于农耕。

syn: n. [农]农业；农艺，[农学]农学：farming, extractive industry
rm: agri(田地； 农业) + cult(种植； 培养) + ure → 农业； 农学

t: n. 武器， 兵器
en: something that you use to fight with or attack someone with, such as a knife, bomb, or gun

ex.en: They all had sticks which they planned to use as weapons.
ex.cn: 他们都持有棍棒，打算当武器用。

syn: n. 武器，[军]兵器：arm, armament

t: adj. 最小的， 最低限度的
en: very small in degree or amount, especially the smallest degree or amount possible

ex.en: The storm caused only minimal damage.
ex.cn: 暴风雨只造成了轻微破坏。

ex.en: The cost to taxpayers would be minimal.
ex.cn: 纳税人的支出将是最少的。

syn: adj. 最低的；最小限度的：lowest, bottommost
rm: min(小) + imal → 最小的

t: n. 岩浆， 熔岩
en: hot liquid rock that flows from a volcano,or this rock when it has become solid

ex.en: Mexico's Mount Colima began spewing lava and ash last night.
ex.cn: 墨西哥科利马山昨晚开始喷发熔岩和火山灰。

rm: 幼虫(larva)在岩浆(lava)中熔化

t: n. 生态， 生态学； 生态环境
en: the way in which plants, animals, and people are related to each other and to their environment, or the scientific study of this

ex.en: the natural ecology of the Earth
ex.cn: 地球的自然生态

ex.en: plant ecology
ex.cn: 植物生态学

syn: n. [生态]生态学；社会生态学：oecology, bionomics
rm: eco(家庭) ＋ logy(…学) → 研究(地球这个大)家庭事务的学科 → 生态学

t: adj. 勇敢的， 有胆量的
en: brave

ex.en: He was wrong, and courageous enough to admit it.
ex.cn: 他是错了，而且有勇气承认自己错了。

ex.en: a courageous decision
ex.cn: 勇敢的决定

syn: adj. 有胆量的，勇敢的：game, brave
rm: courage(勇气) + ous(形容词后缀) → 有勇气的 → 勇敢的，有胆量的

t: adj. 有毒的； 分泌毒液的； 恶意的， 狠毒的
en: full of hatred or anger

ex.en: Lisa shot him a venomous glance.
ex.cn: 莉萨恶狠狠地瞪了他一眼。

ex.en: Reid reserved his most venomous attack for the Rail Authority.
ex.cn: 里德攻击铁路当局还有最厉害的一招没使出来。

syn: adj. 有毒的；恶毒的；[动]分泌毒液的；怨恨的：toxic, poisonous, vicious
rm: venom(毒液) + ous → 有毒的； 分泌毒液的

t: n. 挤出， 推出， 挤压
en: Extrusion is the act or process of extruding something
syn: n. 挤出；推出；赶出；[地质]喷出：pushing out, pushout
rm: ex(出) + trus(刺) + ion → 挤出

t: adj. 稳步的；稳定的；v. 稳定， 平稳； 镇定
en: continuing or developing gradually or without stopping, and not likely to change

ex.en: Paul is making steady progress.
ex.cn: 保罗逐渐在进步。

ex.en: a steady rain
ex.cn: 下个不停的雨

syn: adj. 稳定的；不变的；沉着的：settled, constant, stable, composed, permanent
vt. 使稳定；稳固；使坚定：firm, stabilitate
rm: st ＋ eady(看作ready， 准备好的) → 事先有准备， 心里就有底 → 稳的； 稳定的

t: [计][数] 归纳推理；归纳法

ex.en: A dynamic self-learning efficient intrusion detection model was proposed based on inductive reasoning.
ex.cn: 提出了一种基于归纳推理的动态自学习的高效入侵检测模型。

ex.en: The paper deals with the role that perceptional similarity and category concepts play in infants' inductive reasoning.
ex.cn: 文章探讨了知觉相似性和类别概念在幼儿归纳推理中的作用。

syn: undefined. [计][数]归纳推理；归纳法：inductive inference, induction method

t: vt. 围住； 附上； 把…装入信封
en: to put something inside an envelope as well as a letter

ex.en: Please enclose a cheque with your order.
ex.cn: 请随订单附上支票。

syn: vt. 围绕；装入；放入封套：enring, inclose
rm: en(进入) + close(关闭) → 关闭在里面 → 围住

t: n. 综览， 概述
en: a short description of a subject or situation that gives the main ideas without explaining all the details

ex.en: The central section of the book is a historical overview of drug use.
ex.cn: 本书的中心部分是对药物使用的一个历史概述。

syn: n. [图情]综述；概观：roundup, summarisation

t: n. 校长
en: a male teacher who is in charge of a school

ex.en: If only I knew my new headmaster!
ex.cn: 要是我认识我的新校长就好了！

ex.en: Allow me to introduce you to our headmaster.
ex.cn: 请允许我介绍你见见我们的校长。

syn: n. 校长：principal, president

t: n. 技术员， 技师
en: someone whose job is to check equipment or machines and make sure that they are working properly

ex.en: a laboratory technician
ex.cn: 实验室技术人员

ex.en: a hospital technician
ex.cn: 医院技术人员

syn: n. [劳经]技师，技术员；技巧纯熟的人：lab-technician
rm: techn(技艺) + ician(表人) → 技术员， 技师

t: n. 日规； 日晷
en: an object used in the past for telling the time. The shadow of a pointed piece of metal shows the time and moves round as the sun moves.

ex.en: The shadow on this sundial showed the time to the minute precisely!
ex.cn: 由这个日晷的阴影显示出来的时间，精确到了分钟。

ex.en: The invention and use of the gnomon-and-ruler, sundial, clepsydra and other time-measuring machines is evidence of Chinese wisdom.
ex.cn: 圭表、日晷、漏刻等计时仪器的发明和应用，证明中华民族是个充满智慧的民族。

syn: n. 日晷，[天]日规；羽扇豆（产于美国东部）：gnomon, solarium

t: adj. 一般的， 普通的， 通用的； 种的， 属的
en: relating to a whole group of things rather than to one thing

ex.en: Parmesan is a generic term used to describe a family of hard Italian cheeses.
ex.cn: 巴尔马干酪是一个用来描述一类坚硬的意大利奶酪的通用名称。

syn: adj. 类的；一般的；属的；非商标的：common, prevailing
rm: gen(产生) + er + ic → 产生不同种属的 → 种的， 属的； 注意不要和genetic(a. 遗传的； 起源的)相混

t: adj. 一次性的； 可动用的
en: intended to be used once or for a short time and then thrown away

ex.en: disposable nappies
ex.cn: 一次性尿布

rm: dis + pos(放置) + able → 不能长久放置的 → 一次性的

t: vt. 支持， 赞同
en: to express formal support or approval for someone or something

ex.en: I can endorse their opinion wholeheartedly.
ex.cn: 我可以全心全意地支持他们的观点。

syn: vt. 背书；认可；签署；赞同；在背面签名：ink, allow, back, sign

t: n. 清楚
en: the clarity of a piece of writing, law, argument etc is its quality of being expressed clearly

ex.en: Letters may be edited for length and clarity.
ex.cn: 信件可能要加以修改以求篇幅合适，意思明了。

ex.en: a lack of clarity in the law on property rights
ex.cn: 产权法律含糊不清

syn: n. 清楚，明晰；[化学]透明：transparency, perspicuousness
rm: clar(清楚) + ity → 清楚

t: n. 基础结构， 基础设施
en: the basic systems and structures that a country or organization needs in order to work properly, for example roads, railways, banks etc

ex.en: Some countries lack a suitable economic infrastructure.
ex.cn: 一些国家缺乏适当的经济基础设施。

ex.en: a $65 billion investment package in education, health care and infrastructure
ex.cn: 用于教育、医疗和基础设施的650亿美元一揽子投资计划

ph.cn: 基础设施；基础设施建设

rm: infra(在…下面) + struct(结构， 建造) + ure → 下面的结构 → 基础结构

t: vt. 使隔离， 使孤立
en: to remove from contact with others
syn: vt. 使隔离，使隔绝：segregate, quarantine
rm: se(分离) + clud(关闭) + e → 脱离， 过着封闭的生活 → 使隔离， 使孤立

t: adj. 典型的
en: having the usual features or qualities of a particular group or thing

ex.en: typical British weather
ex.cn: 典型的英国天气

ex.en: This advertisement is a typical example of their marketing strategy.
ex.cn: 这则广告是他们营销策略的一个典型例子。

syn: adj. [数]典型的；特有的；象征性的：characteristic, representative, proper, very, own
rm: typ(e)(典型) + ical → 典型的

t: adj. 夜晚的； 夜晚发生的； 夜晚活动的
en: an animal that is nocturnal is active at night

ex.en: Hamsters are nocturnal creatures.
ex.cn: 仓鼠是夜行动物。

rm: noct(夜) + urnal → 夜晚的

t: adj. 著名的， 众所周知的； 声名狼藉的
en: famous or well-known for something bad

ex.en: a notorious computer hacker
ex.cn: 声名狼藉的电脑黑客

ex.en: notorious cases of human rights abuses
ex.cn: 臭名昭著的践踏人权案

syn: adj. 声名狼藉的，臭名昭著的：infamous, disreputable

t: n. 加重； 恶化； 愤怒， 恼怒
syn: n. 加剧；激怒；更恶化：wrath, intension

t: adv. 连续地， 持续地
syn: adv. 不断地；频繁地：constantly, forever, frequently, unceasingly, straight

t: v. 从…卸下货物； 摆脱
en: to remove a load from a vehicle, ship etc

ex.en: Unload everything from the boat and clean it thoroughly.
ex.cn: 从小船上卸下所有的货物并彻底地清洗。

syn: vt. 卸；摆脱…之负担；倾销：debark
vi. 卸货；退子弹：discharge of goods, load off
rm: un + load(负荷， 重担) → 从…卸下货物

t: n. 马戏团； 环形广场
en: a group of people and animals who travel to different places performing skilful tricks as entertainment

ex.en: Piccadilly Circus
ex.cn: 皮卡迪利广场

ph.cn: 皮卡迪利广场（戏院及娱乐中心）
大篷车；（马戏团的）大篷车

syn: n. 马戏；马戏团：Circus Troupe, Circus Charlie
rm: circ(圆， 环形) + us → 环形广场

t: n. 陷阱，圈套，诡计；vt. 诱捕， 诱骗， 使中圈套； 使陷入困境， 使受限制
en: a piece of equipment for catching animals

ex.en: The only way to catch mice is to set a trap .
ex.cn: 抓老鼠的唯一办法就是放置捕鼠器。

ex.en: He stepped into a bear trap covered in snow.
ex.cn: 他踩到了埋在雪里的一个捕熊夹。

ph.cn: 疏水阀；疏水器；汽水分离器；凝汽阀

syn: vt. 诱捕；使…受限制；使…陷入困境：ensnare
n. [计]陷阱；圈套；[建]存水弯：web, mesh, pit

t: v. 乘电车；n. 有轨电车，电车轨道
en: a vehicle for passengers, which travels along metal tracks in the street

ex.en: The tramp from the tram swamped the ham hamburge with shampoo.
ex.cn: 有轨电车的脚步声淹没了带有香波的火腿汉堡。

ex.en: The tramp from the tram swamped the ham hamburger with shampoo.
ex.cn: 来自有轨电车的流浪者用洗发水淹没火腿汉堡。

syn: vi. 乘电车：trolley

t: n. 气味
en: a smell, especially an unpleasant one

ex.en: ...the lingering odour of car exhaust.
ex.cn: …挥之不去的汽车尾气的独特气味。

syn: n. 气味；声誉：smell, wind, odor, prestige

t: vt. 剥夺； 使丧失
en: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it

ex.en: They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.
ex.cn: 他们无法得到住房取暖必需的燃料。

syn: vt. 使丧失，剥夺：shear, strip of
rm: de(离开) + priv(私有的) + e → 使某物离开某人 → 使丧失

t: n. 重新规划； 重新建设
en: the act of redeveloping an area, especially in a city

ex.en: redevelopment of the city’s downtown area
ex.cn: 中心城区的改造

t: adj. 花的， 像花的； 绘有花的， 饰以花的； 植物群的
en: made of flowers or decorated with flowers or pictures of flowers

ex.en: a scarf with a bold floral pattern
ex.cn: 印有鲜艳花卉图案的围巾

ex.en: a pretty floral dress
ex.cn: 漂亮的印花连衣裙

syn: adj. 花的；植物的，植物群的；花似的：vegetable, flowery

t: n. 害虫
en: a small animal or insect that destroys crops or food supplies

ex.en: a chemical used in pest control
ex.cn: 用于防治虫害的一种化学品

ph.cn: 病虫害控制；病虫害治理；有害生物管理

syn: n. 害虫；[植保]有害之物；讨厌的人：verm, injurious insect

t: v. 骑车；
en: to ride a bicycle

ex.en: The amount of calories that you burn depends on how hard you pedal and how much you weigh.
ex.cn: 您燃烧的热量有多少，端看您骑得有多卖力及您本身的体重有多重。

ph.cn: （汽车等的）油门踏板；[机]加速踏板

syn: vi. 踩踏板；骑车：ride bike
n. 踏板；脚蹬子：footplate, treadboard
rm: ped(脚) + al → 脚踏的东西 → 踏板

t: n. 遗产； 传统
en: the traditional beliefs, values, customs etc of a family, country, or society

ex.en: the importance of preserving the national heritage
ex.cn: 保护民族遗产的重要性

ex.en: beautiful old buildings which are part of our heritage
ex.cn: 属于我们遗产一部分的漂亮古建筑

syn: n. 遗产；传统；继承物；继承权：tradition, succession, inheritance, legacy
rm: her(遗传) + it + age(集体名词后缀) → 遗传下来的东西 → 遗产； 传统

t: n. 救护车； 野战医院
en: a special vehicle that is used to take people who are ill or injured to hospital

ex.en: the ambulance service
ex.cn: 救护车服务

ex.en: the ambulance service
ex.cn: 你觉得我们需要叫救护车吗？

syn: n. [车辆][医]救护车；战时流动医院：meat wagon
rm: ambul(行走) + ance(名词后缀) → 到处流动的车 → 救护车

t: vi. 倾斜；n. 斜坡；倾斜
en: if the ground or a surface slopes, it is higher at one end than the other

ex.en: The bank sloped down sharply to the river.
ex.cn: 那座堤岸陡峭地朝着那条河倾斜下去。

ph.cn: 岩石边坡；石坡；岩石坡；石流坡
边坡保护，护坡；护坡工程

syn: n. 斜坡；倾斜；[数]斜率；扛枪姿势：hill, pitch
vi. 倾斜；逃走：pitch, tip up

en: an arrangement for a meeting at an agreed time and place, for a particular purpose

ex.en: All consultations are by appointment only .
ex.cn: 就诊必须预约。

syn: n. [管理]任命；约定；任命的职位：convention, bond, nomination

t: vt. 与…竞争， 赶上； 仿真， 模仿
en: to do something or behave in the same way as someone else, especially because you admire them

ex.en: He hoped to emulate the success of Wilder.
ex.cn: 他希望效仿怀尔德的成功。

syn: vt. 仿真；模仿；尽力赶上；同…竞争：simulate, pattern, imitate
n. 仿真；仿效：simulation, stylization
rm: emul(竞争) + ate → 与…竞争， 赶上

t: n. 陶器； 瓦器
en: cups, dishes, plates etc

ex.en: a stack of dirty crockery
ex.cn: 一大堆脏碗碟

syn: n. 陶器；瓦器；土器：earthenware, pottery ware
rm: crock(坛子， 瓦罐) + ery → 陶器； 瓦器

t: vi&n. 牛拉车； 艰苦跋涉

ex.en: a lonely trek through the forest
ex.cn: 穿越森林的孤独跋涉

syn: n. 艰苦跋涉：treck
vt. （牛）拉（货车）；搬运：pull, draw, carry

t: v. 压碎， 挤压； 挤进， 塞入； 镇住， 镇压； 制止；n. 软式墙网球，壁球
en: to press something into a flatter shape, often breaking or damaging it

ex.en: The cake got a bit squashed on the way here.
ex.cn: 蛋糕在送来这里的路上有点压坏了。

ex.en: Move over - you’re squashing me.
ex.cn: 挪过去点，你挤着我了。

syn: vt. 镇压；把…压扁；使沉默：silence, suppress
vi. 受挤压；发出挤压声；挤入：wedge in, pile in
rm: squ(看作squeeze， 挤) + ash(灰) → 挤成灰 → 挤压

t: vi. 主修， 专攻；adj. 主要的；n. 专业
en: very large or important, when compared to other things or people of a similar kind

ex.en: Why do you like your major?
ex.cn: 你为什么喜欢你的主修科目?。

ex.en: What are your major subject and minor subject?
ex.cn: 你的主修科目和辅修科目是什么?。

syn: adj. 主要的；重要的；主修的；较多的：crucial, important, primary, considerable, central
n. [人类]成年人；主修科目；陆军少校：adult
rm: maj(大) + or → 较大的 → 主要的

t: v. 中断， 中止； 阻碍； 打断， 打扰
en: to stop someone from continuing what they are saying or doing by suddenly speaking to them, making a noise etc

ex.en: Will you stop interrupting me!
ex.cn: 别打断我的话！

ex.en: Sorry to interrupt, but I need to ask you to come downstairs.
ex.cn: 很抱歉打扰了，我得请你下楼来。

syn: vt. 中断；打断；插嘴；妨碍：let, violate
vi. 打断；打扰：cut in on, to break in on
rm: inter(在…之间) + rupt(打破， 断裂) → 在中间断裂 → 中断， 中止； 打断， 打扰

t: n. 强调； 重要性
en: special attention or importance

ex.en: a change of emphasis in government policy
ex.cn: 政府政策重心的变化

syn: n. 重点；强调；加强语气：stress, unode
rm: em(表加强) + phas(说) + is → 强调；重要性

t: adj. 可行的， 可能的； 可做的， 可实行的
en: a plan, idea, or method that is feasible is possible and is likely to work

ex.en: a feasible solution
ex.cn: 可行的解决方法

ph.cn: [化]可行域；[计]可行区域；[经]可行性区域
经济上可行的，经济上合算

syn: adj. 可行的；可能的；可实行的：possible, working, potential, viable
rm: f + easi(看作easy， 容易的) + ble → 容易做到的 → 可能的

t: v. 开处方， 开药； 规定， 指示
en: to say what medicine or treatment a sick person should have

ex.en: What punishment does the law prescribe for this crime?
ex.cn: 法律规定这种罪行应受何处罚？

syn: vi. 规定；开药方：to stipulate, to formulate
vt. 规定；开处方：define, regulate, state, rule
rm: pre(预先) + scrib(写) + e → 预先写好 → 规定； 指示

t: adj. 潜在的；可能的；n. 潜力， 潜能
en: likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future

ex.en: The company has identified 60 potential customers.
ex.cn: 该公司已确定了60位潜在的客户。

ph.cn: [经]市场潜力；市场潜在需求量

syn: n. 潜能；可能性；[电]电势：possibility, probability, feasibility, maybe, chance
adj. 潜在的；可能的；势的：feasible, possible, underlying, latent
rm: po + tent(伸展) + ial → 无限伸展的 → 潜在的； 可能的； 潜能

t: n. 涡轮机， 汽轮机
en: an engine or motor in which the pressure of a liquid or gas moves a special wheel around

ex.en: The new ship will be powered by two gas turbines and four diesel engines.
ex.cn: 那艘新轮船将由2台燃气涡轮机和4台柴油机驱动。

ph.cn: 汽轮机；蒸汽轮机；蒸汽透平

rm: turb(晃动) + ine → 涡轮机

t: vi. 懒洋洋地站；n. 等候室； 休息室
en: to stand, sit, or lie in a lazy or relaxed way

ex.en: Nathan was lounging on the grass bank outside the cottage.
ex.cn: 内森正懒洋洋地躺在小屋外的草堤上。

syn: n. [建]休息室；闲逛；躺椅；（英）酒吧间：retiring room, lobby
vi. 闲逛；懒洋洋地躺卧；闲混：lig, knock around

t: adj. 总的， 毛的
en: clearly wrong and unacceptable

ex.en: ...a fixed rate account guaranteeing 10.4% gross interest or 7.8% net until October.
ex.cn: …一个能保证到10月份为止获得10.4%毛利或7.8%净利的固定利率账户。

syn: adj. 总共的；粗野的；恶劣的；显而易见的：robust, rough, country, dirty, bush
n. 总额，总数：sum, amount, total

t: v. 抵抗； 抗； 耐
en: to try to prevent a change from happening, or prevent yourself from being forced to do something

ex.en: He resisted pressure to resign.
ex.cn: 他顶住压力，没辞职。

ph.cn: 人见人爱；无法抗拒；惹人喜爱

syn: vi. 抵抗，[法]抗拒；忍耐：hit back, stick up to
vt. 抵抗；忍耐，忍住：tough, hit back
rm: re(反) + sist(站) → 站在对立面 → 抵抗

t: vt. 使丧失， 剥夺
en: to deprive (of) something or someone valued, esp through death
rm: be(使…) + reav(抢夺) + e → 使丧失， 剥夺

t: n. 档案；档案室；vt. 存档
en: a place where a large number of historical records are stored, or the records that are stored

ex.en: an archive of the writer’s unpublished work
ex.cn: 那位作家未发表作品的档案

syn: n. 档案馆；档案文件：chancery

t: vt. 刺激； 使兴奋； 激发， 激励
en: to encourage or help an activity to begin or develop further

ex.en: Her interest in art was stimulated by her father.
ex.cn: 她对艺术的兴趣是她父亲激发的。

syn: vt. 刺激；鼓舞，激励：fan, power, motivate, needle, activate

t: v. 浸泡
en: if you soak something, or if you let it soak, you keep it covered with a liquid for a period of time, especially in order to make it softer or easier to clean

ex.en: Soak the clothes in cold water.
ex.cn: 把衣服浸泡在冷水里。

ex.en: Let the pans soak; I’ll wash them later.
ex.cn: 把锅泡着吧，我过一会儿再洗。

syn: vt. 吸收，吸入；沉浸在（工作或学习中）；使……上下湿透：absorb, drink in
vi. 浸泡；渗透：dip in, sink
rm: 在肥皂(soap)水中浸泡(soak)

t: v. 上下班往返，经常往返；交换，抵偿；减刑；n. 上下班路程
en: to change the punishment given to a criminal to one that is less severe

ex.en: Baldry’s 20-year prison sentence was commuted to three years.
ex.cn: 鲍德里二十年的刑期被减至三年。

syn: vt. 减刑；[数]交换；用……交换；使……变成：exchange for, give for
rm: com(=with以) + mut(改变) + e → 以一物改变另一物 → 交换， 抵偿

t: n. 纤维
en: the parts of plants that you eat but cannot  digest  . Fibre helps to keep you healthy by moving food quickly through your body.

ex.en: Fruit and vegetables are high in fibre content .
ex.cn: 水果和蔬菜的纤维素含量很高。

ex.en: food that is high in dietary fibre
ex.cn: 富含膳食纤维的食物

syn: n. [材]纤维；纤维制品：fiber, funicle
rm: 多食富含纤维(fibre)的水果， 有助消化降火(fire)

t: v. 支撑， 撑住， 承受住； 维持， 保持； 经受， 遭受， 忍耐
en: to make something continue to exist or happen for a period of time

ex.en: She found it difficult to sustain the children’s interest.
ex.cn: 她发现很难保持孩子们的兴趣。

ex.en: He was incapable of sustaining close relationships with women.
ex.cn: 他无法和女人维持亲密关系。

syn: vt. 维持；支撑，承担；忍受；供养；证实：maintain, undertake, support, accept, favor
rm: sus(在…下面) + tain(支持) → 维持， 保持

t: n. 扭曲， 变形； 曲解， 歪曲
en: Distortion is the changing of something into something that is not true or not acceptable

ex.en: I think it would be a gross distortion of reality to say that they were motivated by self-interest.
ex.cn: 我认为说他们被自身利益所驱使是对事实的公然扭曲。

ph.cn: 热变形；热变化；热成畸变

syn: n. [力]变形；[物]失真；扭曲；曲解：deformation, transformation

t: n. 海拔，高度；
en: the height of an object or place above the sea

ex.en: The aircraft had reached its cruising altitude of about 39,000 feet.
ex.cn: 那架飞机已经达到了大约三万九千英尺的巡航高度。

syn: n. 高地；高度；[数]顶垂线；（等级和地位等的）高级：height, raise, elevation, rise
rm: alt(高) + i ＋ tude(表状态， 名词后缀) → 海拔， 高度

t: n&vt. 要求； 请求
en: a polite or formal demand for something

ex.en: To request more information, please call our toll free number.
ex.cn: 欲知详情，请拨打我们的免费电话。

syn: n. [计]请求；需要：asking, necessity, need, motion, want
vt. 要求，[计]请求：exact, desire, call for
rm: re(再， 又) + quest(寻求) → 请求； 要求

t: vt. 把…归类， 把…分级
en: to decide what group something belongs to

ex.en: We’d classify Drabble’s novels under ‘Romance’.
ex.cn: 我们把德拉布尔的小说归类为“言情小说”。

ex.en: Families are classified according to the father’s occupation.
ex.cn: 各个家庭按父亲的职业分类。

syn: vt. 分类；分等：categorize, sort through
rm: class(类别) + ify(使…) → 把…归类

t: n. 代替， 置换； 代入法
en: when someone or something is replaced by someone or something else, or the person or thing being replaced

ex.en: Coach Ross made two substitutions in the second half.
ex.cn: 罗斯教练在下半场两次换人。

ph.cn: 取代度；饱和度；代换的次数

syn: n. 代替；[数]置换；代替物：lieu, stead

t: n. 殖民地； 群体
en: a country or area that is under the political control of a more powerful country, usually one that is far away

ex.en: Algeria was formerly a French colony.
ex.cn: 阿尔及利亚以前是法国的殖民地。

syn: n. 殖民地；移民队：settlements
rm: col(耕种) + on + y(表场所， 名词后缀) → 在某处耕种 → 将那里变为自己的殖民地 → 殖民地

t: n. 透支； 透支额
en: the amount of money you owe to a bank when you have spent more money than you had in your account

ex.en: a £250 overdraft
ex.cn: 250英镑的透支额

ex.en: Many students have a free overdraft facility (= agreement with their bank to have an overdraft up to a particular limit ).
ex.cn: 许多学生都能享受免费透支服务。

t: n. 四轮马车； 大篷车
en: a strong vehicle with four wheels, used for carrying heavy loads and usually pulled by horses
syn: n. 货车，[车辆]四轮马车：carriage, lorry
rm: 大众汽车Volkswagon → 客货两用车 → 大篷车

t: v. 指， 指向； 表明； 瞄准；n. 尖， 尖端； 点， 小数点； 条款， 细目； 分数， 得分； 要点， 论点， 观点
en: to show something to someone by holding up one of your fingers or a thin object towards it

ex.en: ‘Look!’ she said and pointed.
ex.cn: “看呀！”她用手指着说道。

ex.en: She pointed in the direction of the car park.
ex.cn: 她指着停车场的方向。

syn: n. 要点；得分；[语]标点；[机]尖端：core, main, heart, kernel, essential
vt. 指向；弄尖；加标点于：direct to, fall on

t: adj. 一般的，普通的；全体的，普遍的；大体的，概括的；首席的；n. 将军
en: describing or relating to only the main features or parts of something, not the details

ex.en: a general introduction to computing
ex.cn: 计算机应用概论

ex.en: I skimmed through it to get a general impression of the text.
ex.cn: 我把文章浏览了一下，让自己有个大致的了解。

syn: adj. 一般的，普通的；综合的；大体的：ordinary, integrated, synthetic, comprehensive, average
n. 一般；将军，上将；常规：strategos, aga
rm: gen(产生) + er + al → 产生一切的 → 普遍的

t: n. 尺寸，度；方面，特点；维，元；
en: a part of a situation or a quality involved in it

ex.en: You can have a spiritual dimension to your life without being religious.
ex.cn: 即使你不信宗教，也可以在生命中拥有精神层面的内容。

syn: n. [数]维；尺寸；次元；容积：measurement, size
rm: di + mens(测量) + ion → 测量 → 尺寸； 面积

t: n. 野生生物
en: animals and plants growing in natural conditions

ex.en: measures to protect the area’s wildlife
ex.cn: 保护该地区野生生物的措施

ex.en: the destruction of wildlife habitats
ex.cn: 野生动植物生存环境的破坏

rm: wild(野生的) + life(生命) → 野生生物

t: n. 过程；步骤，程序；vt. 加工； 处理； 办理
en: a series of actions that are done in order to achieve a particular result

ex.en: the Israeli-Egyptian peace process
ex.cn: 以－埃和平进程

ex.en: Repetition can help the learning process.
ex.cn: 重复对学习过程会有帮助。

syn: vt. 处理；加工：manufacture, cope with
n. 过程，进行；方法，步骤；作用；程序；推移：going on, course, system, method, approach
rm: pro(向前) + cess(行走) → 向前走 → 过程

t: v. 应得； 值得
en: to have earned something by good or bad actions or behaviour

ex.en: What have I done to deserve this?
ex.cn: 我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？

ex.en: I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
ex.cn: 我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。

syn: vi. 应受，应得：be deserving of
vt. 应受，应得：be deserving of
rm: de + serv(服务)  + e → 花钱享受应得的服务 → 应得； 值得

t: vt. 恢复， 使复位； 修复， 整修， 重建； 归还， 交还
en: to make something return to its former state or condition

ex.en: She was hoping that the Mediterranean climate would restore her to full health.
ex.cn: 她希望地中海的气候能使她的身体完全复原。

ex.en: The National Guard was called in to restore order (= make people stop fighting and breaking the law ) when riots broke out.
ex.cn: 暴乱爆发后，国民警卫队被调来恢复秩序。

syn: vt. 恢复；修复；归还：replace, return, repair
vi. 恢复；还原：recover from, unsave
rm: 灾后重建(restore)， 包括商店(store)

t: adj. 黏滞的， 黏性的
en: a viscous liquid is thick and sticky and does not flow easily

ex.en: As the liquid cools, it becomes viscous.
ex.cn: 这液体冷却后会变黏稠。

syn: adj. [物]粘性的；黏的：sticky, gummy

t: adj. 可供替代的；非传统的，
en: an alternative idea, plan etc is different from the one you have and can be used instead

ex.en: An alternative route is along the Via Unione.
ex.cn: 另一条路线是沿着联合路走。

ph.cn: 没有别的办法了；没有其他选择

syn: adj. 供选择的；选择性的；交替的：selective, vicissitudinary
rm: altern(其他的) + at + ive(形容词后缀) → 可供替代的

t: n. 厨师长， 厨师
en: a skilled cook, especially the main cook in a hotel or restaurant

ex.en: a master chef
ex.cn: 手艺高超的厨师长

ex.en: a pastry chef
ex.cn: 糕饼师傅

syn: n. 厨师，大师傅：cook, kitchener
rm: 厨师长(chef)是厨房的长官(chief)

t: adj. 拥挤的； 塞满的
en: too full of people or things

ex.en: a crowded room
ex.cn: 拥挤的房间

ex.en: a crowded street
ex.cn: 拥挤的街道

syn: adj. 拥挤的；塞满的：jammed, congesting
v. 拥挤（crowd的过去分词）：overcrowded
rm: crowd(人群) + ed → 拥挤的人群 → 拥挤的

t: n. 横幅； 旗帜
en: a long piece of cloth on which something is written, often carried between two poles

ex.en: The onlookers were shouting, cheering, and waving banners.
ex.cn: 观众挥动着横幅，又是叫喊又是欢呼。

ph.cn: 美国国歌；美国国旗（等于Stars and Stripes）

syn: n. 旗帜，横幅；标语：slogan, oriflamme
rm: ban(禁止) + ner → 禁止悬挂横幅 → 横幅

t: vt&n. 遭遇， 遇到
en: to experience something, especially problems or opposition

ex.en: The doctor had encountered several similar cases in the past.
ex.cn: 那位医生过去曾碰到过好几个类似病例。

syn: vt. 遭遇，邂逅；遇到：confront, bring up against
n. 遭遇，偶然碰见：fell in with, lit on
rm: en(使…) + counter(相反的) → 使从两个相反的方面来 → 遇到， 遭遇

t: adj. 环保的
en: not harmful to the environment

ex.en: eco-friendly products
ex.cn: 对环境无害的产品

t: n. 性格外向的人； 爱交际的人
en: someone who is active and confident, and who enjoys spending time with other people

ex.en: Her sister was always more of an extrovert.
ex.cn: 她妹妹总是更外向些。

rm: extro(外) + vert(转) → 向外转的人 → 性格外向的人

t: v. 赞成； 批准， 同意
en: to officially accept a plan, proposal etc

ex.en: The conference approved a proposal for a referendum.
ex.cn: 会议通过了举行全民公决的提议。

syn: vt. 批准；赞成；为…提供证据：confirm, agree, uphold, authorize
vi. 批准；赞成；满意：to ratify, give someone the green light
rm: ap + prove(证实) → 经过证实才能批准 → 批准， 同意

t: v. 咀嚼； 回味； 熟思
en: to bite food several times before swallowing it

ex.en: This meat’s so tough I can hardly chew it!
ex.cn: 这肉太老了，我几乎嚼不动！

syn: n. 咀嚼；咀嚼物：mastication, quid
vt. 嚼碎，咀嚼：masticate

t: adj. 徒步的； 缺乏想象力的；n. 行人
en: ordinary and uninteresting and without any imagination

ex.en: a painting that is pedestrian and unimaginative
ex.cn: 乏味又缺乏想象力的画作

ex.en: a rather pedestrian student
ex.cn: 一名相当平庸的学生

syn: adj. 徒步的；缺乏想像力的：literal-minded
n. 行人；步行者：passerby, walker
rm: ped(脚) + estrian → 用脚走的人 → 行人

t: n. 到场， 出席； 出勤； 伺候， 照料
en: the number of people who attend a game, concert, meeting etc

ex.en: We have an average attendance of 4,000 fans per game.
ex.cn: 每场比赛平均有4,000名球迷来观战。
