en: the part of a theatre where people sit when watching a play, concert etc

ex.en: Anderson was to sing at the Constitution Hall auditorium.
ex.cn: 安德森将要在宪法厅的观众席演唱。

syn: n. 礼堂，会堂；[建]观众席：assembly hall, assembly room
rm: aud(听) + it + orium(表场所、 地点， 名词后缀) → 听(讲座等)的地方 → 礼堂； 观众席

t: adj. 空白的
en: without any writing, print, or recorded sound

ex.en: Leave the last page blank .
ex.cn: 最后一页留空。

ex.en: a blank cassette
ex.cn: 一盒空白磁带

ph.cn: 预留的空白位置；在空格里，在空白处

syn: adj. [电讯][印刷][计]空白的；空虚的；单调的：flat, vacant
n. [电讯][印刷][计]空白；空虚；空白表格：gap, vacancy
rm: b(看作be， 是) + lank(看作lack， 缺乏) → 缺乏“是什么” → 缺乏内容 → 空白的

t: n. 一场， 一节； 会议； 集会
en: A session is a meeting of a court, legislature, or other official group

ex.en: After two late night sessions, the Security Council has failed to reach agreement.
ex.cn: 开过两次深夜会议之后，安理会仍未能达成协议。

ex.en: The Arab League is meeting in emergency session today.
ex.cn: 阿拉伯国家联盟今天正在举行紧急会议。

ph.cn: 练习课；培训课程；训练项目

syn: n. 会议；（法庭的）[法]开庭；（议会等的）开会；学期；讲习会：meeting, congress, term, sitting, semester
rm: ses(看作see， 看见) + sion → 看见彼此 → 会面 → 会议

t: adj. 附加的； 追加的
en: more than what was agreed or expected

ex.en: Additional information can be obtained from the centre.
ex.cn: 可以从中心获取更多信息。

syn: adj. 附加的，额外的：attached, added, plus, more, excess

t: n. 接收， 接受； 接待， 招待会； 接收效果
en: the act of receiving radio, television, or other signals, or the quality of signals you receive

ex.en: listeners complaining about poor reception
ex.cn: 抱怨接收效果不好的听众

syn: n. 接待；接收；招待会；感受；反应：reaction, response, behavior
rm: re(表加强) + cept(拿， 取) + ion → 拿住 → 接受

t: adv. 整体地， 全盘地

ex.en: This lets us see more of the whole picture, look at problems more holistically, and take corrective action sooner.
ex.cn: 这使得我们可以看到更多的整体画面，更轻松地查看问题，更快地采取适当的行动。

ex.en: Menu items and dialogs, when they are translated, need to be considered holistically. It is important to make sure that translated interfaces remain coherent as a whole.
ex.cn: 在翻译菜单项和对话框时，需要全盘考虑，确保翻译的界面保持整体的一致性很重要。

t: adj. 外面的； 外表的， 表面的
en: relating to how a person or situation seems to be, rather than how it really is

ex.en: The economy and outward appearance of the area have changed considerably.
ex.cn: 该地区的经济和面貌发生了很大的变化。

ex.en: His clenched fist was the only outward sign of his anger.
ex.cn: 他那紧握的拳头是他内心愤怒的唯一外在表现。

syn: adj. 向外的；外面的；公开的；外服的；肉体的：outer, outside, external, material, open
adv. 向外（等于outwards）；在外；显而易见地：forth, out

t: adj. 唯一的，独有的；n. 鞋底， 袜底； 脚底
en: the sole person, thing etc is the only one

ex.en: the sole American in the room
ex.cn: 房间里唯一的美国人

ex.en: Griffiths is the sole survivor of the crash.
ex.cn: 格里菲思是此次撞车事故唯一的幸存者。

ph.cn: n. 总代理商；独家经营商；包销人

syn: n. [服装]鞋底；脚底；基础；鳎目鱼：elements, basis, foundation, base, bed
adj. 唯一的；[法]单独的；仅有的：alone, unique, independent, one, isolated
rm: sol(单独) + e → 唯一的

t: vt. 贬抑， 贬低； 轻蔑， 轻视
en: to criticize someone or something in a way that shows you do not think they are very good or important

ex.en: Matcham’s theatres were widely disparaged by architects.
ex.cn: 马彻姆设计的剧院遭到了建筑师的普遍抨击。

syn: vt. 蔑视；毁谤：hold in scorn, contemn
rm: dis(去掉) + par(平等) + age → 剥夺平等 → 贬抑， 贬低

t: n. 班长；监视器；vt. 监视； 监测
en: a television or part of a computer with a screen, on which you can see pictures or information

ex.en: a heart monitor
ex.cn: 心脏监测仪

ph.cn: 遥控监视器；远距离监控装置

syn: n. [电子][环境]监视器；[通信][军]监听器；[自]监控器；班长：detectophone, invigilator
rm: mon(忠告) + itor → 给你忠告的人 → 班长

t: adj. 物质的； 重要的；n. 材料；素材
en: relating to your money, possessions, living conditions etc, rather than the needs of your mind or soul

ex.en: a society that places high importance on material rewards
ex.cn: 重视物质回报的社会

syn: adj. 重要的；[物]物质的，实质性的；肉体的：crucial, important, considerable, big, major
n. [材]材料，原料；[经]物资；布料：stuff, ingredient

t: v. 重新安置， 搬迁， 迁移
en: if a person or business relocates, or if they are relocated, they move to a different place

ex.en: If the company was to relocate, most employees would move.
ex.cn: 如果公司要迁移，大多数员工得搬家。

syn: vt. 重新安置；迁移：remove, to migrate
rm: re(重新) + loc(摆放) + ate → 重新摆放 → 重新安置， (使)搬迁

t: adv. 近似， 大约

ex.en: In approximately 1925, work began on the problem of suspension .
ex.cn: 大约在1925年才开始了关于悬移质的研究。

ex.en: Can you supply this quality at approximately 50% cents per meter?
ex.cn: 请问你们是否能够提供这种质量的，大约每米50%分？

syn: adv. 大约，近似地；近于：around, something

t: adj. 壮观的；令人惊叹的；n. 壮观的场面； 精彩的表演
en: very impressive

ex.en: a mountainous area with spectacular scenery
ex.cn: 景色壮丽的山区

ex.en: a spectacular success
ex.cn: 辉煌的成就

syn: adj. 壮观的，惊人的；公开展示的：tremendous, incredible

t: v. 熨， 烫平；n. 铁；烙铁，熨斗
en: to make clothes smooth using an iron

ex.en: Have you ironed my shirt?
ex.cn: 我的衬衫你熨过了吗？

syn: n. 熨斗；[服装]烙铁；坚强：sadiron, flatiron
adj. 铁的；残酷的；刚强的：cruel, ferrous

t: n&v. 拥抱
en: to put your arms around someone and hold them tightly to show love or friendship

ex.en: We stood there crying and hugging each other.
ex.cn: 我们站在那里哭着互相拥抱。

ex.en: She went to her daughter and hugged her tightly .
ex.cn: 她走到女儿身边，紧紧地拥抱她。

ph.cn: 粗鲁或紧紧得拥抱；[摔跤]熊抱；[金融]接管策略

syn: vt. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有，坚持：press, stay, embrace, tough
vi. 拥抱；紧抱在一起；挤在一起：embrace, cuddle

t: n. 总统， 校长， 会长， 主席
en: the official leader of a country that does not have a king or queen

ex.en: President Bush
ex.cn: 布什总统

syn: n. 总统；董事长；校长：principal, prez

t: vi. 哼曲子； 发嗡嗡声；n. 嗡嗡声，嘈杂声
en: to sing a tune by making a continuous sound with your lips closed

ex.en: He began to hum a tune.
ex.cn: 他开始哼唱一支曲子。

syn: n. 嗡嗡声；哼声；杂声：groaning, zoom
int. 哼；嗯：uh-uh, um
rm: “哼” → 蚊子、 苍蝇的哼哼声

t: n. 假装； 模拟
en: the activity of producing conditions which are similar to real ones, especially in order to test something, or the conditions that are produced

ex.en: a computer simulation used to train airline pilots
ex.cn: 用于训练航空公司飞行员的电脑模拟程序

syn: n. [计]仿真；模拟；模仿；假装：acting, emulation, analog

t: adj. 喜欢冒险的， 敢作敢为的； 充满危险和刺激的， 惊险的
en: eager to go to new places and do exciting or dangerous things

ex.en: Warren was an adventurous businessman.
ex.cn: 沃伦是一位有冒险精神的商人。

syn: adj. 爱冒险的；大胆的；充满危险的：bold, stouthearted

t: adj. 消化的； 和消化有关的
en: connected with the process of digestion

ex.en: ...digestive juices that normally work on breaking down our food.
ex.cn: …通常用于分解食物的消化液。

syn: n. 助消化药：pepsine, bromo
rm: di(分开) + gest(搬运) + ive → 消化的

t: n. 肌腱； 力量的来源
en: a part of your body that connects a muscle to a bone

ex.en: The sinews on his neck stood out like knotted string.
ex.cn: 他颈部的肌腱像打结的绳般凸出。

syn: n. 筋；肌腱；体力；精力：main, steam, vigor
vt. 加强；使牢固：enhance, cement, muscle, firm, build up

t: adj. 表面的； 肤浅的
en: not studying or looking at something carefully and only seeing the most noticeable things

ex.en: They only have the most superficial understanding of prison life.
ex.cn: 他们对监狱生活只有最粗浅的了解。

syn: adj. 表面的；肤浅的：surface, external, facial, shallow
n. 表面文章；外表；浅薄的人：person, garment
rm: super(在…上面) + fic(做) ＋ ial → 做表面文章 → 表面的

t: n. 药片
en: a small round hard piece of medicine which you swallow

ex.en: She took a couple of headache tablets .
ex.cn: 她吃了几片头痛药。

syn: n. 碑；[药]药片；写字板；小块：wordpad, nubble

t: v. 融化； 消散
en: if something solid melts or if heat melts it, it becomes liquid

ex.en: It was warmer now, and the snow was beginning to melt.
ex.cn: 现在天气暖和了，雪开始融化。

ex.en: Melt the butter in a saucepan.
ex.cn: 把黄油放在深平底锅里化开。

ph.cn: 溶解成；消散在…中；因心软而…

syn: vi. 熔化，[化学]溶解；渐混：flux, fuse
vt. 使融化；使熔化；使软化；使感动：oil, soften up

t: v. 钩住， 挂住； 钓；n. 钩，吊钩，钩状物
en: to catch a fish with a hook

ex.en: I hooked a 20-pound salmon last week.
ex.cn: 我上周钓到一条20磅重的鲑鱼。

syn: n. 挂钩，[机]吊钩：towing eye, drawhook
vt. 钩住；[口腔]引上钩：hitch
rm: 书(book)在手， 月如钩(hook)

t: n. 拆除； 破坏， 毁坏
en: The demolition of a structure, for example, a building, is the act of deliberately destroying it, often in order to build something else in its place

ex.en: The project required the total demolition of the old bridge.
ex.cn: 这项工程要求那座旧桥的彻底拆除。

syn: n. 拆除（等于demolishment）；破坏；毁坏：destruction, breaking, blasting

t: n. 高地， 高原
en: relatively high ground

ex.en: There something undeniably soulful about the eerie whine of the highland bagpipes.
ex.cn: 高原风笛神秘的哀鸣有着让人无法抗拒的深情。

ex.en: After upholding to scold the folded wife, a second-hand husband moulds the threshold in shorthand on the highland.
ex.cn: 在赞成责骂被折叠的妻子之后，二手丈夫在高地以速记法铸成了一个门槛。

syn: n. [地理]高地；丘陵地带：height, raise, altitude, elevation, rise
adj. 高原的；[地理]高地的：upland
rm: high(高处) + land(陆地) → 高地， 高原

t: n. 伤亡， 伤亡者； 损失的东西； 伤亡事故
en: someone who is hurt or killed in an accident or war

ex.en: Our aim is to reduce road casualties .
ex.cn: 我们的目标是减少交通事故的伤亡人数。

ph.cn: 灾害保险；不幸事故保险

syn: n. 意外事故；伤亡人员；急诊室：contretemps, fortuity
rm: cas(掉落) ＋ ual + ty(表物) → 掉落下来； 造成事故 → 伤亡(人员)； 伤亡事故

t: n. 测量仪表；规格，标准；计量器；vt. 测量， 度量
en: an instrument for measuring the size or amount of something

ex.en: a 27-gauge needle
ex.cn: 一根27号针

syn: n. 计量器；标准尺寸；容量规格：batcher, measuring chamber
vt. 测量；估计；给…定规格：sound, scale, estimate
rm: “规矩” → 规格

t: adj. 无情的， 狠心的； 无生气的， 没精打采的
en: cruel and not feeling any pity

ex.en: How can you be so heartless?
ex.cn: 你怎么能如此无情呢？

syn: adj. 无情的；无勇气的：relentless, ruthless

t: n. 腰带； 地带
en: a band of leather, cloth etc that you wear around your waist to hold up your clothes or for decoration

ex.en: He unbuckled his leather belt.
ex.cn: 他解开皮带。

ph.cn: 皮带运输机，带式运输机

syn: n. 带；腰带；地带：band, strip, zone, terrain, tract
vi. 猛击：drive, jab at

t: n. 捏造， 伪造； 制作； 构成
en: the process of making or producing something

ex.en: For a manufacturer, these will be materials used in the fabrication of the products.
ex.cn: 对于制造商来说，这些成本是产品制造中使用的原材料成本。

syn: n. 制造，建造；装配；伪造物：assembly, manufacture, machining, make, fishing

t: adj. 好学的， 学习勤勉的； 专心的； 谨慎的， 认真的， 仔细的
en: spending a lot of time studying and reading

ex.en: a quiet, studious young man
ex.cn: 一个文静好学的年轻人

syn: adj. 用功的；热心的；专心的；故意的；适于学习的：focused, eager, designed, intended, conscious
rm: 来自 study(n./v. 学习)

t: adj. 敏感的， 灵敏的； 神经过敏的， 容易生气的； 易受伤害的
en: easily upset or offended by events or things that people say

ex.en: a very sensitive child
ex.cn: 一个很敏感的小孩

syn: adj. [仪]敏感的；灵敏的；感光的；易受伤害的：vulnerable, subtle, quick
rm: sens(感觉) + itive → 敏感的

t: adj. 未占用的， 空的
en: a vacant seat, building, room or piece of land is empty and available for someone to use

ex.en: Only a few apartments were still vacant.
ex.cn: 只有几套公寓仍然空着。

ex.en: There was only a vacant lot (= empty unused area of land in a city ) where her house used to be.
ex.cn: 她以前房子所在的地方只剩下一块空地了。

syn: adj. 空虚的；空的；空缺的；空闲的；茫然的：available, empty, blank, leisure, hollow
rm: vac(空) + ant(形容词后缀) → 未占用的

t: v. 负担得起
en: to have enough money to buy or pay for something

ex.en: I couldn’t afford the rent on my own.
ex.cn: 我单靠自己付不起房租。

ex.en: How can she afford to eat out every night?
ex.cn: 每天晚上下馆子她怎么能负担得起？

syn: vt. 给予，提供；买得起：allow, deal, extend, deliver, tender
rm: af + ford(看作Ford， 美国大财阀福特家族) → 财大气粗 → 负担得起

t: adv. 在地下；adj. 地下的；n. 地铁[ˌʌndə'graund]
en: under the earth’s surface

ex.en: This animal spends most of its life underground.
ex.cn: 这种动物一生中的大部分时间都待在地下。

ex.en: nuclear waste buried deep underground
ex.cn: 深埋在地下的核废物

syn: adv. 在地下；秘密地：quietly, privately, secretly
adj. 地下的；秘密的；先锋派的：secret, chamber, inside, cabinet
rm: under(在…下) + ground(地面， 土地) → 地下的； 在地(面)下

t: n. 勘探者， 探险者
en: someone who travels through an unknown area to find out about it

ex.en: ...the travels of Columbus, Magellan, and many other explorers.
ex.cn: …哥伦布、麦哲伦和许多其他探险家的旅行。

ph.cn: 因特网浏览器；微软网页浏览器
[计]解决方案资源管理器（设计数据库所用软件的菜单选项）
服务器资源管理器；服务器总管

syn: n. 探险家；探测者，探测器：finder, prober
rm: 来自explore(v. 探险， 探索)

t: adj. 生物的； 生物学的， 有关生物学的
en: relating to the natural processes performed by living things

ex.en: the biological functions of the body
ex.cn: 人体的生物机能

ex.en: Depression is both biological and psychological.
ex.cn: 抑郁症与生理和心理都有关系。

syn: adj. [生物]生物的；生物学的：biotic, organismal

t: n. 印象， 感想； 印记， 压痕
en: the opinion or feeling you have about someone or something because of the way they seem

ex.en: When we looked around the school we got a very good impression.
ex.cn: 我们参观了学校，对它的印象很好。

ex.en: I got the impression that she wasn’t very happy with her job.
ex.cn: 我有这样的印象，她的工作干得并不愉快。

syn: n. 印象；效果，影响；压痕，印记；感想：infection, effect, influence, affection, print
rm: impress(印， 盖印) + ion → 印象； 印记

t: vt. 阻碍， 妨碍
en: to make it difficult for someone or something to move forward or make progress

ex.en: Storms at sea impeded our progress.
ex.cn: 海上风暴阻碍了我们的航程。

syn: vt. 阻碍；妨碍；阻止：dispute, let, stem, slow
rm: im + ped(脚) + e → 用脚绊倒 → 阻碍， 妨碍

t: vt. 虐待
en: to treat a person or animal cruelly

ex.en: The hostages said they were hungry but had not been maltreated.
ex.cn: 人质说他们挨了饿，但没有受到虐待。

syn: vt. 虐待；滥用；粗暴对待：abuse, rough, strain
rm: mal(坏) + treat(=tract拉) → 往坏处拉 → 虐待

t: n. 〈总称〉 机械； 机构
en: You can use machinery to refer to machines in general, or machines that are used in a factory or on a farm

ex.en: ...quality tools and machinery.
ex.cn: …优质工具和机械。

syn: n. 机械；[机]机器；机构；机械装置：organization, mechanism, house
rm: machin(机械) + ery → 机械

t: n. 推论； 推断
en: something that you think is true, based on information that you have

ex.en: There were two inferences to be drawn from her letter.
ex.cn: 从她的来信可以得到两种推论。

syn: n. 推理；推论；[数]推断：conclusion, reasoning, consequence
rm: 从这些参考书(reference)里， 你能推断(inference)出什么？

t: n. 解剖； 解剖结构
en: the scientific study of the structure of human or animal bodies

ex.en: a professor of anatomy
ex.cn: 解剖学教授

ph.cn: 解剖生理学；解剖学与生理学

syn: n. [解剖]解剖；解剖学；剖析；骨骼：cadre, dissection
rm: ana(分开) + tomy(切) → 切开机体组织 → 解剖(学)

t: v. 交付， 递送； 发表， 表达； 释放； 接生
en: to take goods, letters, packages etc to a particular place or person

ex.en: The morning mail has just been delivered.
ex.cn: 早晨的邮件刚送到。

ex.en: Do you deliver on Saturdays?
ex.cn: 星期六你们送货吗？

syn: vt. 交付；发表；递送；释放；给予（打击）；给…接生：afford, allow, extend, deal, free
vi. 实现；传送；履行；投递：come true, come to pass
rm: de(使…) + liver(=liber 自由) → 使自由 → 递送； 释放

t: n. 现象， 迹象； 非凡的人
en: something that happens or exists in society, science, or nature, especially something that is studied because it is difficult to understand

ex.en: Homelessness is not a new phenomenon .
ex.cn: 无家可归已不是什么新现象。

syn: n. [物]现象；奇迹；杰出的人才：wonder, miracle
rm: phen(出现) + omen(预兆) + on → 出现预兆的 → 迹象

t: n. 牵挂， 惦念； 迷住， 困扰； 萦绕于心的事物或人； 固执的念头
en: If you say that someone has an obsession with a person or thing, you think they are spending too much time thinking about them

ex.en: She would try to forget her obsession with Christopher.
ex.cn: 她会试图忘掉她对克里斯托弗的迷恋。

syn: n. 痴迷；困扰；[内科][心理]强迫观念：besetment, obsessive idea
rm: ob(逆) + sess(=sit坐) + ion → 坐立不安 → 困扰

t: vt. 通知， 报告
en: to formally or officially tell someone about something

ex.en: The skipper notified the coastguard of the tragedy.
ex.cn: 船长通知了海岸警卫队这一灾难。

syn: vt. 通告，通知；公布：message, post, publish
rm: not(知道) + ify(使…) → 使人知道 → 通知， 报告

t: n. 金属烤肉架； 烧烤野餐
en: a meal or party during which food is cooked on a metal frame over a fire and eaten outdoors

ex.en: We had a barbecue on the beach.
ex.cn: 我们在海滩上烧烤。

ph.cn: 烤肉调味酱；在全烧时涂抹烤物用的沙司；烧烤鱼或肉时所用调味液

syn: n. 烤肉；吃烤肉的野宴：bulgogi, bar-b-q
rm: barb(条， 棒) + ecue → 用木条支撑着进行烧烤 → 烧烤野餐

t: n. 参考书目； 书目； 文献学
en: a list of all the books and articles used in preparing a piece of writing

ex.en: At the end of this chapter there is a select bibliography of useful books.
ex.cn: 本章末尾附着有用书籍的精选书目。

syn: n. 参考书目；[图情]文献目录：reference, reading list
rm: bibl(书) + io + graph(写) + y → 写作中用的书 → 参考书目

t: n. 就职； 归纳； 感应
en: the production of electricity in one object by another that already has electrical or magnetic power

ex.en: Mrs Simpson is responsible for the induction of new library staff.
ex.cn: 辛普森太太负责图书馆新职员的入职培训。

ph.cn: 感应电动机；异步电动机

syn: n. [电磁]感应；[数]归纳法；感应现象：reaction, inductive method
rm: induct(就任； 归纳； 感应) + ion → 就职； 归纳； 感应

t: adj. 多脂的； 油滑的
en: covered in grease or oil

ex.en: a shampoo for greasy hair
ex.cn: 适用于油性发质的洗发液

ex.en: The food was heavy and greasy.
ex.cn: 这食物油腻难消化。

ph.cn: 低级小饭馆；经济小吃店

syn: adj. 油腻的；含脂肪多的；谄媚的：fat, pinguid
rm: greas(e)(油脂) + y → 多脂的

t: vt. 信任， 相信， 委任， 授权； 把…归于
syn: vt. 授权；信任；委派；归因于：credit, empower
rm: ac + credit(相信) → 信任， 相信

t: v. 不赞成， 反对
en: to think that someone or their behaviour, ideas etc are bad or wrong

ex.en: I knew my parents would disapprove, but I went anyway.
ex.cn: 我知道父母会反对，但我还是去了。

ex.en: Her family strongly disapproved of her behaviour.
ex.cn: 她的家人极不赞同她的行为。

syn: vt. 不赞成；不同意：take a dim view of, disagree with
vi. 不赞成；不喜欢：take a dim view of, have a dislike of
rm: dis(不) + approve(赞成) → 不赞成

t: vt. 养育， 滋养； 培养
en: to give a person or other living thing the food and other substances they need in order to live, grow, and stay healthy

ex.en: The cream contains vitamin A to nourish the skin.
ex.cn: 这种护肤霜含有滋养肌肤的维生素A。

ex.en: a well nourished baby
ex.cn: 营养良好的婴儿

syn: vt. 滋养；怀有；使健壮：harbor

t: v. 打；折磨；n. 罢工
en: to hit or fall against the surface of something

ex.en: She fell heavily, striking her head against the side of the boat.
ex.cn: 她重重地摔倒，头撞在船舷上。

ex.en: A snowball struck him on the back of the head.
ex.cn: 一个雪球打中了他的后脑勺。

syn: vi. 打，打击；[劳经]罢工；敲，敲击；抓；打动；穿透：grasp, beat upon
vt. 打，击；[劳经]罢工；撞击，冲击；侵袭；打动；到达：impact, beat upon

t: adj. 被弄弯的，弯曲的；n. 爱好， 天赋
en: no longer straight

ex.en: a bent nail
ex.cn: 弯曲的钉子

ex.en: Stand with your knees slightly bent.
ex.cn: 双膝微曲站立。

syn: n. 爱好，嗜好：weakness, interest, habit, like, appetite
adj. 弯曲的；决心的：curve, winding, flexural, crooked

t: vt. 断言， 宣称
en: to say that something is true or that someone has done something wrong, although it has not been proved

ex.en: She alleged that there was rampant drug use among the male members of the group.
ex.cn: 她指称该组织中有大量的男性成员吸毒。

syn: vt. 宣称，断言；提出…作为理由：declare, asseverate
rm: al(向) + leg(送) + e → 用力向某人寄送 → 断言， 宣称

t: adj. 明确的； 肯定的； 积极的
en: good or useful

ex.en: At least something positive has come out of the situation.
ex.cn: 至少这个情况也产生了一些积极的东西。

ex.en: Write down all the positive things about your life.
ex.cn: 记下生活中所有好的事情。

syn: adj. [电]积极的；[摄][物][数]正的，[化学][医]阳性的；确定的，肯定的；实际的，真实的；绝对的：active, established, practical, actual, fixed, effective, sincere
rm: pos(放) + it + ive(形容词后缀) → 放正心态的 → 积极的

t: vt. 引发，
en: to make something happen very quickly, especially a series of events

ex.en: The assassination triggered off a wave of rioting.
ex.cn: 这次暗杀事件引发了一阵骚乱。

ex.en: Certain forms of mental illness can be triggered by food allergies.
ex.cn: 某些精神疾病可能由食物过敏引发。

syn: vt. [物化]引发，引起；[电子]触发：attract, produce, cause, operate, occasion
n. [军]扳机；[电子]触发器；制滑机：flip-flopper
rm: 扣动扳机(trigger)射杀了一只老虎(tiger)

t: adj. 特别喜欢的，宠爱的；n. 特别喜欢的人或物； 亲信
en: your favourite person or thing is the one that you like the most

ex.en: a child’s favourite toy
ex.cn: 孩子最喜欢的玩具

ex.en: What’s your favourite colour?
ex.cn: 你最喜欢什么颜色？

t: vt. 隔离， 分开
en: to separate one group of people from others, especially because they are of a different race, sex, or religion

ex.en: A large detachment of police was used to segregate the two rival camps of protesters.
ex.cn: 一大队分遣警察被派来隔离两群敌对的抗议者。

syn: vt. 使隔离；[生物]使分离；在…实行种族隔离：separate, split, divorce
rm: se(分离) + greg(人群) + ate → 使脱离人群 → 隔离， (使)分开

t: adj. 租用的； 出租的；n. 租金额；出租，租赁
en: You use rental to describe things that are connected with the renting out of goods, properties, and services

ex.en: A friend drove her to Atlanta, where she picked up a rental car.
ex.cn: 一个朋友开车送她去了亚特兰大，在那里她租到了一辆车。

syn: n. 租金收入，租金；租赁：letting, leasing
adj. 租赁的；收取租金的：leasehold

t: 胡乱地；随便地；任意地
syn: undefined. 胡乱地；随便地；任意地：at a venture, at hazard

t: v. 旋转， 转动； 轮流， 轮换
en: to turn with a circular movement around a central point, or to make something do this

ex.en: The Earth rotates on its axis once every 24 hours.
ex.cn: 地球每24小时绕地轴自转一周。

ex.en: Rotate the pan halfway through the baking time.
ex.cn: 烘烤到一半时把盘子转一下。

syn: vi. 旋转；循环：wheel, circle, spin
vt. 使旋转；使转动；使轮流：turn, spin, swing
rm: rot(旋转) + ate(使…) → (使)旋转， 转动

t: adv. 几乎， 简直； 实际上
en: Practically means almost, but not completely or exactly

ex.en: He'd known the old man practically all his life.
ex.cn: 他几乎从小就认识那位老人。

syn: adv. 实际地；几乎；事实上：almost, nearly, actually, really, most

t: n. 遗传； 继承， 继承物； 遗产， 遗赠
en: money, property etc that you receive from someone who has died

ex.en: Lucinda has to fight for her life and her inheritance in this gripping novel.
ex.cn: 在这部扣人心弦的小说里，露辛达不得不为自己的生命与所继承的遗产进行抗争。

ph.cn: 继承层次；继承体系；继承阶层架构

syn: n. [法]继承；[遗]遗传；遗产：heritage, legacy

t: v. 非常激动； 发抖

ex.en: His music continues to thrill audiences.
ex.cn: 他的音乐依然能扣人心弦。

syn: n. 激动；[医]震颤；紧张：intensity, stress, tension, warmth, excitation
vt. 使…颤动；使…紧张；使…感到兴奋或激动：tie oneself up in knots

t: adj. 短期的
en: continuing for only a short time, or relating only to the period that is not very far into the future

ex.en: The treatment may bring short-term benefits to AIDS sufferers.
ex.cn: 这种疗法对艾滋病患者可能会有短期效果。

ex.en: Most of the staff are on short-term contracts.
ex.cn: 大部分职员签的都是短期合同。

rm: short(短的) + term(期间) → 短期的

t: n. 爬行动物， 爬虫类； 卑鄙的人
en: a type of animal, such as a snake or  lizard  , whose body temperature changes according to the temperature around it, and that usually lays eggs to have babies
syn: adj. 爬虫类的；卑鄙的：poor, mean, base, dirty
n. [脊椎]爬行动物；卑鄙的人：insect, ratfink
rm: rept(爬) + ile → 爬行动物

t: n. 盒式录音带
en: a small flat plastic case containing  magnetic tape  , that can be used for playing or recording sound

ex.en: His two albums released on cassette have sold 10 million copies.
ex.cn: 他以磁带形式发行的两张专辑已售出1000万份。

ph.cn: 录音带放音机；卡式录音机

t: v. 震惊
en: to make someone very surprised or shocked

ex.en: The judge’s decision astounded everyone.
ex.cn: 法官的判决使大家感到震惊。

syn: vt. 使惊骇；使震惊：shock, appall
rm: as + tound(看作sound， 声音) → 像被奇怪的声音吓倒 → 震惊

t: n. 刀片； 桨叶； 叶片
en: the flat wide part of an object that pushes against air or water

ex.en: the blade of an oar
ex.cn: 桨叶

syn: n. [植][脊椎]叶片；[机]刀片，刀锋；剑：sword, vane
rm: 热门电影《刀锋战士》英文为Blade

t: n. 解答， 解决办法； 溶解， 溶液
en: a way of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation

ex.en: The best solution would be for them to separate.
ex.cn: 最好的解决方法是他们分开。

ph.cn: 在不断变化中；动摇不定；在溶解状态中

syn: n. 解决方案；溶液；[化学]溶解；解答：liquor, dissolution

t: vi. 分开， 岔开； 分歧， 相异； 偏离， 违背
en: if opinions, interests etc diverge, they are different from each other

ex.en: The two species diverged millions of years ago.
ex.cn: 这两个物种从数百万年前开始朝不同方向演变。

syn: vi. 分歧；偏离；分叉；离题：stray from, deviate from
vt. 使偏离；使分叉：deviate
rm: di(分离) + verg(转) + e → 分别转换方向 → 分开， 岔开； 分歧

t: adj. 对立的， 对抗的；n. 敌手，对手；反对者
en: someone who you try to defeat in a competition, game, fight, or argument

ex.en: Graf’s opponent in today’s final will be Sukova.
ex.cn: 格拉芙今天的决赛对手将是苏科娃。

ex.en: He is admired even by his political opponents.
ex.cn: 他甚至受到政敌的钦佩。

syn: n. 对手；反对者；敌手：equal, anti, comparative, rival, match
adj. 对立的；敌对的：contrary, adverse, against
rm: op(反) + pon(放) + ent → 处于对立面的 → 对手， 敌手； 对立的， 对抗的

t: v. 主办； 招待；n. 主人；东道主；主办方；大量，许多
en: to provide the place and everything that is needed for an organized event

ex.en: Which country is going to host the next World Cup?
ex.cn: 哪个国家将主办下一届世界杯？

ph.cn: n. 主办城市；举办城市

syn: n. [计]主机；主人；主持人；许多：lots of, sea, hundred, master, thousands of
vt. 主持；当主人招待：to chair, preside over

t: adj. 增补的， 补充的
en: provided in addition to what already exists

ex.en: supplementary information
ex.cn: 补充信息

syn: adj. 补充的；追加的：complementary, adscititious
n. 补充者；增补物：enlargement
rm: sup(在下面) + ple(填满) + ment + ary → 在下面填满的 → 增补的， 补充的

t: v. 加速； 促进
en: if a process accelerates or if something accelerates it, it happens faster than usual or sooner than you expect

ex.en: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
ex.cn: 加快经济增长速度的措施

syn: vi. 加速；促进；增加：improve, increase speed
rm: ac(=to) + celer(快速的) + ate(使…) → 加速； 促进

t: adv. 不顾后果地； 无论如何
en: without being affected or influenced by something

ex.en: Despite her recent surgery she has been carrying on regardless.
ex.cn: 尽管她最近动了手术，她却一直在不顾一切地继续工作。

syn: adj. 不管；不顾；不注意：irregardless
rm: regard(关心) + less(少) → 很少关心 → 不顾后果地

t: v. 猛撞； 闯；n. 驳船
en: If you barge into a place or barge through it, you rush or push into it in a rough and rude way

ex.en: Students tried to barge into the secretariat buildings.
ex.cn: 学生们试图闯进秘书处大楼。

syn: vi. 蹒跚；闯入：titubate, burst into
n. [船]驳船；游艇：lighter, catamaran
rm: “八只” → 八只驳船 → 驳船

t: n. 气象学
en: the scientific study of weather conditions

ex.en: For example geography, meteorology, physics and history.
ex.cn: 例如地理学，气象学，物理（学）和历史。

ex.en: Modern weather forecasts try to take the mystery out of the meteorology.
ex.cn: 现代天气预报试图揭开气象学的神秘面纱。

syn: n. 气象状态，[气象]气象学：aerography, meteorological optics
rm: meteor(陨石； 天气) + ology(…学) → 研究天气的学科 → 气象学

t: v. 说明， 举例说明， 阐明； 给…作插图说明
en: to make the meaning of something clearer by giving examples

ex.en: Let me give an example to illustrate the point.
ex.cn: 让我举个例子来说明这一点。

ex.en: She illustrated her discussion with diagrams.
ex.cn: 她用图表来说明她的论述。

syn: vt. 阐明，举例说明；图解：clarify, elucidate
vi. 举例：give an example, cite an example
rm: il(向内) + lus(光) + tr + ate → 向内投入光 → 阐明

t: v. 专门研究， 专攻； 专用于， 使适应特殊目的

ph.cn: 专门从事，专门研究；专门经营

syn: vi. 专门研究（等于specialize）：to specialize in
vt. 使专门化；限定…的范围；深入（等于specialize）：technicalize
rm: 来自special(a. 特殊的， 专门的)

t: vi. 发生； 存在
en: to happen

ex.en: A third of accidental deaths occur in the home.
ex.cn: 有三分之一的意外死亡发生在家里。

ex.en: The explosion occurred at 5.30 a.m.
ex.cn: 爆炸发生在清晨5点30分。

syn: vi. 发生；出现；存在：happen, exist, proceed, figure, offer
rm: oc(向) + cur(跑) → 跑向 → 发生

t: n. 声名狼藉， 臭名昭著
en: the state of being famous or well-known for something that is bad or that people do not approve of

ex.en: He achieved notoriety as chief counsel to President Nixon in the Watergate break-in.
ex.cn: 在水门事件中，他作为尼克松总统的首席辩护律师被搞得声名狼藉。

rm: not(知道) + oriety(多) → 坏事人所共知 → 臭名昭著

t: n. 软管；vt. 用软管淋
en: a long rubber or plastic tube that can be moved and bent to put water onto fires, gardens etc

ex.en: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
ex.cn: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管吸走。

ph.cn: 金属软管；柔性管；金属蛇形管

syn: n. [橡胶]软管；长统袜；男性穿的紧身裤：flexible pipe, flexible conduit
vt. 用软管浇水；痛打：light into, belabour
rm: 要想玫瑰花(rose)开， 需把软管(hose)拿来浇水

t: n. 微风， 和风
en: a gentle wind

ex.en: flowers waving in the breeze
ex.cn: 在微风中摇曳的花儿

syn: n. [气象]微风；轻而易举的事；煤屑；焦炭渣；小风波：breath, doddle
vi. [气象]吹微风；逃走：tail out, pull foot
rm: 和风(breeze)吹化了冰冻的(freeze)河流

t: n. 验尸，尸体解剖
en: an examination of a dead body to discover why the person died

ex.en: A postmortem was carried out to establish the cause of death.
ex.cn: 进行了尸检以确定死因。

syn: n. [特医]验尸：autopsy, necroscopy

t: adj. 方便的， 便利的； 适宜的
en: useful to you because it saves you time, or does not spoil your plans or cause you problems

ex.en: Mail-order catalogs are a convenient way to shop.
ex.cn: 使用邮购目录是一种方便的购物方式。

ex.en: My secretary will call you to arrange a convenient time to meet.
ex.cn: 我的秘书会打电话给你安排一个方便的时间见面。

syn: adj. 方便的：commodious, expedient
rm: “肯为你的” → 肯为你提供方便的 → 方便的

t: v. 推断， 猜想
en: to form an opinion that something is probably true because of information that you have

ex.en: I inferred from what she said that you have not been well.
ex.cn: 我从她的话里推断出你身体一直不大好。

syn: vt. 推断；推论：understand, conclude, reason
vi. 推断；作出推论：conclude, deduce from
rm: in(进入) + fer(带来) → 带进(意义) → 推断， 猜想

t: n. 专家； 专科医生
en: someone who knows a lot about a particular subject, or is very skilled at it

ex.en: a heart specialist
ex.cn: 心脏专科医生

syn: n. 专家；专门医师：expert, mavin
adj. 专家的；专业的：professional
rm: special(专门的) + ist(从事某职业的人) → 专家

t: n. 班子， 团， 队； 马戏团， 芭蕾舞团
en: a group of singers, actors, dancers etc who work together

ex.en: ...troupes of travelling actors.
ex.cn: …巡回演出的演员剧团。

syn: n. 剧团；一班；一团：gout, wodge
vi. 巡回演出：road show
rm: 部队(troop)里的一群(group)人组建了一个剧团(troupe)

t: v. 通过， 经过； 中转；n. 运输，运载
en: the process of moving goods or people from one place to another

ex.en: baggage that is lost or damaged in transit
ex.cn: 在运输过程中丢失或损坏的行李

ex.en: transit by air or sea
ex.cn: 空运或海运

en: to recognize and understand the difference between two or more things or people

ex.en: The light was too dim for me to distinguish anything clearly.
ex.cn: 光线太暗，我什么也看不清。

syn: vt. 区分；辨别；使杰出，使表现突出：tell apart, differentiate
vi. 区别，区分；辨别：differentiate, tell from
rm: di(分开) + sting(刺) + uish → 将刺挑出来 → 区别， 辨别

t: v. 喷射， 溅洒；n. 浪花；喷雾；飞沫
en: to force liquid out of a container so that it comes out in a stream of very small drops and covers an area

ex.en: A sprayer hooked to a tractor can spray five gallons onto ten acres.
ex.cn: 挂在拖拉机上的喷雾器用五加仑液量能喷洒十英亩地。

syn: n. [药]喷雾；喷雾器；水沫：foam, atomizer
vt. 喷射：eject, sparge
rm: sp(音似： 四泼) + ray(光线) → 光线向四面射去 → 喷射

t: adj. 不满意的， 不满足的
en: not satisfied because something is not as good as you had expected

ex.en: dissatisfied clients
ex.cn: 感到不满意的客户

syn: adj. 不满意的；不高兴的；流露不满的：unsatisfied, joyless

t: n. 意图， 目的
en: a plan or desire to do something

ex.en: They went into town with the intention of visiting the library.
ex.cn: 他们进了城，打算参观图书馆。

syn: n. 意图；目的；意向；愈合：goals, purpose, sake, meaning, will
rm: in(向内) + tent(伸展) + ion → 向内伸展 → 意图， 目的

t: adj. 粗鲁的； 粗糙的
en: speaking or behaving in a way that is not polite and is likely to offend or annoy people

ex.en: a rude remark
ex.cn: 粗鲁的话

ex.en: I didn’t mean to be rude, but I had to leave early.
ex.cn: 我并不想显得无礼，但我不得不早走。

syn: adj. 粗鲁的；无礼的；狂暴的；未开化的：angry, robust, crude
rm: rud(天然的) + e → 粗鲁的； 粗糙的

t: adj. 热情的； 热心的
en: feeling or showing a lot of interest and excitement about something

ex.en: an enthusiastic supporter of reform
ex.cn: 改革的热心支持者

syn: adj. 热情的；热心的；狂热的：intense, warm, crazy, eager, tropical
rm: enthusias(=enthusiasm 热情， 热心) + tic → 热情的

t: n. 症状； 征候， 征兆
en: something wrong with your body or mind which shows that you have a particular illness

ex.en: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
ex.cn: 精神分裂症最常见的症状之一是幻听。

syn: n. [临床]症状；征兆：premonitor, prefiguration
rm: sym(一起) + pto(掉下) + m → 一起掉下来的 → 症状； 征候

t: adv. 因此， 从而
en: with the result that something else happens

ex.en: Our bodies can sweat, thereby losing heat by evaporation.
ex.cn: 我们的身体会流汗，由此能通过蒸发散热。

syn: adv. 从而，因此；在那附近；在那方面：hence, accordingly, thus, consequently, as a result of

t: adj. 损失惨重的， 灾难性的； 极坏的
en: very bad, or ending in failure

ex.en: a disastrous first marriage
ex.cn: 以失败告终的第一次婚姻

ex.en: The move proved disastrous (= was disastrous ) for the company.
ex.cn: 这一行动对公司来说是一场灾难。

syn: adj. 灾难性的；损失惨重的；悲伤的：sinister, sorrowful
rm: dis(分离) + astr(o) (星星) + ous(形容词后缀) → 古人认为星位发生偏离就预示有灾难发生 → 灾难性的

t: 有预谋的犯罪
prep. 除…外；vt. 将…除外
en: to not include something

ex.en: They were all there except me.
ex.cn: 除了我以外他们都在那里。

syn: vi. 反对：object, sit down on, to oppose
prep. 除…之外：unless, besides, in addition to
rm: ex(出) + cept(拿， 抓) → 不拿 → 将…除外

t: n. 冲动， 突如其来的念头； 刺激， 驱使； 脉冲
en: a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking about whether it is a sensible thing to do

ex.en: The eye converts light signals to nerve impulses.
ex.cn: 眼睛把光信号转变成神经冲动。

ph.cn: 一时冲动，一时心血来潮

syn: n. [心理]冲动；[电子]脉冲；刺激；神经冲动；推动力：stimulus, pulse, incentive, excitement, needle
vt. 推动：drive, force, impel
rm: im(使…) + puls(推) + e → 冲动

t: vt. 宠爱，
en: to give someone as much care and attention as you can, especially too much

ex.en: He cosseted her with flowers and champagne.
ex.cn: 他用鲜花和香槟向她大献殷勤。

syn: vt. 宠爱；溺爱；纵容：pet, baby
n. 宠儿；爱畜；供玩赏的小动物：a favourite son, blue-eyed boy
rm: cos(看作cost， 花费) + set(固定) → 每天固定花一大笔钱为某人买礼物 → 宠爱， 溺爱

t: adj. 可以理解的， 能懂的； 可同情的
en: understandable behaviour, reactions etc seem normal and reasonable because of the situation you are in

ex.en: It is understandable that parents are angry, and looking for someone to blame.
ex.cn: 父母生气了想找个人出气，这是可以理解的。

ex.en: He just can’t face anyone at the moment, which is perfectly understandable.
ex.cn: 他现在就是无法面对任何人，这完全可以理解。

syn: adj. 可以理解的；可以了解的：scrutable

t: v. 结晶； 变明确
en: if a liquid crystallizes, it forms  crystals

ex.en: The liquid will crystallize at 50 degrees centigrade.
ex.cn: 这种液体在50摄氏度时结晶。

syn: vt. 使结晶；明确；使具体化；做成蜜饯：embody, nail down
vi. 结晶，形成结晶；明确；具体化：grain formation, nail down

t: v. 同时发生； 意见相同， 一致
en: to agree with someone or have the same opinion as them

ex.en: Local feeling does not necessarily concur with the press.
ex.cn: 当地人的看法不一定和媒体一致。

syn: vi. 同意；一致；互助：accept, grant, identify, square
rm: con(共同) + cur(跑) → 一起跑 → 一致

t: adv. 仍然；然而；conj. 然而， 不过
en: in spite of a fact that you have just mentioned

ex.en: What you said was true. It was, nevertheless, a little unkind.
ex.cn: 你说的都是实话，只不过有点刻薄。

syn: adv. 然而，不过；虽然如此：though, natheless
conj. 然而，不过：whereas, however, while, but, yet

t: adj. 突出的； 著名的； 显著的
en: important

ex.en: a prominent Russian scientist
ex.cn: 杰出的俄罗斯科学家

ex.en: The World Cup will have a prominent place on the agenda.
ex.cn: 世界杯赛将占据议程表的重要位置。

syn: adj. 突出的，显著的；杰出的；卓越的：obvious, excellent, remarkable, brilliant, marked
rm: pro(向前) + min(突出) + ent(形容词后缀) → 突出的； 显著的

t: n. 岛国； 与外界隔绝的生活状况； 褊狭
syn: n. （思想、观点等）偏狭，性僵化；岛国性质（或状态）；岛屿生活状况，与外界隔绝的生活状况：parochialism, intolerance

t: adj. 基础的，基本的
en: relating to the most basic and important parts of something

ex.en: We have to tackle the fundamental cause of the problem.
ex.cn: 我们必须解决问题的根本原因。

ex.en: the fundamental principles of liberty and equality
ex.cn: 自由和平等这两个基本原则

syn: adj. 基本的，根本的：elementary, basic, essential, organic, primary
n. 基本原理；基本原则：basic principle, ultimate, rationale
rm: fund(基础) + ament + al → 基础的

t: adj. 全球的， 全世界的； 整体的， 全面的
en: affecting or including the whole world

ex.en: global climate change
ex.cn: 全球气候变化

ex.en: the global economy
ex.cn: 全球经济

syn: adj. 全球的；总体的；球形的：spherical, ball-shaped
rm: glob(球体) + al → 全球的， 全世界的

t: v. 呕吐， 恶心； 喷出；n. 呕吐，呕吐物；催吐剂
en: to bring food or drink up from your stomach out through your mouth, because you are ill

ex.en: He had swallowed so much sea water he wanted to vomit.
ex.cn: 他呛了这么多海水，所以想吐。

ex.en: I knew I was really in trouble when I began vomiting blood.
ex.cn: 我开始吐血的时候才知道我的麻烦大了。

syn: vt. 吐出；使……呕吐：spit out, regorge
vi. [医]呕吐；吐出：shoot the cat, hork
rm: v + o(形似嘴) + mit(词根mit指“发送”) → 张嘴发送 → 呕吐

t: vt. 给…权利； 给题名； 给…以称号
en: if a book, play etc is entitled something, that is its name

ex.en: a documentary entitled ‘The Price of Perfection’
ex.cn: 一部名为《完美的代价》的纪录片

rm: en(使…) + title(题目， 标题) → 使有题目或标题 → 给(书、 文章等)题名

t: n. 提纲；梗概；轮廓；草图；vt. 概述； 列提纲
en: the main ideas or facts about something, without the details

ex.en: a research proposal outline
ex.cn: 研究计划梗概

syn: n. 轮廓；大纲；概要；略图：profile, program, brief, contour
vt. 概述；略述；描画…轮廓：summarize, sum up
rm: out(外部的) + line(线条) → 外部线条 → 轮廓； 草图

t: v. 变淡， 变暗； 褪色； 凋谢； 逐渐消失
en: to gradually disappear

ex.en: Hopes of a peace settlement are beginning to fade.
ex.cn: 达成和平协议的希望日渐渺茫。

ex.en: Over the years her beauty had faded a little.
ex.cn: 岁月流逝，她的美貌已略逊当年。

syn: vi. 褪色；凋谢；逐渐消失：peter, color fading
vt. 使褪色：discolor
rm: 褪色(fade)的记忆何以面对(face)

t: adj. 过期未付的； 逾期的； 过度的， 过火的； 迟到的， 延误的
en: not done, paid, returned etc by the time expected

ex.en: an overdue gas bill
ex.cn: 逾期未付的煤气账单

ex.en: The library books are overdue.
ex.cn: 图书馆的书过期未还。

ph.cn: 逾期未支付款；过期付款

syn: adj. 过期的；迟到的；未兑的：past-due, expired
rm: over(超过) + due(预期的) → 超过期限的 → 逾期的

t: adj. 名义上的； 微不足道的
en: officially described as being something, when this is not really true

ex.en: the nominal head of the rebellion
ex.cn: 这次叛乱名义上的领导人

ex.en: Their conversion to Christianity was only nominal.
ex.cn: 他们只是名义上皈依了基督教。

syn: adj. 名义上的；有名无实的；[会计]票面上的：titular
rm: nomin(名字， 名目) + al → 名义上的

t: adj. 过量的， 额外的；n. 超越；过量['ekses]
en: additional and not needed because there is already enough of something

ex.en: Cut any excess fat from the meat.
ex.cn: 将肉中多余的肥肉切掉。

ph.cn: 超额生产能力；过剩设备

syn: n. 超过，超额；过度，过量；无节制：immoderation, exorbitance
adj. 额外的，过量的；附加的：additional, added, attached, extra, plus
rm: ex(出) + cess(行走) → 走出界限 → 超越； 过量

t: vi. 报复， 反击； 复仇
en: to do something bad to someone because they have done something bad to you

ex.en: I was sorely tempted to retaliate.
ex.cn: 我非常想报复。

syn: vi. 报复；回敬：get back on, get even with
vt. 报复：get back on, get even with, get back at

t: n. 角度， 方法； 透视法
en: a way of thinking about something, especially one which is influenced by the type of person you are or by your experiences

ex.en: the artist’s use of perspective
ex.cn: 那位画家对透视法的运用

syn: n. 观点；远景；[数]透视图：viewpoint, outlook, eye, sentiment, standpoint
adj. [数]透视的：clairvoyant
rm: per(贯穿) + spect(看) + ive → 贯穿看 → 角度， 方法； 透视法

t: n. [the G-] 银河； 星系； 群英
en: one of the large groups of stars that make up the universe

ex.en: Astronomers have discovered a distant galaxy.
ex.cn: 天文学家们发现了一个遥远的星系。

ph.cn: n. 中国银河证券有限责任公司
n. 螺旋星云（等于spiral nebula）

syn: n. 银河；[天]星系；银河系；一群显赫的人：the Milky Way

t: n. 听写
en: a piece of writing that a teacher reads out to test your ability to hear and write the words correctly

ex.en: I hate doing French dictations .
ex.cn: 我讨厌做法语听写。

syn: n. 听写；口述；命令：instruction, bidding, order, word, charge

t: n. 光荣；尊敬；vt. 向…示敬意； 信守， 执行
en: something that makes you feel very proud

ex.en: Over 100 players competed for the honour of representing the county in the National Finals.
ex.cn: 100多位选手为争取代表郡参加全国总决赛的荣誉进行角逐。

syn: n. 荣誉；尊敬；勋章：glory, respect, medal, worship
vt. 尊敬；[金融]承兑；承兑远期票据：accept, regard, esteem, worship

t: v. 侵犯， 侵入， 侵略， 侵袭
en: to enter a country, town, or area using military force, in order to take control of it

ex.en: The Romans invaded Britain 2,000 years ago.
ex.cn: 2,000年前古罗马人入侵了英国。

syn: vt. 侵略；侵袭；侵扰；涌入：strike, make inroads into
vi. 侵略；侵入；侵袭；侵犯：make inroads into, intrude upon
rm: in(进入) + vad(走) + e → 未经允许走进来 → 侵犯， 侵入

t: v. 逐渐形成； 演变， 进化
en: if an animal or plant evolves, it changes gradually over a long period of time

ex.en: Animals have evolved camouflage to protect themselves from predators.
ex.cn: 动物进化形成了伪装，以保护自身不被捕食性动物所捕食。

syn: vt. 发展，进化；进化；使逐步形成；推断出：go way, to develop
vi. 发展，进展；进化；逐步形成：grow, expand, advance
rm: e(出) + volv(滚， 转) + e → 转出来 → (使)进化

t: vt. 放弃， 遗弃
en: to leave someone, especially someone you are responsible for

ex.en: How could she abandon her own child?
ex.cn: 她怎么能抛弃自己的孩子呢？

syn: n. 狂热；放任：loose, mania
vt. 遗弃；放弃：desert, yield, quit
rm: a + band(乐队) + on → 乐队解散， 放弃演出 → 放弃

t: adj. 家庭的， 家用的， 普通的； 家喻户晓的；n. 家庭，户，全家人
en: relating to looking after a house and the people in it

ex.en: household chores
ex.cn: 家务杂活

ex.en: ...growing up in a male-only household.
ex.cn: …在全体成员均为男性的家庭里长大。

syn: adj. 家庭的；日常的；王室的：domestic, family, daily, everyday, routine
n. 家庭；一家人：family, race
rm: house(房屋) + hold(拥有) → 有房屋才像个家 → 家庭

t: vt. 赞颂， 赞美， 颂扬
en: to praise something very much

ex.en: Now experts are extolling the virtues of the humble potato.
ex.cn: 现在专家们在颂扬粗陋的马铃薯的种种好处。

syn: vt. 颂扬；赞美；赞颂：praise, celebrate, credit, bless
rm: ex(外， 上) + tol(举起) → 举起双手， 赞美上帝 → 赞美

t: adj. 不利的， 有害的
en: not good or favourable

ex.en: They fear it could have an adverse effect on global financial markets.
ex.cn: 他们担心这会对全球金融市场产生不利影响。

ex.en: Miller’s campaign has received a good deal of adverse publicity .
ex.cn: 米勒的竞选活动招来许多负面报道。

ph.cn: 不良反应；逆反应；有害反应

syn: adj. 不利的；相反的；[植]敌对的（名词adverseness，副词adversely）：against, contrary, opposite, counter, cross
rm: ad(向) + vers(转) + e → 转向不希望的一方 → 不利的， 有害的

t: n. 新闻简报； 公告； 学报； 期刊
en: a news report on radio or television

ex.en: ...the early morning news bulletin.
ex.cn: …早间新闻快报。

syn: n. 公告，公报：announcement, declaration
vt. 公布，公告：post, publish, notify
rm: 芝加哥公牛队(Bull)又上新闻(bulletin)了

t: n. 比， 比率
en: a relationship between two amounts, represented by a pair of numbers showing how much bigger one amount is than the other

ex.en: The adult to child ratio is one to six.
ex.cn: 成人与儿童之比是1比6。

syn: n. 比率，[数]比例：rate, scale
rm: rat(清点) + io → 比， 比率

t: vt. 重新包装； 重新填塞； 再装配； 拆修
syn: n. 重新打包；改装：refitment, face-lifting

t: n. 连接； 联结点； 交叉路口
en: a place where one road, track etc joins another

ex.en: the junction of Abbot Road and Mill Street
ex.cn: 阿伯特路与米尔街的交叉口

ex.en: Junction 5 on the M40
ex.cn: 40号高速公路上的第5交叉口

syn: n. 连接，接合；[公路]交叉点；接合点：connection, join, linking
rm: junct(连接) + ion → 连接

t: adj. 惯常的， 通常的
en: usual or typical of someone

ex.en: James took his habitual morning walk around the garden.
ex.cn: 詹姆斯又像往常习惯的那样绕花园作晨间散步去了。

syn: adj. 习惯的；惯常的；习以为常的：used, frequent, confirmed
rm: habit(习惯) ＋ ual(形容词后缀) → 惯常的， 通常的

t: n. 本能， 直觉； 天性
en: a natural tendency to behave in a particular way or a natural ability to know something, which is not learned

ex.en: Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
ex.cn: 直觉告诉她有些不对劲。

syn: n. [生物]本能，直觉；[心理]天性：intuition, natural ability
adj. 充满着的：abrim
rm: in(在…之内) + stinct(刺激) → 内在的刺激 → 本能， 直觉

t: n. 加农炮， 大炮
en: a large heavy powerful gun that was used in the past to fire heavy metal balls

ex.en: The cannons boom, the band plays.
ex.cn: 炮声隆隆，鼓乐齐鸣。

ph.cn: 我行我素不顾后果的人

syn: n. 大炮；[军]加农炮；榴弹炮；机关炮：artillery gun, ordnance
vi. 炮轰；开炮：fire a gun
rm: “加农”

t: n. 名誉， 名声
en: the opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past

ex.en: Alice Munro has a reputation for being a very depressing writer.
ex.cn: 艾丽斯•门罗有文风抑郁的名声。

syn: n. 名声，名誉；声望：credit, name, fame, celebrity, prestige
rm: re(重新) + put(想) + ation(表状态) → 反复想想， 名气只是过眼烟云 → 名誉， 名声

t: n&v. 耸肩
en: to raise and then lower your shoulders in order to show that you do not know something or do not care about something

ex.en: I just shrugged my shoulders and ignored him.
ex.cn: 我只是耸耸肩，没有理睬他。

ex.en: Melanie shrugged and walked away.
ex.cn: 梅拉妮耸耸肩走开了。

ph.cn: 摆脱；抖去；不屑理睬；耸肩表示蔑视；扭身脱掉衣服

syn: vt. 耸肩，耸肩表示：hunch
rm: shru(像拼音shu舒) + g(音似： 胳) → 耸肩

t: n. 独立， 自主
en: political freedom from control by the government of another country

ex.en: The country has made great advances since independence.
ex.cn: 该国自独立以来发展迅速。

syn: n. 独立性，自立性；自主：freedom, juche
rm: in(不) + depend(依靠) + ence(名词后缀) → 不依靠别人 → 独立， 自主

t: adv. 大体上， 主要地
en: used to mention the main part or cause of something, the main reason for something etc

ex.en: Her illness was caused mainly by stress.
ex.cn: 她的病主要是由精神压力引起的。

en: the way someone or something looks to other people

ex.en: He was always criticising his wife’s appearance.
ex.cn: 他老是批评妻子的外表。

ex.en: We are often attracted to somebody first by their physical appearance .
ex.cn: 我们经常先被一个人的外貌吸引。

syn: n. 外貌，外观；出现，露面：occurrence, aspect, emergence, external, outside
rm: appear(出现) + ance(名词后缀) → 出现

t: adj. 【地】冲积的，淤积的；n. 冲积土， 淤积土
en: made of soil left by rivers, lakes, floods etc

ex.en: alluvial flood plains
ex.cn: 冲积泛滥平原

ph.cn: 冲积平原；冲积系；冲积平野

syn: adj. [地质]冲积的：deluvial

t: n. 烟， 气， 汽
en: strong-smelling gas or smoke that is unpleasant to breathe in

ex.en: paint fumes
ex.cn: 油漆烟雾

syn: n. 烟气；激动；空想的事物（fume的复数）：jitters
v. 蒸发；冒烟；发怒（fume的三单形式）：evaporates

t: adj. 假的；v. 伪装；n. 假货；骗子
en: made to look like a real material or object in order to deceive people

ex.en: fake fur
ex.cn: 人造毛皮

ex.en: a fake ID card
ex.cn: 假身份证

ph.cn: 人造革；假裘皮；仿造皮毛

rm: 打击造(make)假(fake)

t: v. 横跨； 持续；n. 跨距；一段时间
en: to include all of a period of time

ex.en: a career which spanned nearly 60 years
ex.cn: 持续了差不多 60 年的职业生涯

syn: n. [建]跨度，跨距；范围：extent, boundary, region, spectrum, territory, area
vt. 跨越；持续；以手指测量：stride leap, last for

t: adj. 奇形怪状的； 怪诞的
en: very unusual or strange

ex.en: a bizarre coincidence
ex.cn: 奇怪的巧合

ex.en: dancers in rather bizarre costumes
ex.cn: 身着奇装异服的舞者

syn: adj. 奇异的（指态度，容貌，款式等）：fantastic, funny, fatastic
rm: 集市(bazaar)上都是奇形怪状的(bizarre)货物

t: vt. 把…归因于
en: If you ascribe an event or condition to a particular cause, you say or consider that it was caused by that thing

ex.en: An autopsy eventually ascribed the baby's death to sudden infant death syndrome.
ex.cn: 一次尸检最终把这名婴儿的死亡归因于婴儿猝死综合症。

syn: vt. 归因于；归咎于：blame, put down to
rm: a + scrib(写) + e → 把…写上去 → 把…归因于

t: v. 对…进行民意测验； 获得…选票；n. 民意测验；政治选举，大选
en: to ask a lot of people the same questions in order to find out what they think about a subject

ex.en: 18% of the women we polled said their husbands had a drinking problem.
ex.cn: 我们调查的妇女当中有18%的人说丈夫有酗酒问题。

syn: n. 投票；民意测验；投票数；投票所：vote, referendums
vt. 投票；剪短；对…进行民意测验；获得选票：crop, cast one's vote
rm: 大选(poll)费用(toll)上涨幅度惊人

t: n. 少数； 少数民族
en: a small group of people or things within a much larger group

ex.en: Gaelic is still spoken in Ireland by a tiny minority.
ex.cn: 爱尔兰仍有极少数人在说盖尔语。

syn: n. 少数民族；少数派；未成年：ethnic minorities, nonage
rm: min(小) + or + ity(名词后缀) → 少数

t: n&v. 诱惑， 吸引
en: a mysterious, exciting, or desirable quality

ex.en: At 50, she had lost none of her sexual allure.
ex.cn: 50岁的她魅力丝毫未减。

syn: vt. 引诱，诱惑；吸引：absorb, attract, engage, induce, seduce
n. 诱惑力：duende

t: adj. 严格的， 苛刻的； 紧缩的， 短缺的， 银根紧的； 迫切的
en: a stringent law, rule, standard etc is very strict and must be obeyed

ex.en: stringent anti-noise regulations
ex.cn: 严格的防噪音条例

ph.cn: 紧缩控制；紧急第；应急控制

syn: adj. 严厉的；迫切的；银根紧的：severe, tight, hard, harsh, pressing
rm: string(捆绑) + ent(形容词后缀) → 捆绑起来的 → 银根紧的； 苛刻的

t: adj. 更可取的， 更好的， 更合意的
en: better or more suitable

ex.en: For this dish, fresh herbs and garlic are preferable.
ex.cn: 做这道菜，用新鲜香草和大蒜更好。

ex.en: In warm weather, clothes made of natural fabrics are infinitely preferable (= much better ) .
ex.cn: 天气暖和的时候，穿天然织物的衣服要舒适得多。

syn: adj. 更好的，更可取的；更合意的：Mair
rm: prefer(更喜欢) ＋ able(能…的) → 更喜欢就觉得更好 → 更可取的， 更好的， 更合意的

t: n. 参考， 参考书目； 提及， 涉及； 证明书； 介绍
en: part of something you say or write in which you mention a person or thing

ex.en: He made no reference to any agreement.
ex.cn: 他没有提到任何协议。

syn: n. 参考，参照；涉及，提及；参考书目；介绍信；证明书：involved in, mention
vi. 引用：quote
rm: 来自refer(v. 参考； 提到)

t: n. 室； 洞穴； 膛
en: an enclosed space, especially in your body or inside a machine

ex.en: a combustion chamber
ex.cn: 燃烧室

ex.en: The heart has four chambers.
ex.cn: 心脏有四个腔。

syn: n. （身体或器官内的）室，膛；房间；会所：apartment, room
adj. 室内的；私人的，秘密的：indoor, private, secret, underground, inside

t: n. 恶意， 怨恨
en: a feeling of wanting to hurt or upset people, for example because you are  jealous  or think you have been unfairly treated

ex.en: I refused her a divorce, out of spite I suppose.
ex.cn: 我拒绝了她离婚的要求，我想是出于怨恨。

syn: n. 不顾；恶意；怨恨：regardless of, hatred
vt. 刁难；使恼怒：make a difficulty, exasperate

t: v. 安排； 排列
en: to organize or make plans for something such as a meeting, party, or trip

ex.en: Contact your local branch to arrange an appointment.
ex.cn: 请联络当地分部安排预约。

ex.en: I’d like to arrange a business loan.
ex.cn: 我想办理一笔商业贷款。

syn: vt. 安排；排列；整理：schedule, budget, place in, settle, form
vi. 安排；排列；协商：place in, treat, form
rm: ar(表加强) + range(排列) → 有序地排列 → 安排； 排列

t: vt. 使显得不重要， 轻视， 淡化
en: to make something seem less important or serious than it really is – used to show disapproval

ex.en: The article trivializes the whole issue of equal rights.
ex.cn: 文章对平等权利这个大问题轻描淡写。

ex.en: The debate has been trivialized by the media.
ex.cn: 那场辩论在媒体的报道中变得无关紧要。

t: n. 宣传， 宣扬； 公众的注意， 名声
en: Publicity is information or actions that are intended to attract the public's attention to someone or something

ex.en: Much advance publicity was given to the talks.
ex.cn: 会谈之前做了大量的宣传。

ex.en: ...government publicity campaigns.
ex.cn: …政府的宣传活动。

syn: n. 宣传，宣扬；公开；广告；注意：advertisement, propaganda, bill, regard, dissemination
rm: 产品可凭借其独特性(peculiarity)， 不用宣传(publicity)也能大为流行(popularity)

t: vi. 离开， 起程
en: to leave, especially when you are starting a journey

ex.en: Flights by Air Europe depart Gatwick on Tuesdays.
ex.cn: 欧洲航空公司的航班每逢周二从盖特威克机场起飞。

syn: vi. 离开；出发，起程；违反；去世：leave, split, vary, quit, get out
rm: de(去掉， 离开) + part(离开) → 离开， 起程

t: n&a. 广东人； 广东话
en: a Chinese language spoken in Southern China

t: n. 不和谐， 不相称； 不协调或不一致的事物
en: the fact that something is strange, unusual, or unsuitable in a particular situation

ex.en: The incongruity of her situation struck Gina with unpleasant force.
ex.cn: 吉娜猛然意识到自己处境尴尬，心里很不舒服。

syn: n. 不协调；不一致；不适宜：variance, disparity
rm: in(不) + congruity(一致， 和谐) → 不和谐， 不相称

t: n. 委托； 许诺； 承担义务
en: a promise to do something or to behave in a particular way

ex.en: Are you ready to make a long-term commitment ?
ex.cn: 你是否准备好作出长久的承诺？

syn: n. 承诺，保证；委托；承担义务；献身：assurance, certification, guarantee, security, compliance
rm: com(共同) + mit(送出) + ment → 一起送出 → 委托

t: n. 化石； 老顽固
en: an animal or plant that lived many thousands of years ago and that has been preserved, or the shape of one of these animals or plants that has been preserved in rock

ex.en: fossils of early reptiles
ex.cn: 早期爬行动物的化石

ex.en: Marine sponges have a long fossil record (= their development has been recorded over a long period ) .
ex.cn: 海绵动物留下了漫长的化石记录。

ph.cn: [生]活化石；[口]落后于时代的人

syn: n. [古生]化石；僵化的事物；顽固不化的人：petrification, reliquiae
adj. [古生]化石的；陈腐的，守旧的：banal, trite
rm: “佛说” → 一开口就是“佛说…”， 真是个老顽固 → 老顽固

t: n. 铁锹
en: a tool for digging that has a long handle and a broad metal blade that you push into the ground

ex.en: ...a garden spade.
ex.cn: …一把花园里使用的锹。

syn: n. 铁锹，铲子：rabbler
vt. [建]铲；把……弄实抹平：shool

t: n. 碰撞； 冲突， 抵触
en: an accident in which two or more people or vehicles hit each other while moving in different directions

ex.en: Two people were killed in a head-on collision (= between two vehicles that are moving directly towards each other ) on highway 218.
ex.cn: 218号公路上有两辆汽车迎面相撞，两人死亡。

syn: n. [物]碰撞；冲突：interference, conflict, war, crash, impact
rm: 来自collide(vi. 冲撞)

t: vt. 大量制造，成批生产；n. 大量制造； 工业品
en: to use machines to make goods or materials, usually in large numbers or amounts

ex.en: the company that manufactured the drug
ex.cn: 生产这种药的公司

ex.en: manufactured goods
ex.cn: 工业品，制成品

syn: n. 制造；产品；制造业：machining, make, work, fabrication
vt. 制造；加工；捏造：process, make
rm: manu(手) + fact(制作， 做) + ure → 用手制作 → 大量制造

t: adj. 独裁的， 专制的
en: An autocratic person or organization has complete power and makes decisions without asking anyone else's advice

ex.en: The people have grown intolerant in recent weeks of the king's autocratic ways.
ex.cn: 最近几周，民众越来越难以忍受国王的专制行径。

syn: adj. 专制的；独裁的，专横的：absolute, arbitrary
rm: auto(自己) + crat(统治) + ic → 独自统治的 → 独裁的， 专制的

t: n. 关节炎
en: a disease that causes the joints of your body to become swollen and very painful

ex.en: I have a touch of arthritis in the wrist.
ex.cn: 我的手腕有轻微关节炎。

ph.cn: 风湿性关节炎；关节风湿病
关节炎，牛皮癣关节炎；银屑病性关节炎

syn: n. [外科]关节炎：sacroiliitis
rm: arthr(连结； 关节) + itis(炎症) → 关节炎

t: n. 卡， 大卡
en: a unit for measuring the amount of  energy  that food will produce

ex.en: A potato has about 90 calories.
ex.cn: 一个马铃薯大约有90卡路里的热量。

ex.en: a calorie-controlled diet
ex.cn: 控制热量的日常饮食

ph.cn: 卡路里摄入量；热量摄取

rm: “卡路里”

t: n. 博士学位
en: a university degree of the highest level

ex.en: Professor Lanphier obtained his doctorate in social psychology from the University of Michigan.
ex.cn: 兰菲尔教授从密歇根大学获得了社会心理学博士学位。

syn: n. 博士学位；博士头衔：doctoral degree

t: n. 干涉， 干预， 介入
en: the act of becoming involved in an argument, fight, or other difficult situation in order to change what happens

ex.en: government intervention to regulate prices
ex.cn: 政府介入控制物价

ph.cn: [心]危机干预；危机处理；危机介入

syn: n. 介入；调停；妨碍：prevention, violation
rm: 来自intervene(vi. 干涉； 干扰， 介于其间)

t: n. 标语， 口号
en: a short phrase that is easy to remember and is used in advertisements, or by politicians, organizations etc

ex.en: an advertising slogan
ex.cn: 一句广告口号

ex.en: demonstrators shouting political slogans
ex.cn: 高喊政治口号的示威者

syn: n. 标语；呐喊声：banner, catchline
rm: s + log(说) + an → 标语， 口号

t: v. 装得太多， 装到满溢
en: to put too much of something into a container

ex.en: He had overfilled the jug.
ex.cn: 他把罐子装得太满了。

syn: vi. 满溢：brim over with
rm: over(过度) + fill(装满) → 装得太多， 装到满溢

t: n. 劝告， 忠告； 建议， 意见
en: an opinion you give someone about what they should do

ex.en: You should have followed my advice.
ex.cn: 你真该听我的建议。

syn: n. 建议；忠告；劝告；通知：suggestion, proposal, information, instance, notice

t: n. 水银
en: Mercury is a silver-coloured liquid metal that is used especially in thermometers and barometers

ex.en: He said that all metals were composed of mercury and sulphur in different proportions .
ex.cn: 他说一切金属都是由水银和硫黄按不同比例构成的。

ex.en: Here they endure long hours at dangerous jobs, wringing flecks of gold from the dirt with mercury.
ex.cn: 他们每天在这种危险的环境下工作很长时间，从带有水银的泥沙中淘出金沙。

syn: n. [化学]水银；水银柱；精神：energy, spirit, soul, mind, genius

t: adj. 频繁的， 常见的， 常用的
en: happening or doing something often

ex.en: Trains rushed past at frequent intervals .
ex.cn: 火车频频驶过。

ex.en: She was a frequent visitor to the house.
ex.cn: 她是家里的常客。

syn: adj. 频繁的；时常发生的；惯常的：confirmed, continual
vt. 常到，常去；时常出入于：resort to
rm: frequ(频繁； 频率) + ent(形容词后缀) → 频繁的， 常见的

t: vi. 相互作用； 相互影响
en: if one thing interacts with another, or if they interact, they affect each other

ex.en: While the other children interacted and played together, Ted ignored them.
ex.cn: 当其他孩子们相互交往、一起玩耍时，泰德却不理他们。

syn: n. 幕间剧；幕间休息：entr'acte
rm: inter(在…之间) + act(行动) → 相互之间有行动 → 相互作用

t: n. 会员身份； 全体会员
en: when someone is a member of a club, group, or organization

ex.en: You should carry your membership card with you at all times.
ex.cn: 你应该随身携带会员卡。

ex.en: Membership fees are being increased this year.
ex.cn: 会费今年提高了。

syn: n. 资格；成员资格；会员身分：qualification, capacity

t: adj. 嫉妒的； 猜疑的
en: feeling unhappy because someone has something that you wish you had

ex.en: She got insanely jealous and there was a terrible fight.
ex.cn: 她变得过分地猜忌，接着是一场激烈的打斗。

syn: adj. 妒忌的；猜疑的；唯恐失去的；戒备的：leary, leery

t: vt. 追踪，追查；追溯；描摹，标出；n. 痕迹； 微量
en: to find the origins of when something began or where it came from

ex.en: Sondheim’s book traces the changing nature of the relationship between men and women.
ex.cn: 桑德海姆的这本书研究了男女关系性质的变化。

ph.cn: 无影无踪地；渺无踪迹地

syn: vi. [审计]追溯；沿路走：go back, carry up
vt. 追踪，查探；描绘；回溯：represent, figure, trail
rm: 描绘(trace)车轮的痕迹(track)

t: adj. 大气的， 空气的； 大气层的； 大气所引起的
en: relating to the Earth’s atmosphere

ex.en: atmospheric pressure
ex.cn: 大气压力

syn: adj. [地物]大气的，大气层的：freeair, meteoric

t: n. 陈列；
en: a set of numbers or signs, or of computer memory units, arranged in lines across or down

ex.en: We visited the local markets and saw wonderful arrays of fruit and vegetables.
ex.cn: 我们参观了当地的市场，看到了漂亮地摆放着的水果蔬菜。

syn: n. 数组，阵列；排列，列阵；大批，一系列；衣服：series of, clothes, thread, garment, ranging
vt. 排列，部署；打扮：dress oneself, rank, form
rm: ar + ray(光线) → 像光线一样整齐排列 → 陈列； 大批

t: n&vi. 努力， 尽力； 尝试
en: to try very hard

ex.en: an outstanding example of human endeavor
ex.cn: 人类努力进取的突出例证

syn: vi. 竭力；企图：strain every nerve, attempt at
rm: end(尽头) + eav(看作eager， 热情) + our(我们的) → 用尽了我们的热情 → 努力， 尽力

t: v. 区别； 歧视
en: to treat a person or group differently from another in an unfair way

ex.en: He is incapable of discriminating between a good idea and a terrible one.
ex.cn: 他没能力在一个好主意和一个坏主意之间进行区分。

syn: vt. 歧视；区别；辨别：tell from, distinguish from
vi. 歧视；区别；辨别：tell from, distinguish from
rm: dis(分开) + crimin(分开) + ate → 分开对待 → 区别； 歧视

t: v. 发出蒸汽； 行驶； 用蒸汽开动；n. 汽，汽雾
en: to cook something in steam

ex.en: Steam the vegetables lightly.
ex.cn: 把蔬菜稍蒸一下。

ex.en: steamed broccoli
ex.cn: 蒸西蓝花

ph.cn: 汽轮机；蒸汽轮机；蒸汽透平
蒸汽喷射，蒸汽注入；射汽法

syn: vt. 蒸，散发；用蒸汽处理：shed
n. 蒸汽；精力：energy, vigor, vapor

t: v&n. 掩饰， 伪装
en: a way of hiding something, especially soldiers and military equipment, by using paint, leaves etc to make it look like the things around it

ex.en: soldiers learning camouflage technique
ex.cn: 在学习伪装技术的士兵

ex.en: the camouflage netting over the tanks
ex.cn: 坦克上的伪装网

syn: n. [军]伪装，掩饰：blind, mask
vt. [军]伪装，掩饰：wrap up, mask
rm: cam(看作came， 来) + ou(看作out) + flag(旗帜) + e → 扛着旗帜出来 → 伪装成革命战士 → 掩饰， 伪装

t: v. 跟踪， 追踪；n. 小路；跑道
en: to search for a person or animal by following the marks they leave behind them on the ground, their smell etc

ex.en: Police have been tracking the four criminals all over Central America.
ex.cn: 警方一直在中美洲到处追捕这四名罪犯。

syn: n. [铁路]轨道；[古生]足迹，踪迹；小道：path, railway, tail, trajectory, orbit
vt. 追踪；通过；循路而行；用纤拉：clear, trail

t: vt. 奴役， 征服， 使受控制
en: if something enslaves you, it completely controls your life and your actions

ex.en: She seemed enslaved by hatred.
ex.cn: 她似乎被仇恨所左右。

syn: vt. 束缚；征服；使某人成为奴隶：chain, bound, master
rm: en(使…) + slave(奴隶) → 使成为奴隶 → 奴役， 征服， 使受控制

t: adj. 一百年的；n. 百年纪念
en: The centennial of an event such as someone's birth is the 100th anniversary of that event

ex.en: The centennial Olympics was in Atlanta, Georgia.
ex.cn: 奥运会百年庆典在乔治亚州的亚特兰大举行。

rm: cent(百) + enn(年) + ial → 百年纪念； 一百年的

t: v. 归还； 报答
en: to do something for someone, or give them something, in return for helping you

ex.en: I’d like to buy them something to repay all their kindness.
ex.cn: 我想给他们买点东西来报答他们的好意。

syn: vi. 偿还；报答；报复：return, make the payments
vt. 回报；报复；付还：get back on, get even with

t: n. 数量， 数目； 量； 众多， 大宗
en: an amount of something that can be counted or measured

ex.en: Your work has improved in quantity and quality this term.
ex.cn: 这学期你的作业在完成数量和质量上都有提高。

syn: n. 量，数量；大量；总量：lots of, wealth, ocean, volume, sea

t: vt. 破坏； 拆除； 驳倒， 推翻
en: to prove that an idea or opinion is completely wrong

ex.en: He demolished my argument in minutes.
ex.cn: 他几分钟内就把我的论点驳倒了。

syn: vt. 拆除；破坏；毁坏；推翻；驳倒：destroy, undermine
rm: de(表加强) + mol(磨) + ish → 完全磨成粉 → 破坏； 拆除

t: n. 演出， 表演； 履行， 执行； 功能， 性能表现
en: when someone performs a play or a piece of music

ex.en: This evening’s performance will begin at 8.00 pm.
ex.cn: 今晚的演出8点开始。

syn: n. 性能；绩效；表演；执行：property, capability, enforcement, execution, implementing

t: adv. 当前， 现时， 目前
en: at the present time

ex.en: the products that are currently available
ex.cn: 目前供应的产品

ex.en: He is currently working on his first novel.
ex.cn: 他目前正在创作他的第一本小说。

syn: adv. 当前；一般地：commonly, normally, generally
rm: current(当前的) + ly(副词后缀) → 当前， 现时， 目前

t: adj. 连续的； 顺序排列的；n. 连续剧
en: arranged or happening one after the other in the correct order

ex.en: Keep the questions in the same serial order .
ex.cn: 让这些问题保持原来的顺序。

syn: adj. 连续的；连载的；[会计]分期偿还的：continuing, straight, endless, running, successive
n. 电视连续剧；[图情]期刊；连载小说：TV series, periodical
rm: 连续剧(serial)就是以某个主题为系列(series)的电视剧

t: n. 大使， 使节
en: an important official who represents his or her government in a foreign country

ex.en: ...the German ambassador to Poland.
ex.cn: …德国驻波兰大使。

syn: n. 大使；代表；使节：representation, deputy, behalf of

t: n. 发票；vt. 给…开发票
en: a list of goods that have been supplied or work that has been done, showing how much you owe for them

ex.en: We will then send you an invoice for the total course fees.
ex.cn: 然后我们将寄给你一张全部课程费用的发票。

ph.cn: 商业发票，正式签证的贸易发票
形式发票；试算发票；备考货单

syn: n. [会计]发票；货物；发货单：cargo, commodity
rm: in + voice(声音) → 大声把人叫进来开发票 → 发票； 给…开发票

t: adj. 可笑的，滑稽的；喜剧的；n. 喜剧演员
en: amusing you and making you want to laugh

ex.en: a comic novel
ex.cn: 滑稽小说

ph.cn: n. 喜剧性穿插；喜剧性调剂

syn: adj. 喜剧的；滑稽的；有趣的：colorful, funny
n. 连环漫画；喜剧演员；滑稽人物：funny, stripcartoon

t: adj. 模糊的； 含糊的
en: unclear because someone does not give enough detailed information or does not say exactly what they mean

ex.en: The governor gave only a vague outline of his tax plan.
ex.cn: 州长只是含糊地大致说了一下他的税务计划。

syn: adj. 模糊的；含糊的；不明确的；暧昧的：fuzzy, dark, uncertain
rm: vag(漫游) + ue → 思路四处游走 → 模糊的； 含糊的

t: vi. 进展；n. 费，票价
en: If you say that someone or something fares well or badly, you are referring to the degree of success they achieve in a particular situation or activity

ex.en: It is unlikely that the marine industry will fare any better in September.
ex.cn: 海运业不大可能在9月份有所好转。

ph.cn: 公共汽车票钱；公车票；公车费率
飞机票价；航空费用；航空票价

syn: vi. 经营；进展；遭遇；过活：round, advance
n. 票价；费用；旅客；食物：passenger, food, fee, charge, diet
rm: 若愿与我同行， 我不在乎(care)船费(fare)

t: adj. 偶然发生的， 不定期的； 由许多片段组成的， 松散的
en: something that is episodic happens from time to time and then stops for a while, rather than happening all the time

ex.en: his episodic involvement in politics
ex.cn: 他对政治的偶尔参与

ph.cn: 情景记忆，情节记忆；事件记忆

rm: 来自episode(n. 片段； 插曲)

t: n. 准确， 精确
en: the ability to do something in an exact way without making a mistake

ex.en: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
ex.cn: 他传球准确无误。

rm: ac(表加强) + cur(注意， 关心) + acy → 一再关心， 使其精确 → 准确(性)， 精确(性)

t: n. 离子
en: an atom which has been given a positive or negative force by adding or taking away an  electron

ex.en: Both of these particles can produce ion pairs .
ex.cn: 这两种粒子都能产生离子对。

ex.en: The ion channel was the missing circuit element I was looking for, and it already existed in nature.
ex.cn: 这种离子通道是我正在寻找的缺失的电路元件，而且它的确在自然界中存在。

t: adj. 地质的， 地质学的
en: Geological means relating to geology

ex.en: With geological maps, books, and atlases you can find out all the proven sites of precious minerals.
ex.cn: 有了地质地图、书籍和地图册，你就可以找到所有已探明的珍贵矿藏的位置。

rm: ge(o)(地球， 地) + olog(y)(…学) + ical → 关于地球的学科 → 地质学的

t: n. 配偶
en: a husband or wife

ex.en: Spouses were invited to the company picnic.
ex.cn: 配偶受到邀请参加公司的野餐会。

syn: n. 配偶：mateship, sexual partner
rm: sp(看作spend， 度过) + ouse(看作house， 房子) → 在同一间房子里共度人生的人 → 配偶

t: n. 环境； 背景； 安置
en: the place where something is or where something happens, and the general environment

ex.en: I’ve worked with children in various settings, mainly in secondary school.
ex.cn: 我在许多地方教过孩子，主要是在中学。

syn: n. 环境；安装；布置；[天]沉落：context, circumstance, installation, arrangement, surrounding
v. 放置；沉没；使…处于某位置（set的ing形式）：putting, positioning, laying
rm: set(布置) + t + ing → 布置(新居) → 环境； 安置

t: v. 得分， 记分； 给打分， 给…评分； 刻痕于， 画线于； 获胜， 成功；n. 得分， 分数； 乐谱； 抓痕， 划痕； 二十
en: to win a point in a sport, game, competition, or test

ex.en: Great cheers went up when he scored in the final minute of the game.
ex.cn: 当他在比赛的最后一分钟得分时，人群爆发出了雷鸣般的欢呼。

ex.en: She scored an average of 9.9 in the test.
ex.cn: 这次考试她的平均分是9.9。

ph.cn: 为（某队）进球/得分；为…得分；把…改写成器乐曲

syn: n. 分数；二十；配乐；[木]刻痕：marks, twenty
vt. 获得；评价；划线，刻划；把…记下：acquire, earn, buy, find, value
rm: 分， 分(score)， 考试的核心(core)

t: n. 缓刑； 试用； 试用期
en: a system that allows some criminals not to go to prison or to leave prison, if they behave well and see a probation officer regularly, for a particular period of time

ex.en: The judge sentenced Jennings to three years’ probation.
ex.cn: 法官判詹宁斯三年缓刑。

syn: n. [劳经]试用；缓刑；查验：suspended sentence, try-on
rm: prob(检查， 试验) + ation → 察看 → 试用； 试用期

t: n. 小岛， 岛
en: a word for an island, used in poetry or in names of islands

ex.en: the British Isles
ex.cn: 不列颠群岛

ph.cn: 英国属地曼岛（首都道格拉斯，位于欧洲）

syn: n. 岛：island

t: v. 引用， 引述， 引证； 提出， 提供； 报价；n. 引文，引语；估价，报价；
en: to repeat exactly what someone else has said or written

ex.en: He quoted a short passage from the Bible.
ex.cn: 他引用了《圣经》里的一小段。

ex.en: A military spokesman was quoted as saying that the border area is now safe.
ex.cn: 报道引述军方一位发言人的话，说边境地区现在很安全。

syn: vt. 报价；引述；举证：make offers, price quotation
vi. 报价；引用；引证：reference, make offers
rm: quot(数目) + e → 引用， 引述

t: v. 毕业； 获得学位；n. 毕业生；研究生['grædʒʊeɪt]
en: to obtain a degree, especially a first degree, from a college or university

ex.en: When the boys graduated from high school, Ann moved to a small town in Vermont.
ex.cn: 男孩们中学毕业后安迁到了佛蒙特州的一座小镇。

syn: vi. 毕业；渐变：shadow, to finish school
n. 研究生；毕业生：postgraduate, advanced student

t: n. 定额， 限额， 配额
en: an official limit on the number or amount of something that is allowed in a particular period

ex.en: The government has decided to scrap quotas on car imports.
ex.cn: 政府决定取消汽车进口配额。

ex.en: There are plans to introduce strict immigration quotas.
ex.cn: 有计划要推行严格的移民限额制度。

ph.cn: n. 配额制；定额分配制

syn: n. 配额；[经管]定额；[经]限额：norm, allowance
rm: “阔的” → 出手阔绰， 没有限额 → 限额

t: adj. 一致同意的； 一致通过的
en: a unanimous decision, vote, agreement etc is one in which all the people involved agree

ex.en: It was decided by a unanimous vote that the school should close.
ex.cn: 关闭学校是大家一致通过的决定。

syn: adj. 全体一致的；意见一致的；无异议的：unobjectionable, undisputed
rm: un(=uni 一个) + anim(精神) + ous → 大家都秉持一种精神 → 一致同意的

t: adj. 热的，热量的；n. 热气流
en: relating to or caused by heat

ex.en: thermal energy
ex.cn: 热能

ph.cn: 火力；火力发电；热功率；热电站
热稳定性，耐热性；热稳性

syn: adj. [热]热的，热量的：hot, heated, hottest
rm: therm(＝thermo热) + al → 热的

t: adj. 不能令人满意的
en: not good enough or not acceptable

ex.en: an unsatisfactory situation
ex.cn: 让人不满意的状况

syn: adj. 不令人满意的；不满足的；不符合要求的：ungratified

t: n. 地形， 地势
en: a particular type of land

ex.en: rocky terrain
ex.cn: 多石的地形

ph.cn: 不平地形，地形条件恶劣地区

syn: n. 地形，地势；领域；[地理]地带：domain, province, world, kingdom, universe
rm: terr(地) + ain → 地形， 地势

t: adv. 几乎， 差不多； 实际上， 事实上
en: almost

ex.en: Virtually all the children come to school by bus.
ex.cn: 几乎所有的孩子都乘公交车上学。

ex.en: He was virtually unknown before running for office.
ex.cn: 他在参加竞选之前几乎不为人知。

syn: adv. 事实上，几乎；实质上：actually, really, almost, nearly, most

t: adj. 极好的； 杰出的
en: extremely good or of very high quality

ex.en: an excellent suggestion
ex.cn: 极好的建议

ex.en: His car is in excellent condition.
ex.cn: 他的汽车状况极佳。

syn: adj. 卓越的；极好的；杰出的：remarkable, wonderful, famous, prominent, brilliant
rm: excel(优于， 超过) + lent → 杰出的

t: adv. 相当地； 公平地； 简直， 完全地
en: more than a little, but much less than very

ex.en: The house had a fairly large garden.
ex.cn: 那幢房子有个不小的花园。

ex.en: She speaks English fairly well.
ex.cn: 她英语讲得还不错。

syn: adv. 相当地；公平地；简直：relatively, simply, comparatively, equally, reasonably

t: adj. 文化的， 人文的
en: belonging or relating to a particular society and its way of life

ex.en: the very real historical and cultural differences between our two societies
ex.cn: 我们两个社会之间非常现实的历史和文化差异

ex.en: the desire to maintain a distinct cultural identity
ex.cn: 保持独特的文化特征的愿望

syn: adj. 文化的；教养的：nonmaterial

t: n. 国籍； 民族
en: the state of being legally a citizen of a particular country

ex.en: people of the same nationality
ex.cn: 同国籍的人

syn: n. 国籍，国家；民族；部落：state, folk, people, soil
rm: nation(国家) + ality(表状态， 名词后缀) → 属于哪个国家 → 国籍

t: v. 倒塌， 倒下； 打倒， 推翻
en: to become unsteady and then fall over, or to make something do this

ex.en: This scandal could topple the government.
ex.cn: 这一丑闻可能使政府倒台。

syn: vi. 倾倒；倒塌；摇摇欲坠：collapse, founder
vt. 推翻；颠覆；使倒塌：collapse, upset
rm: top(顶) + ple → 使顶向下 → 打倒， 推翻

t: adj. 市的， 市政的； 地区的； 内政的
en: relating to or belonging to the government of a town or city

ex.en: the municipal waste dump
ex.cn: 城市垃圾场

ex.en: municipal elections
ex.cn: 市级选举

syn: adj. [建][经]市政的，市的；地方自治的：civic, communalistic
rm: muni(服务) + cip(拿) + al(形容词后缀) → 提供城市公共服务的 → 市政的

t: n. 研究所，学院；vt. 建立， 设立
en: an organization that has a particular purpose such as scientific or educational work, or the building where this organization is based

ex.en: research institutes
ex.cn: 研究所

syn: vt. 开始（调查）；制定；创立；提起（诉讼）：found, construct, father, initiate
n. 学会，协会；学院：academy, college, union, school
rm: in + stit(站立) + ute → 建立， 设立

t: v. 忍受； 持久， 持续
en: to be in a difficult or painful situation for a long time without complaining

ex.en: It seemed impossible that anyone could endure such pain.
ex.cn: 似乎谁都不可能忍受这样的疼痛。

syn: vt. 忍耐；容忍：resist, tough, abide
vi. 忍耐；持续：resist, abide
rm: en(使) + dur(持续) + e → 忍受； 持久， 持续

t: n. 标准， 准则
en: a standard that you use to judge something or make a decision about something

ex.en: the criteria we use to select candidates
ex.cn: 我们挑选候选人的标准

ph.cn: 设计标准；设计准则；设计规范
失效准则；故障判据；抗剪强度破坏准则

syn: n. （批评判断的）[标准]标准；准则；规范；准据：standard, formula, level, prototype, norm
rm: cri(判断) + ter + ion → 判断的手段 → 标准， 准则

t: n. 命运， 天数
en: the things that happen to someone or something, especially unpleasant things that end their existence or end a particular period

ex.en: I wouldn’t wish such a fate on my worst enemy.
ex.cn: 就算是我不共戴天的仇敌，我也不希望他遭遇这样的命运。

syn: n. 命运：lot, destiny, fortune, portion, cup of tea
vt. 注定：predestine, foreordain

t: n. 本质； 精髓
en: the most basic and important quality of something

ex.en: In essence his message was very simple.
ex.cn: 实质上他想表达的意思很简单。

syn: n. 本质，实质；精华；[化工]香精：substance, truth, principle, entity, texture
rm: ess(存在) + ence → 存在即是本质 → 本质

t: n. 手册，
en: a book that gives instructions about how to do something, especially how to use a machine

ex.en: Consult the computer manual if you have a problem.
ex.cn: 如有问题请参阅计算机用法指南。

ex.en: a user manual
ex.cn: 用户指南

syn: adj. 手工的；体力的：handmade, mechanic
n. 手册，指南：guide, handbook, notebook
rm: manu(手) + al(形容词后缀) → 手工的

t: n. 犹豫， 迟疑； 不确定； 无把握
en: when you feel doubt about what will happen

ex.en: Times of great change are also times of uncertainty.
ex.cn: 发生巨大变革的时期也是动荡的时期。

ph.cn: 定性分析；不确定性分析

syn: n. [数][物]不确定，不可靠：indetermination, unsureness

t: adj. 装饰性的， 装饰的
en: designed to make something look attractive rather than to be used for a particular purpose

ex.en: ornamental gardens
ex.cn: 装饰性花园

ex.en: The pillars in the centre are purely ornamental.
ex.cn: 位于中心的那些柱子纯粹是作装饰用的。

syn: adj. 装饰的，装饰性的：decorative, illuminative
n. 观赏植物；装饰品：decoration, trimming

t: n. 杰出的才能， 高超的技艺， 专长， 造诣
en: great skill at doing something

ex.en: his physical prowess
ex.cn: 他优异的体能

ex.en: military prowess
ex.cn: 精良的军事技能

syn: n. 英勇；超凡技术；勇猛：valor, heroism
rm: prow(英勇的) + ess → 杰出的才能

t: n. 对一侧面的偏重， 偏向一侧状态
vt. 对…感到不满； 嫉妒； 勉强做， 不乐意地做
en: to feel angry or upset with someone because they have something that you think they do not deserve

ex.en: I certainly don't begrudge him the Nobel Prize.
ex.cn: 我肯定不会妒忌他得了获诺贝尔奖。

syn: vt. 羡慕，嫉妒；吝惜，舍不得给：spare, envy

t: n. 论文； 专著
en: a serious book or article about a particular subject

ex.en: ...Locke's Treatise on Civil Government.
ex.cn: ...洛克的《政府论》。

syn: n. 论述；论文；专著：thesis, dissertation, discourse

t: v. 退休； 引退， 退隐， 撤退
en: when a  jury  in a law court retires, they go away to consider whether someone is guilty or not

ex.en: At the age when most people retire, he is ready to face a new career.
ex.cn: 在大多数人退休的年纪，他准备要面对一项新事业。

ph.cn: 退隐，沉默；(沉湎于自己的思想而)离群索居

syn: vi. 退休；撤退；退却：withdraw, beat a retreat
vt. 退休；离开；收回：leave, split, quit
rm: re(再， 又) + tire(劳累) → 不再劳累 → 退休

t: n. 方面； 朝向， 方向； 外貌， 外观样子
en: one part of a situation, idea, plan etc that has many parts

ex.en: a south-facing aspect
ex.cn: 朝南方向

syn: n. 方面；[建]方向；形势；外貌：direction, orientation, situation, side, respect
rm: a + spect(看) → 看上去的样子 → 外貌

t: adj. 素食者的；n. 素食者
en: Someone who is vegetarian never eats meat or fish

ex.en: Yasmin sticks to a strict vegetarian diet.
ex.cn: 亚斯敏坚持一种严格的纯素饮食。

syn: n. 素食者；食草动物：veggie, herbivore
adj. 素食的：meatless, maigre

t: adj. 侵犯的， 侵略的， 挑衅的； 有进取心的， 有冲劲的
en: behaving in an angry threatening way, as if you want to fight or attack someone

ex.en: Jim’s voice became aggressive.
ex.cn: 吉姆的声音凶了起来。

ex.en: Teachers apparently expect a certain amount of aggressive behaviour from boys.
ex.cn: 老师显然料到男孩子多少会有些好勇斗狠的行为。

syn: adj. 侵略性的；好斗的；有进取心的；有闯劲的：invasive, enterprising
rm: ag + gress(行走) + ive(形容词后缀) → 不断行走， 四处闯荡 → 有进取心的

t: n. 弹性， 弹力； 复原力； 适应性； 乐观的性情
en: the ability to become strong, happy, or successful again after a difficult situation or event

ex.en: People showed remarkable resilience during the war.
ex.cn: 战争期间人们表现得特别坚韧。
