rm: fac(做) + ilit + ate(使…) → 使便利， 使容易

t: v. 颤抖， 抖动
en: to shake slightly because you are cold, or because you feel very afraid, angry, excited etc

ex.en: The child was quivering in her arms.
ex.cn: 那孩子在她怀里发抖。

ex.en: Her mouth quivered slightly as she turned away.
ex.cn: 她嘴唇微微哆嗦着，转过头去。

syn: n. 颤抖；箭袋；震动：shock, flesh-creep
vi. 颤抖；振动：quake, judder

t: n. 帮忙；偏爱；赞同；恩惠；vt. 赞同； 较喜欢， 偏袒； 有利于
en: something that you do for someone in order to help them or be kind to them

ex.en: Could you do me a favour and tell Kelly I can’t make it?
ex.cn: 你帮个忙告诉凯莉说我来不了好吗？

ex.en: He hired John as a favour to his father.
ex.cn: 他雇约翰是给他父亲一个面子。

syn: n. 偏爱；赞同；善行：acceptance, preference, good, mercy
vt. 赞成；喜爱；有助于：enjoy, agree, aid, uphold
rm: “飞吻” → 姑娘比较喜欢那个小伙子， 于是给了他一个飞吻 → 较喜欢

t: vt. 装入， 包住
en: to cover or surround something completely

ex.en: When nuclear fuel is manufactured it is encased in metal cans.
ex.cn: 核燃料生产出来时被装在金属罐中。

syn: vt. 包住；围绕；包装：pack, enclose
rm: en(进入) + case(容器) → 被装入容器中 → 装入， 包住

t: v. 打电报， 发电报； 泄露， 流露；n. 电报机；电报
en: to send a message by telegraph

ex.en: Once he knew where we were, Lewis telegraphed every few hours.
ex.cn: 一知道我们在哪里，刘易斯就每隔几小时发一份电报来。

syn: n. [通信]电报机，电报：wire, tgm
vt. 电汇；流露出；打电报给…：wire transfer, cable transfer
rm: tele(远的) + graph(写) → 以书写的方式带来远处的东西 → 电报机； 电报

t: n. 虚弱； 缺点； 偏好， 嗜好
en: a fault in someone’s character or in a system, organization, design etc

ex.en: The legislation has a fundamental weakness.
ex.cn: 这项立法有一个根本性缺陷。

ex.en: The plan has strengths and weaknesses.
ex.cn: 这个计划既有优点又有缺点。

syn: n. 弱点；软弱；嗜好：habit, appetite, hobby

t: v. 使具有光泽； 掩饰； 曲解； 作注释； 发光， 发亮；n. 光泽，色泽；虚假的外表，假象；注解，解释
en: If you gloss a difficult word or idea, you provide an explanation of it

ex.en: "Aventure" is often glossed as simply good or bad "fortune" or "chance."
ex.cn: "Aventure"常常被注解为简单的好或坏的“运气”或“机会”。

ph.cn: v. 掩盖，掩饰；给以光滑的表面

syn: n. 光彩；注释；假象：notes, splendor
vt. 使光彩；掩盖；注释：cover up, screen from
rm: 可能来自glow(v. 闪光)； 注意不要和gross(a. 总的， 粗略的) 相混

t: adj. 混浊的； 紊乱的
en: turbid water or liquid is dirty and muddy

ex.en: A fisherman drags nets of oysters from the turbid river water on a breathless summer day.
ex.cn: 一个渔民在喘不过气来的夏天从浑浊的河水里拖上了几网牡蛎。

ex.en: Life is the clear and transparent white spirits, which seems pure at the first glance, but actually is turbid.
ex.cn: 生命是明确的和透明的白酒，这似乎纯在乍看之下，但实际上是浑浊。

syn: adj. 浑浊的；混乱的；雾重的：chaotic, troubled, confused

t: n. 配给量，定量；给养，口粮；vt. 配给， 定量供应
en: a fixed amount of something that people are allowed to have when there is not enough, for example during a war

ex.en: emergency food rations
ex.cn: 紧急食物配给

syn: vt. 配给；[经管]定量供应：admeasure, allowance
n. 定量；口粮；配给量：quantification, definite quantity
rm: rat(老鼠) + ion → 老鼠正在开大会， 讨论口粮问题 → 配给量， 定量； 口粮

t: v. 腐烂；n. 腐烂
en: to decay by a gradual natural process, or to make something do this

ex.en: Candy will rot your teeth.
ex.cn: 吃糖会腐蚀牙齿。

ex.en: The trees were cut and left to rot .
ex.cn: 树被砍伐后任其腐烂。

syn: n. [植保]腐烂；腐败；腐坏：corruption, decomposition
vi. [植保]腐烂；腐败；堕落：fall into decay, blet

t: v. 预言； 预告
en: to say that something will happen, before it happens

ex.en: Sales were five percent lower than predicted.
ex.cn: 销售额比预期低5%。

ex.en: As Liz had predicted , the rumours were soon forgotten.
ex.cn: 正如利兹所预料的，流言很快就被淡忘了。

syn: vt. 预报，预言；预知：forecast, advance information
rm: pre(在…之前) + dict(说) → 预言

t: n. 建造； 建筑物； 构造
en: the process of building things such as houses, bridges, roads etc

ex.en: a road construction project
ex.cn: 道路修建计划

ex.en: construction workers
ex.cn: 建筑工人

ph.cn: 建筑计划，建设项目；基建计划

syn: n. [建]建设；建筑物；解释；造句：interpretation, explanation, fabric, building, structure

t: vt. 倾卸，倾倒；n. 垃圾场
en: If you dump something somewhere, you put it or unload it there quickly and carelessly

ex.en: We dumped our bags at the nearby Grand Hotel and hurried toward the market.
ex.cn: 我们把包扔在附近的格兰德旅馆，急匆匆地向市场赶去。

syn: vt. 倾倒；倾卸：pour in
vi. 倒垃圾：empty the trash
rm: “当铺” → 到当铺去倾销 → 倾卸， 倾倒

t: vt. 削弱； 破坏
en: to gradually make someone or something less strong or effective

ex.en: economic policies that threaten to undermine the health care system
ex.cn: 可能会损害医疗保健制度的经济政策

syn: vt. 破坏，渐渐破坏；挖掘地基：destroy, founder
rm: under(在…下) + mine(挖) → 在下面挖 → 削弱； 破坏

t: n. 家禽； 禽肉
en: birds such as chickens and ducks that are kept on farms in order to produce eggs and meat

ex.en: ...a poultry farm.
ex.cn: …一个家禽饲养场。

syn: n. [禽]家禽：fowl
rm: poul(小鸡) + try → 家禽； 禽肉

t: adj. 主观的
en: a state-ment, report, attitude etc that is subjective is influenced by personal opinion and can therefore be unfair

ex.en: As a critic, he is far too subjective.
ex.cn: 作为评论家，他过于主观。

ex.en: a highly subjective point of view
ex.cn: 相当主观的看法

syn: adj. 主观的；个人的；自觉的：personal, individual

t: adj. 钝的；率直的；vt. 把…弄钝； 使减弱
en: not sharp or pointed

ex.en: Sharpen all your blunt knives.
ex.cn: 把你所有的钝刀子都磨一磨。

ex.en: a blunt pencil
ex.cn: 钝铅笔

syn: adj. 钝的，不锋利的；生硬的；直率的：dull, explicit, naked
vt. 使迟钝：dull, benumb
rm: “不拦的” → 口无遮拦的 → 率直的

t: adj. 无法抵抗的， 不能压制的； 不能自已的
en: so attractive, desirable etc that you cannot prevent yourself from wanting it

ex.en: Men find Natalie irresistible.
ex.cn: 男人们觉得无法抗拒纳塔莉的魅力。

syn: adj. 不可抵抗的；不能压制的；极为诱人的：knock-down
rm: ir(不) + resistible(可抵抗的) → 不可抵抗的 → 无法抵抗的

t: n. 类推； 类比
en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way

ex.en: The analogy between music and fragrance has stuck.
ex.cn: 音乐与香味的类比已经深入人心了。

syn: n. 类比；类推；类似：similarity, parallelism
rm: ana(类似) + log(说话) + y → 放在一起说 → 类推； 类比

t: n. 请求， 申请； 应用， 运用； 施用， 敷用
en: a formal, usually written, request for something such as a job, place at university, or permission to do something

ex.en: We receive hundreds of job applications each year.
ex.cn: 我们每年收到数百封求职信。

ex.en: I filled in the application form and sent it off.
ex.cn: 我填完申请表后把它寄了出去。

syn: n. 应用；申请；应用程序；[药]敷用：adhibition, Apps
rm: ap(=ad向， 靠近) + plic(折叠) + ation(名词后缀) → 折得很近 → 申请； 应用

t: n. 里程碑； 转折点
en: a very important event in the development of something

ex.en: He said the launch of the party represented a milestone in Zambian history.
ex.cn: 他说该党的成立代表着赞比亚历史上的一个里程碑。

syn: n. [交]里程碑，划时代的事件：landmark, milliarium
rm: mile(英里) + stone(石头) → 标记英里数的石头 → 里程碑

t: adj. 生产性的； 多产的； 富有成效的
en: producing or achieving a lot

ex.en: Most of us are more productive in the morning.
ex.cn: 我们大多数人在早上更有效率。

ex.en: a highly productive meeting
ex.cn: 富有成效的会议

syn: adj. 能生产的；生产的，生产性的；多产的；富有成效的：fruitful, procreative

t: vt. 使重新振作； 使恢复活力
en: to put vitality and vigour back into (someone or something)

ex.en: The good news for committed shoppers is a so-called 'soft break' – a few minutes rest grabbing a coffee, for example - can reinvigorate our senses, although only temporarily.
ex.cn: 对于那些热衷购物的人来说，好消息是，稍事休息一下——比如花几分钟喝杯咖啡——可以使我们的感官重新振作，虽然这仅是暂时的。

syn: vt. 使再振作；使复兴：revive

t: n. 学期
en: one of the two periods of time that a year at high schools and universities is divided into, especially in the US

ex.en: the fall semester
ex.cn: 秋季学期

syn: n. 学期；半年：session, term
rm: seme(看作semi， 半) + s + ter(看作term， 学期) → 半学期也是学期 → 学期

t: n. 假设， 假定； 假说； 猜想
en: an idea that is suggested as an explanation for something, but that has not yet been proved to be true

ex.en: One hypothesis is that the victim fell asleep while driving.
ex.cn: 一种假设是受害人开车时睡着了。

ph.cn: 有效市场假说；有效率市场假说

syn: n. 假设：tentative
rm: hypo(在…下面) + thesis(论点) → 在论点之下， 非真正论点 → 假设， 假定； 假说

t: adj. 乏味的； 阴沉的
en: not interesting or exciting

ex.en: Life is never dull when Elizabeth is here.
ex.cn: 有伊丽莎白在这里生活绝不会无聊。

ex.en: a dull movie
ex.cn: 一部沉闷的电影

syn: adj. 钝的；迟钝的；无趣的；呆滞的；阴暗的：slow, blunt
vt. 使迟钝；使阴暗；缓和：relax, benumb
rm: 和充实的(full)相反的是乏味的(dull)

t: v&n. 坍塌， 崩溃； 晕倒
en: if a building, wall etc collapses, it falls down suddenly, usually because it is weak or damaged

ex.en: Uncle Ted’s chair collapsed under his weight.
ex.cn: 椅子承受不了特德叔叔的重量，塌架了。

ex.en: The roof had collapsed long ago.
ex.cn: 屋顶早就塌了。

ph.cn: 损毁荷载，极限载荷；破坏负荷；临界纵向荷载

syn: vi. 倒塌；瓦解；暴跌：founder, fall in
vt. 使倒塌，使崩溃；使萎陷：crumple up
rm: col + lapse(滑倒) → 一出门就滑倒， 真让人崩溃 → 崩溃

t: n. 让步， 迁就； 特许权； 承认， 认可
en: something that you allow someone to have in order to end an argument or a disagreement

ex.en: The British were not prepared to make any concessions .
ex.cn: 英国人没有打算作出让步。

ph.cn: 特许经营权合约；租让制合同

syn: n. 让步；特许（权）；承认；退位：recognition, license
rm: con(共同) + cess(行走， 前进) + ion → 要想大家共同进步， 必须都做出让步 → 让步

t: adj. 正确无误的； 精确的
en: correct and true in every detail

ex.en: The brochure tries to give a fair and accurate description of each hotel.
ex.cn: 该手册尽量公正、准确地介绍每一家酒店。

syn: adj. 精确的：precise, mathematical, strict, rigid, refined

t: v. 爬；n. 胫，胫部，胫骨
en: to climb quickly up or down a tree, pole etc by using your hands and legs

ex.en: He shinned up a tree.
ex.cn: 他噌的一下爬到了一棵树上。

syn: n. 胫骨：shankbone, tibia
vt. 爬；攀：climb

t: n. 身份证明； 识别， 鉴定
en: official papers or cards, such as your passport, that prove who you are

ex.en: Do you have any identification?
ex.cn: 你有什么身份证明文件吗？

ex.en: fingerprinting as a means of identification
ex.cn: 作为一种身份证明方式的指纹提取

syn: n. 鉴定，[计]识别；认同；身份证明：authentication, recognition
rm: ident(一样的， 相同的) + ific(使…) + tion(名词后缀) → 查看是否相同 → 鉴定； 证明

t: n. 猿；vt. 模仿
en: an animal that is similar to a monkey but has no tail or only a very short tail

ex.en: ...chimpanzees and other apes.
ex.cn: …黑猩猩和其他猿。

syn: n. [脊椎]猿；傻瓜；模仿者：stupid, fool
vt. 模仿；抢台词：simulate, pattern, imitate

t: adj. 每年的，年度的；n. 年刊， 年鉴； 一年生植物
en: happening once a year

ex.en: The school trip has become an annual event.
ex.cn: 学校组织的旅行成了一年一度的活动。

ph.cn: 年报，年度报告；年度决算；年度财务报告

syn: adj. 年度的；[统计]每年的：yearly, etesian
n. 年刊，[图情]年鉴；一年生植物：year book, almanac
rm: ann(年) + ual → 每年的， 年度的

t: adj. 奢华的；独有的；
en: available or belonging only to particular people, and not shared

ex.en: Bel Air is an exclusive suburb of Los Angeles.
ex.cn: 贝莱尔是洛杉矶郊外一处高级住宅区。

syn: adj. 独有的；排外的；专一的：particular, antiforeign
n. 独家新闻；独家经营的项目；排外者：scoop

t: n. 贫穷
en: the situation or experience of being poor

ex.en: Millions of elderly people live in poverty .
ex.cn: 数百万老年人生活在贫困之中。

ex.en: We need an effective strategy to fight poverty .
ex.cn: 我们需要制定一个有效的对策来与贫困作斗争。

ph.cn: 贫困线；贫穷线（指维持一般生活所需收入的最低标准）

syn: n. 贫困；困难；缺少；低劣：difficulty, shortage, hardness, want

t: n. 常备剧目； 全部节目
en: all the plays, pieces of music etc that a performer or group knows and can perform

ex.en: the behavioural repertoire of infants
ex.cn: 婴幼儿的行为能力

rm: re(一再) + pert(带) + oire → 反复带着的剧目 → (剧团等)常备剧目

t: vi. 求助； 诉诸；n. 求助；诉诸；胜地
en: If you resort to a course of action that you do not really approve of, you adopt it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want

ex.en: His punishing work schedule had made him resort to drugs.
ex.cn: 他那累人的工作日程已经使他不得不求助于毒品了。

syn: n. 凭借，手段；度假胜地；常去之地：instrument, shift, road, tool, implement
vi. 求助，诉诸；常去；采取某手段或方法：appeal, ask for help
rm: 报告(report)上级， 紧急求助(resort)

t: adj. 课外的
en: extracurricular activities are not part of the course that a student is doing at a school or college

ex.en: Each child had participated in extracurricular activities at school.
ex.cn: 每个孩子都参加了学校的课外活动。

syn: adj. 课外的；业余的；婚外的：leisure, sparetime
rm: extra(额外的) ＋ curricular(课程的) → 课外的

t: v. 变小， 缩小
en: to gradually become less and less or smaller and smaller

ex.en: The elephant population is dwindling.
ex.cn: 大象的数量在减少。

ex.en: His money had dwindled away.
ex.cn: 他的钱在逐渐变少。

syn: vi. 减少；变小：to cut down, fall off
vt. 使缩小，使减少：shrink, astrict
rm: d + wind(风) + le → 随风而去， 越来越小 → (使)缩小

t: n. 颌
en: one of the two bones that your teeth are in

ex.en: a broken jaw
ex.cn: 碎裂的颌骨

ph.cn: 迫近的危险，险境；鬼门关

syn: n. [脊椎]颌；下巴；[地质]狭窄入口；唠叨：chin, jowl
vi. 教训；唠叨：rabbit on
rm: “嚼” → 他下颌脱臼了， 没法嚼东西 → 颌

t: v. 加旁注于； 加边于；n. 差额，差距；页边空白；边缘；余地；幅度
en: the empty space at the side of a page

ex.en: Someone had scribbled a note in the margin .
ex.cn: 有人在页边写了条批注。

ex.en: Use double spacing and wide margins to leave room for comments.
ex.cn: 采用双倍行距和宽阔的页边空白，以便留出地方写评注。

syn: n. [心理]边缘；[会计]利润，余裕；[印刷]页边的空白：profit, gain, brink, suburb
rm: mar(是mark的变体， 记号、 符号) + in → 记号常标于书页空白处 → 页边空白

t: adj. 易于…的； 适宜的； 敏捷的
en: exactly right for a particular situation or purpose

ex.en: ‘Love at first sight’ is a very apt description of how he felt when he saw her.
ex.cn: 用“一见钟情”来形容他见到她时的感觉再恰当不过。

syn: adj. 恰当的；有…倾向的；灵敏的：sensitive, correct, quick, prone, liable
rm: 本身为词根， 意为“适应； 能力”

t: n. 怀孕； 怀孕期
en: when a woman is pregnant (= has a baby growing inside her body )

ex.en: This drug should not be taken during pregnancy.
ex.cn: 这种药妊娠期间不得服用。

ex.en: her third pregnancy
ex.cn: 她的第三次怀孕

syn: n. 怀孕；丰富，多产；意义深长：conception, abundance, plenty, amplitude, enrichment
rm: 来自pregnant(a. 怀孕的)

t: v. 要求； 需要； 询问；n. 要求；需求
en: if one thing demands another, it needs that thing in order to happen or be done successfully

ex.en: Too many things demanded his attention at the same time.
ex.cn: 太多事情同时需要他的关注。

ex.en: It’s a desperate situation demanding a desperate remedy.
ex.cn: 情况危急，需要背水一战。

syn: vt. 要求；需要；查询：exact, lack, desire, call for
vi. 需要；[计]请求；查问：wish, have need of
rm: de(向下) + mand(命令) → 向下命令 → 要求； 需要

t: v. 登上； 骑上； 发起； 镶嵌；n. 山，山峰；支架，底座
en: to get on a horse or bicycle

ex.en: He mounted his horse and rode on.
ex.cn: 他跨上马前行。

ph.cn: 埃佛勒斯峰（喜马拉雅山主峰之一，中国称珠穆朗玛峰）

syn: vt. 增加；爬上；使骑上马：enhance, boost, jack, hot, gain
vi. 爬；上升：climb, arise, raise, go up
rm: 本身为词根， 意为“登上”

t: v. 摇摇晃晃地移动， 蹒跚； 眩晕， 发昏； 卷， 绕；n. 卷轴，卷筒，卷盘，线轴
en: to walk in an unsteady way and almost fall over, as if you are drunk

ex.en: Andy reeled away from the bar and knocked over his stool.
ex.cn: 安迪踉跄着离开吧台，把凳子都撞倒了。

ph.cn: 流畅地讲；抽出；一口气说

syn: vi. 卷；眩晕；蹒跚地走；退缩：roll, swim
vt. 卷；使旋转：roll, turn
rm: 喝醉酒步履蹒跚(reel)， 感觉(feel)墙走我不走

t: vi. 共存
en: if two different things coexist, they exist at the same time or in the same place

ex.en: But I think both can coexist.
ex.cn: 但是我认为两者可以共存。

ex.en: Let green and we coexist!
ex.cn: 让绿色与我们共存！

rm: co(共同) + exist(存在) → 共存

t: adj. 原子的
en: relating to the energy produced by splitting atoms or the weapons that use this energy

ex.en: atomic power
ex.cn: 核动力

ex.en: an atomic submarine
ex.cn: 核潜艇

ph.cn: 原子吸收；原子吸收作用

syn: adj. 原子的，原子能的；微粒子的：nuclear, corpuscular

t: n. 滨水路， 滨水区， 码头区
en: the part of a town or an area of land next to the sea, a river etc

ex.en: The hotel is down on the waterfront.
ex.cn: 这家酒店位于滨水区。

syn: n. 滩，海滨；水边：shore, oceanfront
rm: water(水) + front(面向， 朝向) → 滨水路， 滨水区， 码头区

t: n. 望远镜
en: a piece of equipment shaped like a tube, used for making distant objects look larger and closer

ex.en: What is the range of this telescope?
ex.cn: 这架望远镜的有效距离多大?。

ex.en: We have two blankets and a telescope.
ex.cn: 我有两个毯子和一个望远镜。

ph.cn: 电波望远镜；无线电天文望远镜

syn: vt. 压缩；使套叠：to compress, constrict
vi. 套叠；变短：shorten
rm: tele(远) + scop(看) + e → 往远处看时所借助的工具 → 望远镜

t: n. 摄影术， 摄影
en: the art, profession, or method of producing photographs or the scenes in films

ex.en: He did fashion photography for ‘Vogue’ magazine.
ex.cn: 他为《时尚》杂志拍过时装照片。

ex.en: the National Museum of Photography
ex.cn: 国家摄影博物馆

ph.cn: n. 空中摄影；空中照相术

syn: n. [摄]摄影；摄影术：photo shoot, camerawork
rm: photo(照片) + graph(书写) + y → 摄影术， 摄影

t: n. 代数
en: a type of mathematics that uses letters and other signs to represent numbers and values

ex.en: On the basis of minimax algebra theory, this paper provides an algebra method of solving countable stages decision problems in the dynamic programming.
ex.cn: 本文根据极大极小代数理论，给出了一种用以求解动态规划中有限多阶段决策问题的代数算法。

ex.en: Through the symbol computer algebra, a fourth order perturbation solution for the one dimentional stable coupled flows of elastic fluids in the deformable porous media.
ex.cn: 用计算机代数系统进行符号运算，求得了可变形多孔介质中弹性流体一维定常耦合渗流问题的四阶摄动解。

t: adj. 鼓舞人心的； 启发灵感的
en: giving people a feeling of excitement and a desire to do something great

ex.en: inspiring music
ex.cn: 激励人心的音乐

ex.en: King was a great orator and an inspiring leader.
ex.cn: 金是伟大的演说家和鼓舞人心的领袖。

syn: adj. 鼓舞人心的；灌输的；启发灵感的：heartening, stimulatory
v. 鼓舞；激发；使感悟（inspire的ing形式）：prompting
rm: in(使…) + spir(呼吸) + ing → 使呼吸的 → 鼓舞人心的

t: vt. 取得， 获得
en: to obtain something by buying it or being given it

ex.en: Manning hoped to acquire valuable works of art as cheaply as possible.
ex.cn: 曼宁希望以尽可能低的价格买到有价值的艺术品。

ex.en: She has acquired an email address and a site on the World Wide Web.
ex.cn: 她获得了一个电子邮件地址和万维网网址。

syn: vt. 获得；取得；学到；捕获：earn, buy, score, find, make
rm: ac(表加强) + quir(追求) + e → 不断追求才能够获得 → 获得， 取得

t: adj. 肥沃的， 多产的， 富饶的； 能繁殖的
en: fertile land or soil is able to produce good crops

ex.en: 800 acres of fertile cropland
ex.cn: 800英亩的肥沃耕地

syn: adj. 富饶的，肥沃的；[植]能生育的：rich, viable
n. 肥沃，多产：pregnancy, enrichment
rm: fer(带来) + tile → 可带来果实的 → 多产的

t: n. 概念， 观念； 想法
en: an idea, belief, or opinion

ex.en: She had no notion what he meant.
ex.cn: 她根本不明白他是什么意思。

syn: n. 概念；见解；打算：concept, idea, eye, construct, sight
rm: not(知道) + ion(名词后缀) → 知道的东西 → 观念； 想法

t: n. 多样性； 差异
en: the fact of including many different types of people or things

ex.en: ...the cultural diversity of Latin America.
ex.cn: …拉丁美洲文化的多样性。

ph.cn: 多样性指数；歧异度指数

syn: n. 多样性；差异：difference, multiplicity
rm: di(分离) + vers(转) + ity(名词后缀) → 转开 → 多样性； 差异

t: adj. 唯物主义的； 物质享乐主义的， 贪图享乐的
en: concerned only with money and possessions rather than things of the mind such as art, religion, or moral beliefs – used in order to show disapproval

ex.en: He’s so materialistic.
ex.cn: 他太实利主义了。

ex.en: the materialistic values of American society
ex.cn: 美国社会的实利主义价值观

rm: 来自material(a. 物质的)

t: n. 红利， 股息； 回报， 效益； 被除数
en: a part of a company’s profit that is divided among the people with  share s  in the company

ex.en: Good eating habits will pay dividends later on in life.
ex.cn: 保持良好的饮食习惯，将来会受益的。

syn: n. 股息；[数]被除数；奖金：bonus, stake

t: adj. 被抓住的， 被捕获的； 受控制的； 受垄断的；n. 被抓住的人或动物
en: A captive person or animal is being kept imprisoned or enclosed

ex.en: Her heart had begun to pound inside her chest like a captive animal.
ex.cn: 她心如鹿撞，怦怦跳个不停。

ph.cn: 受制而走不开的听众或观众

syn: adj. 被俘虏的；被迷住的：spellbound
n. 俘虏；迷恋者：prisoner
rm: capt(抓住) + ive → 被抓住的， 被捕获的

t: vt. 缝，
en: to sew two pieces of cloth together, or to sew a decoration onto a piece of cloth

ex.en: Mary is stitching a bedspread.
ex.cn: 玛丽在缝床罩。

ph.cn: 针距；线圈长度；针迹长度

syn: n. 针脚，[服装]线迹；一针：steek
vt. 缝，缝合：seam, oversew
rm: stit(看作sit， 坐) + ch → 坐在那里做针线活 → 缝； 针脚

t: n&vt. 尊重； 尊敬
en: a feeling of respect for someone, or a good opinion of someone

ex.en: Peden was greatly esteemed by the people of Ayrshire.
ex.cn: 佩登深受艾尔郡人的尊敬。

syn: vt. 尊敬；认为；考虑；估价：assess, honor, expect, evaluate, guess
n. 尊重；尊敬：estimation, respect, regard, worship
rm: e(音似： 一) + stee(看作steel, 钢铁) + m(看作man, 人) → 一个有钢铁般意志的人值得尊敬 → 尊重； 尊敬

t: vt. 比…重； 比…更重要； 胜过， 强于
en: to be more important or valuable than something else

ex.en: The benefits of the scheme outweigh the disadvantages.
ex.cn: 这项计划利大于弊。

syn: vt. 比…重（在重量上）；比…重要；比…有价值：come before, take precedence over
rm: out(超过) + weigh(称重) → 比…更重要

t: adj. 卷曲的， 波浪式的
en: having a lot of curls

ex.en: long dark curly hair
ex.cn: 又长又黑的鬈发

syn: adj. 卷曲的；卷毛的；（木材）有皱状纹理的；蜷缩的：frizzy
rm: curl(使卷曲) + y → 卷曲的

t: adj. 沉思的； 体贴的
en: always thinking of the things you can do to make people happy or comfortable

ex.en: Paul is very thoughtful.
ex.cn: 保罗非常体贴人。

syn: adj. 深思的；体贴的；关切的：considerate

t: n. 上当者，受骗者；vt. 欺骗， 愚弄
en: someone who is tricked, especially into becoming involved in something illegal

ex.en: He was accused of being a dupe of the Americans.
ex.cn: 他被控是美国人的傀儡。

syn: n. 上当者；易受骗的人：greenhorn
vt. 欺骗；愚弄（等于duplicate）：sell, fox, kid

t: vt. 压制， 镇压； 禁止发表， 查禁； 抑制， 忍住； 阻止…的生长
en: to stop people from opposing the government, especially by using force

ex.en: The uprising was ruthlessly suppressed.
ex.cn: 起义受到了残酷的镇压。

syn: vt. 抑制；镇压；废止：control, restrain, stay
rm: sup(向下) + press(压) → 压下去 → 压制， 镇压

t: n. 火山口； 坑
en: a round hole in the ground made by something that has fallen on it or by an explosion

ex.en: craters on the moon’s surface
ex.cn: 月球表面的坑

ph.cn: n. 火山口形成的深湖

syn: n. [地质]火山口；弹坑：volcanic vent, dead hole
vt. 在…上形成坑；取消；毁坏：destroy, damage, recall

t: n. 布丁
en: a hot sweet dish, made from cake, rice, bread etc with fruit, milk, or other sweet things added

ex.en: chocolate pudding
ex.cn: 巧克力布丁

ph.cn: 圣诞布丁（一种干果布丁）

syn: n. 布丁：pud
rm: “布丁”

t: v. 起皱纹；n. 皱纹
en: if you wrinkle a part of your face, or if it wrinkles, small lines appear on it

ex.en: Alex wrinkled up her nose at the smell.
ex.cn: 闻到那股味道，亚历克丝皱起了鼻子。

ex.en: Carter wrinkled his forehead in concentration.
ex.cn: 卡特全神贯注，眉头紧锁。

syn: n. 皱纹：rugosity, plication
vi. 起皱：crease
rm: 眨眼(twinkle)容易起皱纹(wrinkle)

t: adj. 镇静的；平静的；v. 平静； 镇静
en: relaxed and quiet, not angry, nervous, or upset

ex.en: Glen was calm and composed at the funeral.
ex.cn: 格伦在葬礼上表现得平静而镇定。

syn: adj. 静的，平静的；沉着的：pacific, peaceful, composed, steady, still
vt. 使平静；使镇定：compose, pacify
rm: 她手掌(palm)心出汗， 内心很不平静(calm)

t: n. 牛犊； 崽， 幼兽
en: the baby of a cow, or of some other large animals, such as an  elephant

ph.cn: 肥牛犊；最好的款待[来自《圣经》]
初恋；早恋（指少男少女之间短暂的爱情）

syn: n. [解剖]腓肠，小腿；[印刷]小牛；小牛皮：crus, shank
rm: 小牛(calf)是半(half)大的牛

t: vt. 过度开采

ex.en: Hunger and poverty often compel the poor to overexploit the resources on which their own livelihoods depend.
ex.cn: 饥饿和贫困常常迫使穷人过度开采其赖以生存的资源。

t: n. 灰；灰烬；
en: the soft grey powder that remains after something has been burned

ex.en: cigarette ash
ex.cn: 香烟灰

ex.en: The house burnt to ashes.
ex.cn: 那房子烧成了灰烬。

syn: n. [化学][矿物]灰；灰烬：ember

t: adj. 流行的， 时髦的
en: modish ideas, designs etc are modern and fashionable

ex.en: ...a short checklist of much that is modish at the moment.
ex.cn: ...一张时下潮品的简表。

syn: adj. 流行的；时髦的：popular, fashionable, going, modern, ruling
rm: mod(样式) + ish → 最新样式的 → 流行的， 时髦的

t: vt. 监督， 管理； 指导
en: to be in charge of an activity or person, and make sure that things are done in the correct way

ex.en: Griffiths closely supervised the research.
ex.cn: 格里菲思密切指导该项研究。

syn: vt. 监督，管理；指导：manage, police, conduct, run, direct
vi. 监督，管理；指导：direct, charge of
rm: super(超过) ＋ vis(看见) + e → 在超出别人高度的地方看 → 监督， 管理； 指导

t: adv. 迷路地； 误入歧途地

ex.en: His passion for horseracing carried him astray.
ex.cn: 他对赛马运动的酷爱使他误入歧途。

ex.en: The first thing we did was look for errors in our experimental design and for every conceivable scenario that could have led us astray.
ex.cn: 我们的第一个动作是寻找的实验设计哪里出了差错，并想遍每一种可能让我们误入歧途的状况。

syn: adj. 迷路的；离开正道的；不对头的：stray
rm: as(像) + tray(盘子) → 像在盘子里转圈圈 → 迷路地； 误入歧途地

t: n. 餐厅， 食堂
en: a place in a factory, school etc where meals are provided, usually quite cheaply

ex.en: Rennie had eaten his supper in the canteen.
ex.cn: 伦尼已在食堂吃过晚饭。

syn: n. 食堂，小卖部；水壶：mess, refectory
rm: “看停” → 小孩一看到餐厅就停下不走了 → 餐厅

t: adj. 寓言式的； 极为巨大的； 极好的
en: extremely good or impressive

ex.en: You look fabulous!
ex.cn: 你看上去美极了！

ex.en: a fabulous meal
ex.cn: 丰盛的一餐

syn: adj. 难以置信的；传说的，寓言中的；极好的：wonderful, excellent, famous, super, great
rm: fab(看作fable， 寓言) + ulous → 寓言式的

t: vt. 不理会，漠视；n. 忽视， 漠视
en: when someone ignores something that they should not ignore

ex.en: He ordered the jury to disregard the witness’s last statement.
ex.cn: 他指示陪审团忽略证人的最后一句话。

syn: vt. 忽视；不理；漠视；不顾：ignore, neglect
n. 忽视；不尊重：inobservancy, negligence
rm: dis(不) + regard(关心) → 不关心 → 不理会， 漠视

t: n. 薄暮， 黄昏
en: the time before it gets dark when the sky is becoming less bright

ex.en: The street lights go on at dusk.
ex.cn: 街灯在黄昏时亮起来。

syn: n. 黄昏，[气象]薄暮；幽暗，昏暗：dark, owl-light
adj. 微暗的：darksome
rm: 她趴在书桌(desk)上看着窗外的黄昏(dusk)

t: adj. 偶尔的， 间或发生的
en: happening sometimes but not often or regularly

ex.en: He made occasional visits to London.
ex.cn: 他有时候会去伦敦。

ex.en: They had an occasional coffee together after shopping.
ex.cn: 他们偶尔会在购物后一起喝杯咖啡。

syn: adj. [生物]偶然的；临时的；特殊场合的：extraordinary, temporary, odd

t: v. 通过； 扮演
en: to act in a play, story etc

ex.en: a drama enacted on a darkened stage
ex.cn: 在灯光暗淡的舞台上演的戏剧

syn: vt. 颁布；制定法律；扮演：play, portray
rm: en(使) + act(法令) → 使成为法令 → 通过(法律)

t: n&v. 争论， 辩论
en: discussion of a particular subject that often continues for a long time and in which people express different opinions

ex.en: the gun-control debate in the US
ex.cn: 美国有关控制枪支的争论

ex.en: The new drug has become the subject of heated debate within the medical profession.
ex.cn: 这种新药成了医学界激烈争论的话题。

syn: vt. [法]辩论，争论，讨论：reason, dispute about
vi. [法]辩论，争论，讨论：deal, pro-and-con
rm: de(表加强) + bat(打) + e → 竞选双方在打口水战 → 争论， 辩论

t: n. 航空学
en: the science of designing and flying planes

ex.en: If we in fact had the right level of investment in aeronautics, we would not currently be competing with Airbus.
ex.cn: 如果我们真的在航空领域投入了足够多的资金，现在就绝不会还在与空中客车缠斗了。

syn: n. [航]航空学；飞行术：aviation, airmanship
rm: aero(空气) + naut(航行) + ics(…学) → 航空学

t: vt. 熄灭， 扑灭； 消灭， 使破灭
en: to make a fire or light stop burning or shining

ex.en: Please extinguish all cigarettes.
ex.cn: 请把香烟都熄灭了。

ex.en: Firemen were called to extinguish the blaze.
ex.cn: 有人打电话叫消防队员来扑灭大火。

syn: vt. 熄灭；压制；偿清：silence, go out
rm: ex(没有) + ting(刺) + uish → 用针刺使没有 → 熄灭， 扑灭； 消灭

t: n. 航天器， 宇宙飞船
en: a vehicle that is able to travel in space

ex.en: ...the world's largest and most expensive unmanned spacecraft.
ex.cn: …世界上最大、最贵的无人航天器。

ph.cn: 载人飞船；人操纵的宇宙飞船
无人驾驶飞机；无人宇宙飞船

syn: n. 宇宙飞船，[航]航天器：aerospacecraft, astrovehicle
rm: space(太空) + craft(技术) → 太空技术 → 航天器， 宇宙飞船

t: adj. 易受攻击的， 易受伤的
en: someone who is vulnerable can be easily harmed or hurt

ex.en: He took advantage of me when I was at my most vulnerable.
ex.cn: 他在我最脆弱的时候利用了我。

ex.en: We work mainly with the elderly and other vulnerable groups.
ex.cn: 我们主要和老年人以及其他弱势群体打交道。

syn: adj. 易受攻击的，易受…的攻击；易受伤害的；有弱点的：sensitive, assailable
rm: vuln(受伤) + er + able(易…的) → 易受伤的

t: vt. 捐赠， 赠送
en: to give something, especially money, to a person or an organization in order to help them

ex.en: people who volunteer to donate blood
ex.cn: 自愿献血者

syn: vt. 捐赠；[经]捐献：make a contribution to, endow
vi. 捐赠；[经]捐献：give, make a contribution to
rm: don(给予) + ate → 给出去 → 捐赠， 赠送

t: vt. 倒空； 枯竭； 消耗
en: To deplete a stock or amount of something means to reduce it

ex.en: ...substances that deplete the ozone layer.
ex.cn: …消耗臭氧层的物质。

syn: vt. 耗尽，用尽；使衰竭，使空虚：spend, exhaust
rm: de + plet(满， 填满) + e → 不满 → 倒空； (使)枯竭

t: n. 统计数值； 统计学
en: a single number which represents a fact or measurement

ex.en: The statistic comes from a study recently conducted by the British government.
ex.cn: 这项统计数据来自英国政府最近进行的一项研究。

rm: stat(看作state， 国家) + istic → 常听到新闻说： 据国家统计数据表明 → 统计数值

t: adj. 有意义的； 重大的， 重要的
en: having an important effect or influence, especially on what will happen in the future

ex.en: His most significant political achievement was the abolition of the death penalty.
ex.cn: 他政治上最重大的成就是废除了死刑。

ex.en: Please inform us if there are any significant changes in your plans.
ex.cn: 你们的计划如有重大变动，请通知我们。

syn: adj. 重大的；有效的；有意义的；值得注意的；意味深长的：valid, important, available, effective, virtual, remarkable
n. 象征；有意义的事物：symbol, indication
rm: 来自signify(v. 有重要性)； sign(标记) + ify(使…) → 重点部分标上记号 → 有重要性

t: adj. 粗体的； 大胆的， 鲁莽的， 勇敢的； 醒目的
en: not afraid of taking risks and making difficult decisions

ex.en: In a surprisingly bold move , he is threatening court action against the company.
ex.cn: 他出人意料地做出一个大胆举动，威胁要起诉这家公司。

ex.en: My aunt Flo was a bold determined woman.
ex.cn: 我姑妈芙洛是一个大胆果断的人。

syn: adj. 大胆的，英勇的；[印刷]黑体的；厚颜无耻的；险峻的：rapid, stouthearted

ex.cn: 你曾否因为头昏眼花而失却平衡或你曾否失去知觉？

t: adj. 侵略的， 入侵的； 侵袭的， 扩散的； 切入的， 开刀的
en: an invasive disease spreads quickly and is difficult to stop

ex.en: invasive bladder cancers
ex.cn: 扩散性膀胱癌

syn: adj. 侵略性的；攻击性的：aggressive, attacking
rm: in(进入) + vas(走) + ive(形容词后缀) → 未经许可就进入的 → 入侵的， 侵袭的

t: n. 基因
en: a part of a cell in a living thing that controls what it looks like, how it grows, and how it develops. People get their genes from their parents

ex.en: human genes
ex.cn: 人类基因

ex.en: the genes that regulate cell division
ex.cn: 控制细胞分裂的基因

syn: n. [遗]基因，遗传因子：hereditary factor
rm: “基因”

t: adj. 空的，空洞的；沉闷的；虚伪的，空虚的；v. 挖空， 凿空
en: having an empty space inside

ex.en: a hollow tree
ex.cn: 空心树

syn: adj. 空的；中空的，空腹的；凹的；虚伪的：empty, artificial, false, bare, vacant
n. 洞；山谷；窟窿：hole, cavity

t: n. 树干， 躯干； 大箱子； 象鼻
en: the thick central woody stem of a tree

ex.en: He left his bicycle leaning against a tree trunk .
ex.cn: 他把他的自行车斜靠在树干上。

ph.cn: 干线；中继线，长途电话线

syn: n. 树干；躯干；象鼻；汽车车尾的行李箱：stock, bole
adj. [航][铁路]干线的；躯干的；箱子的：arterial
rm: 卡车(truck)撞向树干(trunk)

t: vi. 依靠； 信赖
en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly

ex.en: They relied heavily on the advice of their professional advisers.
ex.cn: 他们非常依赖专业顾问的建议。

syn: vi. 依靠；信赖：trust, hope
rm: re(一再) + ly(音似： lie“撒谎”) → 一再撒谎的人完全不值得信赖 → 信赖

t: v. 滑动，下滑；悄悄地移动；n. 滑动， 下滑； 滑坡， 滑道， 滑面； 幻灯片； 突然崩落
en: to move smoothly over a surface while continuing to touch it, or to make something move in this way

ex.en: He slid open the door of the glass cabinet.
ex.cn: 他滑开玻璃柜的门。

syn: n. 滑动；[电影]幻灯片；滑梯；雪崩：transparency, slipping
vi. 滑动；滑落；不知不觉陷入：bowl, creep down
rm: s + lid(盖子) + e → 盖子太滑， 从桌子上滑了下去 → 滑动， 下滑

t: adj. 黏性的； 湿热的
en: made of or covered with a substance that sticks to surfaces

ex.en: There’s some sticky stuff in your hair.
ex.cn: 你的头发上有什么黏糊糊的东西。

ex.en: a sticky floor
ex.cn: 黏糊糊的地板

ph.cn: 偷盗习惯；小偷小摸的人

syn: adj. [胶粘]粘的；粘性的：glutinous, viscous
rm: stick(黏贴) + y → 黏性的

t: v. 拘泥小节； 挑剔， 吹毛求疵； 为小事操心； 不断地烦扰
en: if something niggles you, you keep worrying about it or feeling annoyed about it and you cannot forget it

ex.en: Something’s been niggling her all day.
ex.cn: 有什么事烦了她一整天。

ex.en: It niggles me that we can’t go home yet and get warm.
ex.cn: 我很生气，我们到现在还不能回家暖和暖和。

syn: vi. 拘泥小节；为琐事费时；挑剔：carp at, find fault with

t: n. 腰， 腰部
en: the narrow part in the middle of the human body

ex.en: The skirt was too big around the waist.
ex.cn: 那条裙子腰围太大。

syn: n. 腰，腰部：middle, loin

t: adj. 过多的， 极度的， 过分的
en: much more than is reasonable or necessary

ex.en: his excessive drinking
ex.cn: 他的酗酒

ex.en: $15 for two beers seems a little excessive.
ex.cn: 两杯啤酒要15美元，似乎有点过分。

syn: adj. 过多的，极度的；过分的：extreme, ultra, tall

t: n. 丛林
en: a thick tropical forest with many large plants growing very close together

ex.en: the Amazon jungle
ex.cn: 亚马孙丛林

ph.cn: 水泥丛林；立体丛林；混凝土建成的野兽世界

syn: n. 丛林，[林]密林；危险地带：mott, chaparral
adj. 丛林的；蛮荒的：backwoods

t: vt. 烧烤；拷问，盘问；n. 烤架
en: if you grill something, or if it grills, you cook it by putting it on a flat metal frame with bars across it, above or below strong direct heat

ex.en: Grill the bacon until crisp.
ex.cn: 将培根烤至酥脆。

ex.en: swordfish grilled over charcoal
ex.cn: 炭火烤的剑鱼

syn: vt. 烧，烤；烤问：carbonado, to roast
vi. 烧，烤；严加盘问：to roast

t: n. 分享； 参与
en: the act of taking part in an activity or event

ex.en: Thank you for your participation.
ex.cn: 谢谢你的参与。

ex.en: entertainment with plenty of audience participation
ex.cn: 有许多观众参与的娱乐活动

syn: n. 参与；分享；参股：privy to, concernment
rm: 来自participate(vi. 参与)

t: n. 樱桃
en: a small round red or black fruit with a long thin stem and a stone in the middle

ex.en: a bunch of cherries
ex.cn: 一串樱桃

ex.en: cherry pie
ex.cn: 樱桃馅饼

syn: n. [木][园艺]樱桃；樱桃树；如樱桃的鲜红色；处女膜，处女：hymen, virginal membrane
rm: 要会分清浆果(berry)和樱桃(cherry)

t: n. 损害；；vt. 损害
en: physical harm that is done to something or to a part of someone’s body, so that it is broken or injured

ex.en: These chemicals have been found to cause serious environmental damage.
ex.cn: 经发现，这些化学物质会造成严重的环境破坏。

ex.en: There may be permanent brain damage.
ex.cn: 可能有永久性脑损伤。

ph.cn: 地层损害，油层损害；生产层损坏

syn: vi. 损害；损毁；赔偿金：do harm to, let in for
n. 损害；损毁：injury, harm, lesion

t: n. 攻击，袭击；侵犯人身罪；冲击；
en: the crime of physically attacking someone

ex.en: a case of robbery and assault
ex.cn: 一宗抢劫袭击案

ex.en: Several soldiers have been charged with assault .
ex.cn: 几名士兵被控侵犯人身。

syn: n. 攻击；袭击：attack, attempt, push
vt. 攻击；袭击：hit, come at
rm: as(向) + saul(跳) + t → 跳向某人 → 攻击， 袭击

t: v. 定居， 安家； 解决， 调停； 安排， 安放； 支付， 结算； 安置于； 飞落， 停留， 栖息
en: to decide what you are going to do, especially so that you can make definite arrangements

ex.en: Nothing’s settled yet.
ex.cn: 一切都还未定。

ex.en: It’s settled then. I’ll go back to the States in June.
ex.cn: 那就这么定了，我六月份回美国。

syn: vi. 解决；定居；沉淀；下陷：deposit, beach, work out, figure out
vt. 解决；安排；使…定居：decide, schedule, budget, place in, work out
rm: set(放置) + tle → 放置在一个地方就好像定居了下来 → 定居， 安家

t: n. 样式；模式；vt. 构成图案； 使形成， 促成
en: the regular way in which something happens, develops, or is done

ex.en: Weather patterns have changed in recent years.
ex.cn: 气候模式近年已经发生了变化。

ex.en: A general pattern began to emerge .
ex.cn: 一个总体模式开始显现。

ph.cn: 流型，流动型态；活动模；流线谱

syn: n. 模式；图案；样品：mode, device, design, schema, specimen
vt. 模仿；以图案装饰：simulate, imitate

t: v. 增强， 加剧
en: if something heightens a feeling, effect etc, or if a feeling etc heightens, it becomes stronger or increases

ex.en: There are fears that the march will heighten racial tension.
ex.cn: 有人担心这次游行会加深种族间的紧张局势。

ex.en: Increased levels of fat in the diet could heighten the risk of cancer.
ex.cn: 饮食中脂肪摄入量的提升会增加患癌症的风险。

syn: vt. 提高；增高；加强；使更显著：enhance, raise, cement, muscle
vi. 升高；变强：strengthen, breeze up
rm: height(高度， 海拔) + en(使…) → 提高 → (使)增强， (使)加剧

t: adj. 严厉的， 严酷的； 粗糙的， 毛糙的； 刻薄的； 恶劣的； 刺耳的， 刺目的
en: harsh conditions are difficult to live in and very uncomfortable

ex.en: The hostages are being held in harsh conditions.
ex.cn: 人质被拘押在恶劣环境中。

ex.en: a young girl suddenly exposed to the harsh realities of life
ex.cn: 骤然暴露于残酷现实生活中的小女孩

ph.cn: 严酷的现实；残酷的现实

syn: adj. 严厉的；严酷的；[声]刺耳的；粗糙的；刺目的：severe, grinding, crude, tight, hard
rm: har(看作hard， 坚硬的) + sh → 态度强硬的 → 严厉的

t: v. 厚厚地覆盖； 窒息； 把闷熄
en: to completely cover the whole surface of something with something else, often in a way that seems unnecessary or unpleasant

ex.en: A teenage mother was accused of smothering her 3-month-old daughter.
ex.cn: 一个少女妈妈被指控闷死自己三个月大的女儿。

syn: vt. 使窒息；抑制；（用灰等）闷熄；忍住：control, stay, restrain, resist
vi. 窒息；被抑制；闷死：choke

t: v. 劳动； 努力；n. 劳动；劳动力，工人

ex.en: ...he will be labouring 14 hundred metres below ground.
ex.cn: …他将在地下1400米处艰苦劳动。

vi. [劳经]劳动；分娩；费力地前进：swink
rm: “累伯” → 农民伯伯劳动很辛苦， 很累 → 劳动

t: v&n. 刮， 擦
en: to remove something from a surface using the edge of a knife, a stick etc

ex.en: Scrape the carrots and slice them thinly.
ex.cn: 把这些胡萝卜去皮切成薄片。

ex.en: The two of them scraped their dishes clean .
ex.cn: 他们两个把盘子擦得干干净净。

syn: n. 刮掉；擦痕；困境；刮擦声：difficulty, corner, dilemma, fix

t: adj. 寒冷的， 阴沉的； 阴郁的， 暗淡的； 没有希望的， 不乐观的； 荒凉的； 索然无味的

ex.cn: 一月里一个阴冷的下午

rm: 寒(bleak)风呼啸而过， 打破(break)黑夜的沉寂

t: n. 困难， 麻烦； 分歧， 争论
en: something that is annoying, because it causes problems or is difficult to do

ex.en: I don’t feel like cooking tonight, it’s too much hassle.
ex.cn: 今天晚上我不想做饭，太麻烦了。

ex.en: It’s such a hassle not having a washing machine.
ex.cn: 没有洗衣机真是麻烦。

syn: vt. 找麻烦，搅扰；与…争辩；使…烦恼：pain, take to task
n. 困难，麻烦；激战：difficulty, poverty, trouble, hardness, headache

t: adj. 光荣的； 壮丽的
en: having or deserving great fame, praise, and honour

ex.en: a truly glorious future
ex.cn: 无比美好的将来

ex.en: a glorious victory
ex.cn: 光荣的胜利

syn: adj. 光荣的；辉煌的；极好的：wonderful, excellent, famous, super, great
rm: “哥劳累死” → 劳累致死， 荣誉来之不易 → 光荣的

t: adj. 双边的； 双方的
en: involving two groups or nations

ex.en: ...bilateral talks between Britain and America.
ex.cn: …英美之间的双边会谈。

syn: adj. 双边的；有两边的：bipartite, two-sided
rm: bi(双， 两) + later(侧面， 边) + al(形容词后缀) → 双边的

t: n. 高原； 稳定时期
en: a large area of flat land that is higher than the land around it

ex.en: Inflation rates have reached a plateau.
ex.cn: 通货膨胀率已趋平稳。

vi. 达到平衡；达到稳定时期：level out
rm: plat(平的) + eau → 高出平地的地 → 高原

t: n. 天资， 天赋， 天生的才能
en: natural ability or skill, especially in learning

ex.en: He drifted into publishing and discovered an aptitude for working with accounts.
ex.cn: 他偶入出版界，发现自己具有管账的天资。

有…的才能；有…的天性，有…的自然倾向
学术能力倾向；学术才能

rm: 感激(gratitude)上苍让你具备这种才能(aptitude)

t: adj. 糟糕透顶的， 可恶的； 恶劣的， 卑鄙的
en: extremely unpleasant or bad

ex.en: This coffee tastes really vile.
ex.cn: 这咖啡太难喝了。

ex.en: a vile smell
ex.cn: 难闻的气味

syn: adj. 卑鄙的；邪恶的；低廉的；肮脏的：poor, evil, base, mean, ill
rm: vil(无耻的) + e → 恶劣的， 卑鄙的

t: n. 建筑学； 建筑设计， 建筑风格； 【计】 体系结构
en: the style and design of a building or buildings

ex.en: He studied architecture at university.
ex.cn: 他在大学里读的是建筑学。

ph.cn: 造园术，园林建筑学；造景建筑业

syn: n. [建]建筑学；建筑风格；建筑式样：architectural style

t: n. 压力；重音；强调，重点，着重；vt. 强调； 重读
en: continuous feelings of worry about your work or personal life, that prevent you from relaxing

ex.en: Your headaches are due to stress.
ex.cn: 你的头痛是压力造成的。

ex.en: Janet’s been under a lot of stress since her mother’s illness.
ex.cn: 珍妮特自从母亲生病以来承受了很大的压力。

syn: n. 压力；强调；紧张；重要性；重读：pressure, significance, intensity, heat, tension
vt. 强调；使紧张；加压力于；用重音读：emphasize, tension, highlight
rm: s + tress(看作dress， 穿衣) → 穿衣强调个人风格 → 强调

t: n. 安慰； 慰问
en: something that makes you feel better when you are sad or disappointed

ex.en: If it’s any consolation, things do get easier as the child gets older.
ex.cn: 聊可安慰的是，随着这孩子慢慢长大，境况也好起来了。

ex.en: He had the consolation of knowing that he couldn’t have done any better.
ex.cn: 他知道自己已经尽了最大努力，心中便有了安慰。

syn: n. 安慰；慰问；起安慰作用的人或事物：comfort, relief, sympathy
rm: con(=with以) + sol(安慰) + ation → 可用来给人安慰的东西 → 安慰； 慰问

t: n. 依靠， 依赖
en: when someone or something is dependent on someone or something else

ex.en: the country’s heavy reliance on trade
ex.cn: 该国对贸易的严重依赖

ph.cn: 印度瑞来斯实业公司（又称信实工业公司）

syn: n. 信赖；信心；受信赖的人或物：belief, confidence, trust, hope

t: vt&n. 陈列， 展览； 显示， 表现
en: an arrangement of things for people to look at or buy

ex.en: a dazzling display (= very good display ) of flowers
ex.cn: 令人目眩神迷的花卉展

ex.en: The window display caught her eye.
ex.cn: 橱窗陈列吸引了她的目光。

ph.cn: n. 液晶显示器；液晶屏幕

syn: n. [电子]显示；炫耀：exhibition, manifestation
vt. [电子]显示；表现；陈列：reveal, make clear, conduct oneself, prove, represent

t: v. 使厌烦；钻孔；n. 令人讨厌的人

ex.en: He’s the sort of person who bores you at parties.
ex.cn: 他这人会在派对上烦你。

ex.en: a film that will bore its young audience
ex.cn: 会让年轻观众感到无聊的一部电影

vt. [机]钻孔；使烦扰：drill hole, counter sunk

t: n. 特技演员； 杂技演员
en: someone who entertains people by doing difficult physical actions such as walking on their hands or balancing on a high rope, especially at a  circus

ex.en: The acrobat turned a somersault.
ex.cn: 杂技演员翻了个筋斗。

ex.en: Look at the clever acrobat on the tightrope.
ex.cn: 快看，那个灵巧的杂技演员在走绷索。

syn: n. 杂技演员，特技演员；随机应变者；翻云覆雨者，善变者：posturer, tumbler
rm: acro(高) + bat(走) → 高空走的人 → 杂技演员

t: n. 混乱； 失调， 紊乱， 疾病
en: a mental or physical illness which prevents part of your body from working properly

ex.en: severe eating disorders such as bulimia and anorexia
ex.cn: 像贪食症和厌食症这类严重的进食障碍

ph.cn: 混乱；慌乱地， 狼狈不堪；杂乱地

syn: n. 混乱；骚乱：chaos, confusion, disturbance, turmoil, involvement
vt. [医]使失调；[电子]扰乱：upset, disarrange
rm: dis(不) + order(顺序) → 无序 → 混乱

t: n. 前沿地； 岬角
en: a headland, cape, or coastal promontory
syn: n. 沿海地区；[地质]前沿地；海角：coastland, coastal areas
rm: fore(前面) + land(土地) → 前面的土地 → 前沿地

t: vt. 恶化， 加重， 加剧
en: to make a bad situation, an illness, or an injury worse

ex.en: Their money problems were further aggravated by a rise in interest rates.
ex.cn: 由于利率上调，他们的财务问题更加严重。

ex.en: Building the new road will only aggravate the situation .
ex.cn: 建造那条新路只会使情况恶化。

syn: vt. 加重；使恶化；激怒：anger, complicate
rm: ag + grav(重的) + ate(使…) → 使重 → 加重， 恶化

t: adj. 乳制品的；n. 奶制品；乳品店
en: Dairy is used to refer to foods such as butter and cheese that are made from milk

ex.en: He avoids all meat and dairy products.
ex.cn: 他不吃任何肉类和奶制品。

ph.cn: 乳品业，乳品加工业；乳制品行业

syn: n. 奶制品；乳牛；制酪场；[食品]乳品店；牛奶及乳品业：milker, milking cow
adj. [食品]乳品的；牛奶的；牛奶制的；产乳的：milky
rm: 每天(daily)吃乳制品(dairy)强壮骨骼

t: adj. 巨大的， 庞大的
en: used to emphasize that something is extremely large

ex.en: a colossal statue of the King
ex.cn: 国王的巨大雕像

ex.en: This whole holiday was a colossal waste of money.
ex.cn: 这次度假浪费了大量的钱财。

syn: adj. 巨大的；异常的，非常的：huge, tremendous, enormous, massive, macro, intense

t: adj. 成熟的；深思熟虑的；v. 成熟
en: someone, especially a child or young person, who is mature behaves in a sensible and reasonable way, as you would expect an adult to behave

ex.en: Laura is very mature for her age .
ex.cn: 相对她的年龄来说劳拉是很成熟的。

ex.en: We’re mature enough to disagree on this issue but still respect each other.
ex.cn: 我们都很成熟，尽管我们对此事意见不同，但还是彼此尊重。

ph.cn: 成熟期；产品生命成熟期

syn: adj. [农学][地质]成熟的；充分考虑的；到期的；成年人的：developed, adult, due
vi. [农学][地质]成熟；到期：age, flower
rm: 自然(nature)中的n更换成m就是成熟的(mature)

t: vt. 减轻， 缓解， 缓和
en: to make something less painful or difficult to deal with

ex.en: measures to alleviate poverty
ex.cn: 扶贫措施

syn: vt. 减轻，缓和：moderate, relax
rm: al + lev(轻) + iate → 减轻

t: n. 影响(力)，作用；v. 影响，对…起作用
en: the power to affect the way someone or something develops, behaves, or thinks, without using direct force or orders

ex.en: As a scientist, his influence was immense.
ex.cn: 身为一名科学家，他的影响力极大。

syn: n. 影响；势力；感化；有影响的人或事：effect, infection, impression, affection, incidence
vt. 影响；改变：affect, impact of, impact on, reach, fashion

t: n. 模糊； 费解； 不出名

ex.en: obscurities in the text
ex.cn: 文中的难解之处

syn: n. 朦胧；阴暗；晦涩；身份低微；不分明：nebulosity, shadowiness
rm: 来自obscure(a. 朦胧的， 模糊的)

t: n. 百分比， 百分率
en: an amount expressed as if it is part of a total which is 100

ex.en: Interest rates fell by six percentage points (= 6% ) .
ex.cn: 利息下降了6个百分点。

ex.en: The numbers are small in percentage terms (= when calculated as a percentage ) .
ex.cn: 按百分比来看，这些数字很小。

syn: n. [数]百分比；百分率，百分数：centage
rm: percent(百分比) + age(集体名词后缀) → 百分比， 百分率

t: adj. 事实的； 真实的， 确凿的
en: based on facts or relating to facts

ex.en: Try to keep your account of events as factual as possible.
ex.cn: 你要尽量如实地说明情况。

syn: adj. 事实的；真实的：actual, sincere, true, real, positive
rm: fact(事实) + ual → 事实的； 真实的

t: v. 洽谈， 协商； 商定， 达成； 顺利通过
en: to discuss something in order to reach an agreement, especially in business or politics

ex.en: His first aim is to get the warring parties back to the negotiating table (= discussing something ).
ex.cn: 他的首要目标就是把交战各方拉回到谈判桌上。

syn: vt. 谈判，商议；转让；越过：transfer, surmount
vi. 谈判，交涉：transact

t: n. 推测， 思索； 投机活动， 投机买卖
en: when you guess about the possible causes or effects of something without knowing all the facts, or the guesses that you make

ex.en: The witness’s statement was pure speculation (= not based on any facts ) .
ex.cn: 这名证人的陈述纯粹是猜测。

syn: n. 投机；推测；思索；投机买卖：theory, guess, projection

t: n. 危机； 紧要关头， 关键阶段
en: a situation in which there are a lot of problems that must be dealt with quickly so that the situation does not get worse or more dangerous

ex.en: The country now faces an economic crisis .
ex.cn: 该国目前正面临一场经济危机。

ex.en: The Prime Minister was criticized for the way in which he handled the crisis .
ex.cn: 首相处理危机的方式遭到了批评。

ph.cn: 危机管理，处理危急的办法

syn: n. 危机；危险期；决定性时刻：defining moment, critical stage
rm: cri(看作cry， 哭) + sis(看作sos， 求救信号) → 哭喊着求救 → 危机

t: n. 市场， 集市
en: the part of business activity that is concerned with buying and selling goods in competition with other companies

ex.en: Some retailers worry that new regulations will hurt their ability to compete in the marketplace.
ex.cn: 有些零售商担心新规定会削弱他们的市场竞争力。

syn: n. 市场；商场；市集：exchanges, plaza, fair
rm: market(市场) + place(地点， 场所) → 市场

t: n. 瘾； 沉溺
en: the need to take a harmful drug regularly, without being able to stop

ex.en: She helped him fight his drug addiction.
ex.cn: 她帮助了他对抗自己的毒瘾。

syn: n. 上瘾，沉溺；[内科]癖嗜：addicted to, indulgence

t: n. 邮政编码
en: a group of numbers and letters that you write at the end of an address on an envelope, package etc. The postcode shows the exact area where someone lives and helps the post office deliver the post more quickly.

ex.en: Type your street address and postcode.
ex.cn: 键入你的街道地址和邮政编码。

syn: n. （英）邮政编码；邮区号：zip code, postal code

t: n. 微生物， 细菌； 起源， 萌芽
en: a very small living thing that can make you ill

ex.en: Put disinfectant down the toilet to kill any germs.
ex.cn: 在抽水马桶里投放消毒剂杀菌。

ph.cn: [比喻]处于初级阶段，处于萌芽阶段

syn: n. [植]胚芽，萌芽；[微]细菌：seed, plantule
vi. 萌芽：burgeon, spring up
rm: 本身是词根， 意为“芽” → 微生物， 细菌

t: v. 破碎， 碎裂； 给予极大打击
en: to break suddenly into very small pieces, or to make something break in this way

ex.en: The explosion shattered the building.
ex.cn: 这次爆炸把大楼炸成一片废墟。

syn: vt. 粉碎；打碎；破坏；破掉；使散开：destroy, comminute
vi. 粉碎；损坏；落叶：size reduction, out of action
rm: “筛它” → (使)破碎

t: n. 苔藓
en: a very small green plant that grows in a thick soft furry mass on wet soil, trees, or rocks

ex.en: ...ground covered over with moss.
ex.cn: …长满青苔的地面。

ph.cn: 凯特·摩斯（英国超级模特）

syn: n. [植]苔藓；泥沼：mire

t: vt. 瞥见；n. 一瞥， 一看
en: to see someone or something for a moment without getting a complete view of them

ex.en: I glimpsed a figure at the window.
ex.cn: 我瞥见窗前有个身影。

syn: n. 一瞥，一看：glance, dekko
vi. 瞥见：catch sight of
rm: glim(灯光) + pse → 像灯光一闪 → 一瞥

t: adj. 侦探的；n. 侦探
en: A detective novel or story is one in which a detective tries to solve a crime

ex.en: ...Arthur Conan Doyle's classic detective novel.
ex.cn: …阿瑟·柯南·道尔的经典侦探小说。

syn: n. 侦探：tec, hawkshaw

t: v. 搬， 转移； 调动， 转学； 转让， 过户； 转车， 换乘；n. 转移； 调动； 转车， 换乘
en: to move from one place, school, job etc to another, or to make someone do this, especially within the same organization

ex.en: He was transferred for a fee of £8 million.
ex.cn: 他以800万英镑的转会费转到了其他球队。

ph.cn: 质量传递，传质；质量转移

syn: n. 转让；[计]转移；传递；过户：negotiation, diversion
vi. 转让；[计]转移；转学；换车：make over, dispose of
rm: trans(穿过， 越过) + fer(带来) → 转移； 调动

t: adj. 自杀的； 有自杀倾向的
en: wanting to kill yourself

ex.en: She was depressed and almost suicidal.
ex.cn: 她很抑郁，几乎想自杀。

ex.en: For many years before treatment, Clare had suicidal tendencies (= behaviour that showed she wanted to kill herself ) .
ex.cn: 在治疗前的许多年里，克莱尔都有自杀倾向。

syn: adj. 自杀的，自杀性的；自我毁灭的；自取灭亡的：banzai
rm: sui(自己) ＋ cid(杀) + al(形容词后缀) → 自杀(性)的

t: n. 神经； 勇敢
en: nerves are parts inside your body which look like threads and carry messages between the brain and other parts of the body

ex.en: a condition which affects the nerves in the back
ex.cn: 影响背部神经的疾病

syn: n. [解剖]神经；勇气；[植]叶脉：courage, heart
vt. 鼓起勇气：take courage, get up the courage
rm: nerv(体力； 神经； 勇气) + e → 神经； 勇敢

t: n. 转向， 转移， 转换； 转移视线的事物； 娱乐
en: a change in the direction or use of something, or the act of changing it

ex.en: Two prisoners created a diversion to give the men time to escape.
ex.cn: 两名囚犯想办法分散了大家的注意力，使那些人有时间逃跑。

syn: n. 转移；消遣；分散注意力：entertainment, transfer, occupation, recreation, metastasis
rm: di(分离) + vers(转) + ion → 转向， 转移， 转换

t: v&n. 重修， 补考
en: to take an examination again, because you failed it or did not do well enough

ex.en: Those who fail can resit the exam in 60 days.
ex.cn: 考试不及格的人可以在60天后重考。

syn: vt. （英）重考；补考：reexamine
n. 补考；重考：make-up examination, supplementary examination

t: adj. 错误的， 不正确的
en: erroneous ideas or information are wrong and based on facts that are not correct

ex.en: His economic predictions are based on some erroneous assumptions.
ex.cn: 他的经济预测是基于错误假设之上的。

syn: adj. 错误的；不正确的：false, wrong, improper, incorrect, inaccurate
rm: err(徘徊) + oneous → 在正确事物旁边徘徊 → 错误的， 不正确的

t: v. 躺在…上面； 置于…上面
en: to lie over something

ex.en: Clay overlies chalk in the southern mountains.
ex.cn: 在南部山脉，黏土层覆在白垩层之上。

rm: over (在…之上) + lie(躺；放) → 躺在…上面； 置于…上面

t: n. 限制； 局限
en: the act or process of controlling or reducing something

ex.en: a nuclear limitation treaty
ex.cn: 核限制条约

syn: n. 限制；限度；极限；追诉时效；有效期限：restriction, threshold, qualification, terminal
rm: limit(限制) + ation → 限制； 局限

t: n. 发起者，赞助人，主办者；主顾；vt. 发起， 主办； 赞助， 资助； 惠顾
en: a person or company that pays for a show, broadcast, sports event etc, especially in exchange for the right to advertise at that event

ex.en: corporate sponsors
ex.cn: 企业赞助商

syn: n. 赞助者；主办者；保证人：friend, guarantee, entrepreneur
vt. 赞助；发起：launch, support of
rm: spons(看作spoon， 勺子) ＋ or(表人) → 揭勺而起者 → 发起者

t: vt. 使恐怖， 使惊吓
en: to make someone extremely afraid

ex.en: Her husband’s violence terrified her.
ex.cn: 丈夫的暴力行为让她感到害怕。

syn: vt. 恐吓；使恐怖；使害怕：gallow, intimidate

t: vt. 弄清， 查明； 确定
en: to find out something

ex.en: A postmortem was ordered to try to ascertain the cause of death.
ex.cn: 下令验尸以查明死因。

syn: vt. 确定；查明；探知：confirm, identify, assure oneself
rm: as + cert(确定) + ain → 弄清， 查明； 确定

t: v. 插入， 嵌入
en: to put something inside or into something else

ex.en: He took a small key from his pocket and slowly inserted it into the lock.
ex.cn: 他从衣袋里掏出一把小钥匙，然后缓缓地将其插入锁孔里。

syn: vt. 插入；[建]嵌入：bed, build in
n. [建]插入物：inlet, impaler
rm: in(进入) + sert(放置) → 放进去 → 插入， 嵌入

t: adj. 气候的
en: relating to the weather in a particular area

ex.en: climatic conditions
ex.cn: 气候情况

t: n. 启示， 灵感； 鼓舞人心的人， 激励
en: a good idea about what you should do, write, say etc, especially one which you get suddenly

ex.en: The Malvern Hills have provided inspiration for many artists and musicians over the decades.
ex.cn: 几十年来，莫尔文丘陵为很多艺术家和音乐家提供了灵感。

ex.en: He raised his eyes to the altar as if seeking inspiration.
ex.cn: 他抬头看看祭坛，似乎在寻求灵感。

syn: n. 灵感；鼓舞；[生理]吸气；妙计：stimulation, afflatus
rm: in(进入) + spir(呼吸) + ation → 吸入灵气 → 灵感

t: adj. 生殖的， 生产的； 有生产能力的
en: able to produce something

ex.en: the generative power of the life force
ex.cn: 生命力的生成能力

syn: adj. 生殖的；生产的；有生殖力的；有生产力的：productive, reproductive

t: vt. 强调，突出；以强烈光线照射；集中注意力于；n. 最精彩的部分， 最重要的事件
en: to make a problem or subject easy to notice so that people pay attention to it

ex.en: Your résumé should highlight your skills and achievements.
ex.cn: 你的简历应该突出自己的技能和成绩。

syn: vt. 突出；强调；使显著；加亮：emphasize, stress
n. 最精彩的部分；最重要的事情；[电子]加亮区：first thing
rm: high(高的) + light(发光) → 高调地发光 → 强调， 突出

t: n. 龟， 陆龟； 行动迟缓的人
en: a slow-moving land animal that can pull its head and legs into the hard round shell that covers its body

ph.cn: 龟甲；一种类似龟甲的蝴蝶

syn: n. [脊椎]龟，乌龟（等于testudo）；迟缓的人：turtle, chelonian

t: n. 管理者， 管理人员； 行政人员
en: someone whose job involves managing the work of a company or organization

ex.en: On Friday the company's administrators sought permission from a Melbourne court to keep operating.
ex.cn: 在星期五，该公司的管理人员们从一家墨尔本法院取得了继续经营的许可。

ph.cn: 数据库管理员；数据库管理程序

syn: n. [管理]管理人；行政官：supervisor, conductor

t: n. 数据库
en: a large amount of data stored in a computer system so that you can find and use it easily

ex.en: customer details held on a database
ex.cn: 存储在数据库内的客户详细信息

ph.cn: 数据库系统；资料库系统
数据库管理，资料库管理

syn: n. [计]数据库，资料库：dbase, informix
rm: data(数据) + base(基础) → 数据库

t: adj. 不透气的， 不新鲜的， 不通风的； 乏味的
en: a room or building that is stuffy does not have enough fresh air in it

ex.en: It’s getting stuffy in here – do you mind if I open the window?
ex.cn: 这里越来越闷了，我开开窗行吗？

syn: adj. 闷热的；古板的；不通气的：sweltering, sultry
rm: stuff(填进) + y → 填得满满当当的， 很闷 → 不透气的

t: vt. 拒绝['riːdʒ3kt]；n. 被拒货品， 不合格品
en: to refuse to accept, believe in, or agree with something

ex.en: Sarah rejected her brother’s offer of help.
ex.cn: 萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。

ex.en: Dexter flatly rejected (= completely rejected ) calls for his resignation.
ex.cn: 德克斯特断然拒绝让他辞职的要求。

syn: vt. 拒绝；排斥；抵制；丢弃：refuse, negative
n. 被弃之物或人；次品：inferior, degraded product
rm: re(反) + ject(扔) → 被扔回来 → 拒绝

t: adj. 十足的； 纯粹的 ； 陡峭的
en: a sheer drop, cliff, slope etc is very steep and almost vertical

ex.en: I’ll never forget the look of sheer joy on her face.
ex.cn: 我永远也不会忘记她满脸喜悦的神情。

syn: adj. 绝对的；透明的；峻峭的：strict, absolute, transparent, positive, crystal
adv. 完全；陡峭地：very, quite a
rm: she(她) + er(表人) → 她是个十足的女人 → 十足的

t: n. 奇迹； 奇事
en: something very lucky or very good that happens which you did not expect to happen or did not think was possible

ex.en: It’s a miracle you weren’t killed!
ex.cn: 你没有死真是奇迹！

ex.en: By some miracle, we managed to catch the plane.
ex.cn: 我们奇迹般地赶上了飞机。

ph.cn: 奇妙地；好得不可思议；好到惊人程度；完全地

syn: n. 奇迹，奇迹般的人或物；惊人的事例：phenomenon, wonder
rm: mir(惊奇) + acle(表物) → 奇迹； 奇事

t: n. 模仿； 仿造； 仿制品， 假货， 赝品
en: when you copy someone else’s actions

ex.en: The remake of ‘Casablanca’ was a pale imitation (= something that is much less good than the thing it imitates ) of the original movie.
ex.cn: 重拍的《卡萨布兰卡》远不如原版。

syn: n. 模仿，仿造；仿制品：simulation, mimicry
adj. 人造的，仿制的：artificial, synthetic

t: n. 赞美；
en: a remark that shows you admire someone or something

ex.en: All the guests paid her extravagant compliments.
ex.cn: 所有客人都对她赞不绝口。

ex.en: Being compared to Abba is a great compliment.
ex.cn: 能和阿巴乐队相提并论是极大的赞誉。

ph.cn: 言不由衷(或挖苦人)的恭维话

syn: n. 恭维；称赞；问候；致意；道贺：praise, regard
vt. 恭维；称赞：speak well of, pay a tribute to
rm: com(共同) + pli(满， 填满) + ment(名词后缀) → 一起满足某人的愿望 → 赞美

t: v. 有利于； 获益；n. 利润；益处
en: to be useful or helpful to someone

ex.en: No one was profiting inordinately from the war effort.
ex.cn: 没有人在从战争中发大财。

syn: n. [会计]利润；利益：behalf, margin, benefit, gain, sake
vi. 获利；有益：advantage, gain

t: vi. 合计；n. 总额
en: If something amounts to a particular total, all the parts of it add up to that total

ex.en: Consumer spending on sports-related items amounted to $9.75 billion.
ex.cn: 消费者在体育相关用品上的消费总共达到了97.5亿美元。

syn: vi. [会计]总计，合计；相当于；[数]共计；产生…结果：foot, gross total
n. 数量；总额，[数]总数：sum, quantity of, gross, total

t: vi. 遵从； 服从
en: to do what you have to do or are asked to do

ex.en: The newspaper was asked by federal agents for assistance and agreed to comply.
ex.cn: 联邦探员要求这家报社给予协助，报社同意配合。

syn: vi. 遵守；顺从，遵从；答应：engage, abide by/obey/observe
rm: com(表加强) + ply(装满) → 完全装满 → 完全满足 → 遵从； 服从

t: adj. 最初的，原始的；新颖的，有独创性的；n. 原物， 原作
en: existing or happening first, before other people or things

ex.en: The land was returned to its original owner.
ex.cn: 这块土地归还给了原主。

ex.en: The kitchen still has many original features (= parts that were there when the house was first built ).
ex.cn: 这间厨房仍保留着当初的许多特点。

syn: n. [摄]原件；原作；[经]原物；原型：archetype, antitype
adj. [摄]原始的；最初的；独创的；新颖的：initial, premier, primitive

t: n. 任务， 工作
en: a piece of work that is given to someone as part of their job

ex.en: a history assignment
ex.cn: 历史作业

ph.cn: 指派问题；分配问题；分派问题；配置问题
转让方法；指定分配方法

syn: n. 分配；任务；作业；功课：allocation, distribution, role, mission, task
rm: 来自assign(vt. 指派， 分配)

t: vi. 不同， 相异； 发生分歧
en: if two people or groups differ about something, they have opposite opinions

ex.en: The two systems differ in many respects.
ex.cn: 这两个系统在许多方面不同。

ph.cn: 不同在；在…方面存在不同

syn: vi. 相异；意见分歧：divide

t: n. 门诊部， 诊所
en: a place, often in a hospital, where medical treatment is given to people who do not need to stay in the hospital

ex.en: an appointment at an outpatient clinic
ex.cn: 门诊预约
