ex.en: There is a leak in the ceiling.
ex.cn: 天花板上有条裂缝。

ex.en: The boat had sprung a leak (= a hole had appeared in it ).
ex.cn: 小船出现了漏洞。

syn: n. 泄漏；漏洞，裂缝：crack, split
vt. 使渗漏，泄露：reveal, divulge
rm: 湖(lake)面上的船漏出(leak)很多油

t: n. 缺点； 瑕疵
en: a mistake, mark, or weakness that makes something imperfect

ex.en: A design flaw (= a mistake or weakness in the way something was made ) caused the engine to explode.
ex.cn: 一个设计缺陷导致了引擎爆炸。

syn: n. 瑕疵，裂纹；缺点；一阵狂风：checking, defect, deficiency, vice, fault
vt. 使无效；使破裂，使有缺陷：crack, fracture

t: v. 以…为特色； 由…主演； 占重要地位；n. 特征，特色；
en: to include or show something as a special or important part of something, or to be included as an important part

ex.en: The exhibition features paintings by Picasso.
ex.cn: 这次展览重点展出毕加索的画作。

ex.en: a cruise ship featuring extensive spa facilities
ex.cn: 以大量水疗设施为特色的邮轮

ph.cn: 主要特征；主要特点；主景；功能特点

syn: n. 特色，特征；容貌；特写或专题节目：person, characteristic
vt. 特写；以…为特色；由…主演：star
rm: 我的未来(future)由我主演(feature)

t: v. 断言， 声称； 坚持
en: to state firmly that something is true

ex.en: French cooking, she asserted, is the best in the world.
ex.cn: 她坚称法国菜是世界上最好的。

ph.cn: 坚持自己的权利或意见

syn: vt. 维护，坚持；断言；主张；声称：maintain, say, submit, stay, advocate
rm: as(表加强) + sert(放置) → 强行放入 → 断言

t: adj. 平的；固定的；n. 单元住宅
en: smooth and level, without raised or hollow areas, and not sloping or curving

ex.en: houses with flat roofs
ex.cn: 平顶房

ex.en: a perfectly flat sandy beach
ex.cn: 十分平坦的沙滩

ph.cn: v. 竭尽全力；用全速；疲惫

syn: adj. 平坦的；扁平的；浅的；单调的：even, low, level, shallow, blank
adv. 平直地；断然地：positively, emphatically
rm: 菜不放盐(salt)味道平平(flat)

t: n. 跳跃；
en: a big jump

ex.en: He threw a stick into the river and the dog went after it in a flying leap.
ex.cn: 他把一根枝条扔到河里，那条狗一个飞跃就追了过去。

ph.cn: adv. 飞跃地，突飞猛进地

syn: vi. 跳，跳跃：jump, dance
n. 飞跃；跳跃：jump, spring, bound

t: adj. 失礼的， 无礼的
en: If you are disrespectful, you show no respect in the way that you speak or behave to someone

ex.en: ...accusations that he had been disrespectful to a police officer.
ex.cn: ...关于他曾对一名警官无礼的控告。

syn: adj. 无礼的；失礼的；不尊敬的：rude, offensive

t: v. 拍打；拍动；n. 薄片； 封盖； 振动； 激动
en: If you flap your arms, you move them quickly up and down as if they were the wings of a bird

ex.en: ...a kid running and flapping her arms.
ex.cn: …一个边跑边像小鸟一样上下扇动着双臂的小女孩。

syn: n. 拍打，拍打声；[航]副翼：aileron
vi. 拍动；鼓翼而飞；（帽边等）垂下：hang
rm: f(看作fly， 飞) + lap(拍打) → 拍动

t: adj. 黄铜制的， 黄铜色的； 厚颜无耻的
en: used to describe a person, or the actions of a person, who is not embarrassed about behaving in a wrong or immoral way

ex.en: her brazen admission that she was cheating on him
ex.cn: 她恬不知耻地承认自己对他不忠

syn: adj. 厚颜无耻的；黄铜制的：as bold as brass, bold-faced

t: adj. 不合理的，不合逻辑的，荒谬的；n. 无理数
en: not based on clear thought or reason

ex.en: an irrational fear of flying
ex.cn: 对飞行非理性的恐惧

ex.en: He’s becoming increasingly irrational.
ex.cn: 他变得越来越不可理喻了。

syn: adj. 不合理的；无理性的；荒谬的：unreasonable, reasonless
n. [数]无理数：surd
rm: ir(不) + rational(合理的) → 不合理的

t: adj. 美丽如画的； 生动的
en: a picturesque place is pretty and interesting in an old-fashioned way

ex.en: a quiet fishing village with a picturesque harbour
ex.cn: 拥有一座美丽港口的宁静渔村

syn: adj. 独特的；生动的；别致的；图画般的：unique, distinct, individual, telling, live

t: adj. 冰期的； 冰川的； 寒冷的， 冰冷的； 冷若冰霜的
en: relating to ice and glaciers, or formed by glaciers

ex.en: a glacial valley
ex.cn: 冰川谷

ex.en: glacial deposits
ex.cn: 冰川沉积

syn: adj. [地质]冰的；冰冷的；冰河时代的：ice, icy
rm: glac(冰) + ial → 冰期的

t: n. 反对； 反对的理由
en: a reason that you have for opposing or disapproving of something, or something you say that expresses this

ex.en: Her objection was that he was too young.
ex.cn: 她反对的理由是他太小。

syn: n. 异议，反对；缺陷，缺点；妨碍；拒绝的理由：opposition, exception, intervention, prevention, deficiency

t: v. 对…表示异议； 争论， 争吵；n. 争论，争端，争吵
en: to say that something such as a fact or idea is not correct or true

ex.en: The main facts of the book have never been disputed.
ex.cn: 书中的主要事实从未遭到质疑。

syn: vt. 辩论；怀疑；阻止；抗拒：discuss, debate, argue, stem, block
vi. 争论：debate, argue with
rm: dis(分开) + put(思考) + e → 分开思考 → 争论， 争吵

t: n. 观察， 观测； 监视； 评述， 评论
en: the process of watching something or someone carefully for a period of time

ex.en: He spent two nights under close observation in hospital.
ex.cn: 他在医院接受了两个晚上的严密观察。

ex.en: His orders were to keep the men under observation.
ex.cn: 他下的命令是监视这些人。

syn: n. 观察；监视；观察报告：view, monitoring, surveillance, watch
rm: ob(表加强) + serv(维持) + ation → 观测； 监视

t: v. 建议， 提出； 暗示
en: to tell someone your ideas about what they should do, where they should go etc

ex.en: The zoo asked its visitors to suggest a name for the new baby panda.
ex.cn: 动物园请游客提建议，给刚出生的大熊猫起一个名字。

ex.en: It has been suggested that the manager will resign if any more players are sold.
ex.cn: 有人提议，如果再有球员被出售，球队主教练就辞职。

syn: vt. 提议，建议；启发；使人想起：vote, advise

t: n. 领导；铅；导线；榜样；vt. 领导；致使；引导；指挥；vi. 领导；导致；用水砣测深；adj. 带头的；最重要的
en: if someone follows someone else’s lead, they do the same as the other person has done

ex.en: Other countries are likely to follow the U.S.’s lead.
ex.cn: 其他国家很可能会效法美国。

ex.en: The Government should give industry a lead in tackling racism (= show what other people should do ).
ex.cn: 政府在处理种族歧视问题上应该为企业树立榜样。

ph.cn: 领先；主要的；占主导地位的

syn: n. 领导；[化学]铅；导线；石墨；榜样：guidance, mirror, example
vt. 领导；致使；引导；指挥：aim, officer, captain, boss

t: n. 居民， 住户， 居住者； 栖息的动物
en: one of the people who live in a particular place

ex.en: a city of six million inhabitants
ex.cn: 有600万居民的城市

syn: n. 居民；居住者：liver, resident, dweller, habitant
rm: in(在里面) + hab(居住) + it + ant → 住在里面的人 → 居民， 居住者

t: n. 小部分， 片断
en: a part of a whole number in mathematics, such as ½ or ¾

ex.en: The students had a grasp of decimals, percentages and fractions.
ex.cn: 学生们掌握了小数、百分数和分数。

ph.cn: 体积分率，体积分数；容积率
一小部分；一部分；零点几

syn: n. [数]分数；部分；小部分；稍微：score, marks, proportion, part, portion
rm: fract(打碎) + ion → 碎的部分 → 小部分， 片断

t: v. 过滤； 走漏；n. 过滤器
en: to remove unwanted substances from water, air etc by passing it through a special substance or piece of equipment

ex.en: The water in the tank is constantly filtered.
ex.cn: 鱼缸里的水在不停地被过滤。

ex.en: The ozone layer filters harmful UV rays from the sun.
ex.cn: 臭氧层过滤掉有害的太阳紫外线。

syn: vi. 滤过；渗入；慢慢传开：sink in, seep into
n. [电子][光]滤波器；[轻][核][化工]过滤器；筛选；滤光器：strainer, percolator
rm: “非要它” → 香烟的过滤嘴是非要不可的 → 过滤器

t: n. 感情； 情绪
en: a strong human feeling such as love, hate, or anger

ex.en: Her voice was full of emotion.
ex.cn: 她的声音充满了激情。

ex.en: She was good at hiding her emotions.
ex.cn: 她很会掩饰自己的情感。

syn: n. [心理]情感；情绪：mood, will, spirit, affect, feeling
rm: e(出) + mot(动) + ion(名词后缀) → 心里释放出的东西 → 感情； 情绪

t: v. 停止， 终止
en: to stop doing something or stop happening

ex.en: The things people will do for charity never cease to amaze me (= I am always surprised by them ) .
ex.cn: 人们的慈善义举总是让我感到惊讶。

ex.en: The rain ceased and the sky cleared.
ex.cn: 雨过天晴。

syn: vi. 停止；终了：desist from, come to a stop
vt. 停止；结束：conclude, cheese, quit
rm: c + ease(安逸， 安心) → 生于忧患， 死于安乐 → 停止， 终止

t: vt. 评定； 估价
en: to make a judgment about a person or situation after thinking carefully about it

ex.en: The test was to assess aptitude rather than academic achievement.
ex.cn: 该测试将评估能力而不是学业成绩。

syn: vt. 评定；估价；对…征税：evaluate, rate, value, prize

t: n. 处方， 药方； 开处方， 开药方
en: a piece of paper on which a doctor writes what medicine a sick person should have, so that they can get it from a  pharmacist

ex.en: We are trying to cut the price of prescription drugs .
ex.cn: 我们正努力降低处方药的价格。

ex.en: a repeat prescription
ex.cn: 重复处方

ph.cn: 须医师处方才可买的药品

syn: n. [医]药方；指示；惯例：tradition, instruction, convention, usage, pointing
rm: pre(预先) + script(写) + ion → 预先把要抓的药写在方子上 → 药方

t: n. 观众； 旁观者
en: someone who is watching an event or game

ex.en: The match attracted over 40,000 spectators.
ex.cn: 这场比赛吸引了四万多名观众。

ph.cn: 吸引大量观众的体育运动

syn: n. 观众；旁观者：audience, onlooker
rm: spect(看) + ator → 观众； 旁观者

t: adj. 缺乏的， 不足的； 稀少的， 罕见的
en: if something is scarce, there is not very much of it available

ex.en: Food was often scarce in the winter.
ex.cn: 冬季常常粮食短缺。

ex.en: There was fierce competition for the scarce resources .
ex.cn: 对这些紧缺资源的争夺非常激烈。

syn: adj. 缺乏的，不足的；稀有的：rare, short, lacking, insufficient, deficient
adv. 仅仅；几乎不；几乎没有：merely, simply, just, only, but
rm: scar(伤疤) + ce → 有伤疤 → 美中不足 → 不足的

t: n. 争吵， 争论； 观点， 论据； 说理， 论证
en: a situation in which two or more people disagree, often angrily

ex.en: We need to provide a convincing argument as to why the system should be changed.
ex.cn: 我们得提出有说服力的论据，证明为何要改变体制。

ph.cn: 模板实参；范本自变量；模板参数

syn: n. 论证；论据；争吵；内容提要：brush, reasoning, dispute

t: adj. 充足的； 合适的， 合格的
en: enough in quantity or of a good enough quality for a particular purpose

ex.en: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
ex.cn: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

ex.en: Some creams we tested failed to give adequate protection against UV light.
ex.cn: 我们检测的有些防晒霜不能提供足够的防紫外线保护。

ph.cn: 胜任……的；对……是足够的；适合……的

syn: adj. 充足的；适当的；胜任的：suitable, competent, appropriate, proper, becoming
rm: ad(表加强) + equ(平等) + ate → 比平等多的 → 充足的

t: n. 所有动物
en: all the animals living in a particular area or period in history

ex.en: ...the flora and fauna of the African jungle.
ex.cn: …非洲丛林的植物群和动物群。

syn: n. 动物群；[动]动物区系：zoology
rm: 来自Fannus(潘纳斯， 罗马神话中的动物之神)

t: n. 香肠
en: a small tube of skin filled with a mixture of meat, spices etc, eaten hot or cold after it has been cooked

ex.en: pork sausages
ex.cn: 猪肉香肠

syn: n. [食品]香肠；腊肠；装香肠的碎肉：wust, wurst

t: n. 胎儿； 胚胎
en: a baby or young animal before it is born

ex.en: Perhaps we are really talking about amniotic fluid, which surrounds the foetus in the birth sac.
ex.cn: 也许我们真正在谈论的是羊水，也就是包围着胎儿的那些液体。

ex.en: In this chapter we will look at what happens when a human foetus receives too much or too little male hormone.
ex.cn: 在这一章里，我们将看看当一个人类胎儿接收了过多或过少的雄性激素会发生什么。

syn: n. 胎儿：fetus, homunculi
rm: foe(敌人) + t(看作to) + us(我们) → 对我们来说， 胎儿是自由的敌人 → 胎儿； 胚胎

t: adj. 极大的， 巨大的； 非常的， 惊人的
en: very big, fast, powerful etc

ex.en: Suddenly, there was a tremendous bang, and the whole station shook.
ex.cn: 突然一声巨响，整个车站都晃动了。

ex.en: She was making a tremendous effort to appear calm.
ex.cn: 她竭力表现出平静的样子。

syn: adj. 极大的，巨大的；惊人的：huge, enormous, massive, macro, vast
rm: trem(害怕) + end + ous(多…的) → (多得、 好得)让人害怕 的 → 非常的， 惊人的

t: v. 逐步增长或发展， 逐步升级
en: if fighting, violence, or a bad situation escalates, or if someone escalates it, it becomes much worse

ex.en: The fighting on the border is escalating.
ex.cn: 边境地区的战事在不断升级。

ex.en: We do not want to escalate the war.
ex.cn: 我们不想让战争升级。

rm: 来自Escalator， 原来是自动电梯的商标， 后来才出现了动词escalate

t: v. 压缩， 精简； 凝结
en: if a gas condenses, or is condensed, it becomes a liquid

ex.en: the mist which condensed on every cold surface
ex.cn: 每个冰冷的表面上凝结的水汽

syn: vi. 浓缩；凝结：concentrate, to freeze
vt. 使浓缩；使压缩：dewater, inspissate
rm: con + dense(密集的) → 变得密集的 → (使)压缩

t: n. 标签
en: a small piece of paper, cloth, plastic etc that sticks out from the edge of something, so that you can find it more easily

ex.en: an index tab labeled ‘Expenses’
ex.cn: 标着“支出”字样的检索标签

syn: n. 标签；制表；帐单：ticket, label, tag, prepared by

t: vt. 使绕道， 转移； 娱乐， 供消遣
en: if you divert your telephone calls, you arrange for them to go directly to another number, for example because you are not able to answer them yourself for some time

ex.en: Remember to divert your phone when you are out of the office.
ex.cn: 你不在办公室的时候要记得设定电话转移。

ph.cn: 把注意力从…转移开来；分散注意力

syn: vt. 转移；使…欢娱；使…转向：shift, distract from
vi. 转移：transfer, metastasize
rm: di(分离) + vert(转) → 转移

t: n. 正义， 公正； 司法
en: the quality of being right and deserving fair treatment

ex.en: No one doubts the justice of our cause.
ex.cn: 没有人怀疑我们的事业是正义的。

syn: n. 司法，法律制裁；正义；法官，[法]审判员：judge, right, judicature
rm: just(正确的) + ice → 正义， 公正

t: n. 标签；
en: a small piece of paper, plastic etc attached to something to show what it is, who owns it, what it costs etc

ex.en: Staff wore name tags and called inmates by their first names.
ex.cn: 工作人员戴着姓名标签，对同僚直呼其名。

syn: n. 标签；名称；结束语；附属物：name, ticket, label, belonging
vt. 尾随，紧随；连接；起浑名；添饰：dog, shadow, couple
rm: 在包(bag)上贴标签(tag)

t: n. 营火
en: a fire made outdoors by people who are camping

ex.en: We are sitting by the campfire.
ex.cn: 我们正坐在营火旁。

ex.en: The black soot deposited on a kettle by a smoky campfire is nearly pure carbon.
ex.cn: 带烟的营火在水壶上熏积的黑煤烟几乎是纯碳。

syn: n. 营火；营火会：bonfire
rm: camp(露营， 宿营) + fire(火) → 营火

t: adj. 狂怒的； 激烈的
en: very angry

ex.en: She was absolutely furious .
ex.cn: 她怒不可遏。

syn: adj. 激烈的；狂怒的；热烈兴奋的；喧闹的：acute, stinging

t: n. 摄政者
en: someone who governs instead of a king or queen, because the king or queen is ill, absent, or still a child
syn: n. 摄政王；摄政者；州立大学董事会董事；统治者：governor, ruler
adj. 摄政的；统治的：ruling, dominant
rm: reg(统治) + ent(表人) → 统治者 → 摄政者

t: v. 晒成棕褐色， 晒黑； 硝；n. 棕褐色；晒黑
en: if you tan, or if the sun tans you, your skin becomes darker because you spend time in the sun

ex.en: She has a pale skin which doesn’t tan easily.
ex.cn: 她的肤色很白，不容易被晒黑。

syn: n. 棕褐色；[皮革]鞣料；马戏团：circus, Circus Troupe
adj. 黄褐色的；鞣皮的：fulvous, snuffcoloured

t: v. 轻拍； 利用， 开发
en: to use or take what is needed from something such as an energy supply or an amount of money

ex.en: People are tapping into the power supply illegally.
ex.cn: 人们在非法取电。

ex.en: We hope that additional sources of funding can be tapped.
ex.cn: 我们希望还有其他资金来源可以利用。

syn: vt. 轻敲；轻打；装上嘴子：percuss
vi. 轻拍；轻击；轻叩：pat

t: adj. 个别的，单独的；独特的；n. 个人， 个体
en: considered separately from other people or things in the same group

ex.en: Each individual leaf on the tree is different.
ex.cn: 树上每片叶子都不相同。

ex.en: the needs of the individual customer
ex.cn: 每位顾客的需求

syn: adj. [经]个人的；个别的；独特的：personal, different, subjective, distinct, unique
n. [经]个人，[生物]个体：unity, private person
rm: in + divid(e)(分割) + ual → 分割开的 → 个别的， 单独的

t: n. 公文包
en: a flat case used especially by business people for carrying papers or documents

ex.en: No one told me about any briefcase.
ex.cn: 没有人和我提过什么公文包。

ex.en: If you ask about my impression on him, I feel he looks like a typical businessman, you know, dark suit and briefcase.
ex.cn: 如果你问我对他的印象如何，我感觉他看起来像是个典型的商人，你知道，黑西装和公文包的那种。

syn: n. 公文包：portfolio, attache case
rm: brief(简捷的) + case(手提箱) → 简捷的手提箱 → 公文包

t: adj. 本能的
en: instinctive

ex.en: The relationship between a parent and a child is instinctual and stems from basic human nature.
ex.cn: 父母与孩子之间的关系是本能的，源于人类的本性。

syn: adj. [生物]本能的：involantary, libidinal

t: vt. 迫使； 约束
en: To constrain someone or something means to limit their development or force them to behave in a particular way

ex.en: Women are too often constrained by family commitments and by low expectations.
ex.cn: 女性往往受家庭职责及低期望值约束。

syn: vt. 驱使；强迫；束缚：chain, bound, force, provoke, enforce
rm: con(表加强) + strain(拉紧) → 约束

t: n. 激动； 兴奋； 令人兴奋的事
en: the feeling of being excited

ex.en: We were both new to the excitements of life in the big city.
ex.cn: 我们俩都是初次感受大城市多姿多彩的生活。

syn: n. 兴奋；刺激；令人兴奋的事物：stimulus, incentive, needle
rm: ex (出) + cit(激起， 召唤) + e + ment(名词后缀) → 激动， 兴奋

t: n. 提供消息或情报的人， 线人； 提供资料的人
en: someone who secretly gives the police, the army etc information about someone else

ex.en: One of the witnesses was a paid informant for the FBI.
ex.cn: 目击者之一是联邦调查局出钱雇用的线人。

syn: n. 被调查者；告密者；提供消息者：tattletale, beefer

t: n. 蓝图； 方案
en: a plan for achieving something

ex.en: By changing the tomato’s genetic blueprint , scientists can alter the rate at which it ripens.
ex.cn: 科学家可以通过改变番茄的基因蓝图来改变它的成熟速度。

syn: vt. 计划；制成蓝图：schedule, design, map, propose, project
n. [印刷]蓝图，设计图；计划：plan, scheme, programme, project
rm: blue(蓝) + print(印刷的图) → 蓝图

t: adj. 野蛮的， 粗鲁的； 残暴的， 残忍的； 原始部落的
en: very cruel and violent

ex.en: The way the whales are killed is nothing short of barbaric.
ex.cn: 对鲸的捕杀方式简直就是野蛮。

syn: adj. 野蛮的，粗野的；原始的：wild, robust, gross, rough, country
rm: barbar(外来者) + ic(形容词后缀) → 外来者的 → 野蛮的， 粗鲁的； 残忍的

t: vt. 实施， 执行； 强制， 迫使
en: to make people obey a rule or law

ex.en: Parking restrictions will be strictly enforced.
ex.cn: 停车限制将会严格执行。

syn: vt. 实施，执行；强迫，强制：perform, actualize
rm: en(使…) + force(强迫) → 强制， 迫使

t: n&vi. 闪光
en: to shine brightly with flashing points of light

ex.en: The river glittered in the sunlight.
ex.cn: 阳光下河面波光粼粼。

syn: vi. [光]闪光；闪烁：flare light, lightning flash
n. [光]闪光；灿烂：stroboflash, coruscation
rm: g + litter(看作little， 小) → 一闪一闪小星星 → 闪光

t: adj. 脆弱的； 虚弱的； 易碎的； 易受伤害的
en: easily broken or damaged

ex.en: Be careful with that vase – it’s very fragile.
ex.cn: 小心那只花瓶——很容易打碎的。

ex.en: fragile bones
ex.cn: 脆弱的骨头

ph.cn: [精神病学]脆性X综合征；X染色体易损综合征

syn: adj. 脆的；易碎的：delicate, crumbly
rm: frag(打碎) + ile(易…的) → 容易被打碎的 → 脆弱的； 易碎的

t: n. 离开， 出发； 背离， 违反
en: an act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey

ex.en: There are several departures for New York every day.
ex.cn: 每天有好几个班次去纽约。

ph.cn: 出发时间；撤离时刻；起飞时刻

syn: n. 离开；出发；违背：leaving, starting, violation, breach, quit

t: adj. 需细心的，辛苦的，煞费苦心的；勤勉的；刻苦的；n. 辛苦； 勤勉； 刻苦
en: very careful and thorough

ex.en: The work had been done with painstaking attention to detail.
ex.cn: 这项工作被一丝不苟地完成了。

ex.en: Chris described in painstaking detail what had happened.
ex.cn: 克里斯非常详细地描述了所发生的事情。

syn: adj. 艰苦的；勤勉的；小心的：careful, tough, rough, diligent
n. 辛苦；勤勉：industry, diligence
rm: pains(痛苦) + taking(花费…的) → 煞费苦心的

t: adj. 发胖的， 肥胖的， 强壮的； 结实的， 牢固的； 顽强的， 坚毅的
en: fairly fat and heavy, or having a thick body

ex.en: a short, stout man
ex.cn: 一个矮胖的男人

syn: adj. 结实的；矮胖的；勇敢的；激烈的：acute, solid, firm, tough, game
n. 矮胖子；[食品]烈性啤酒：punchinello
rm: st(=stand站) + out(出来) → 歹徒行凶， 壮小伙站出来 → 强壮的

t: n. 社会学
en: the scientific study of societies and the behaviour of people in groups

ex.en: Basic courses in sociology and psychology as well as other humanities courses give students plenty of opportunity to explore their own emotions.
ex.cn: 社会学和心理学的基础，以及其他人文学科的课程，赋予学生大量的机会去探索其个人情感。

ex.en: The mistress hunters are mostly women and are all psychology, sociology or law graduates.
ex.cn: “情妇猎手”大多为女性，且都是心理学、社会学或法学的毕业生。

ph.cn: 经济社会学；社会经济学
城市社会学，都市社会学

syn: n. 社会学；群体生态学：demotics, synecology
rm: soci(同伴， 结交) + ology(…学) → 社会学

t: v. 逃走； 逃避
en: to leave somewhere very quickly, in order to escape from danger

ex.en: His attackers turned and fled.
ex.cn: 袭击他的人转身逃走了。

ex.en: Masaari spent six months in prison before fleeing the country .
ex.cn: 正有蹲了六个月监狱，然后逃出了该国。

syn: vi. 逃走；消失，消散：lift, disappear, blank
vt. 逃跑，逃走；逃避：escape, desert

t: adj. 巨大的， 庞大的
en: extremely big

ex.en: a gigantic skyscraper
ex.cn: 摩天大楼

syn: adj. 巨大的，庞大的：huge, enormous, tremendous, massive, macro
rm: gigant(＝giant 巨人) + ic → 巨大的

t: adj. 清楚的， 明显的； 有区别的， 不同的
en: clearly different or belonging to a different type

ex.en: two entirely distinct languages
ex.cn: 两种完全不同的语言

syn: adj. 明显的；独特的；清楚的；有区别的：obvious, visible, unique, evident, individual
rm: di + stinct(刺) → 刺眼的 → 明显的

t: n. 地质学； 地质概况
en: the study of the rocks, soil etc that make up the Earth, and of the way they have changed since the Earth was formed

ex.en: He was visiting professor of geology at the University of Georgia.
ex.cn: 他曾是佐治亚大学的地质学客座教授。

syn: n. [地质]地质学；地质情况：geologic map, geognosy
rm: geo(地球， 地) + logy(…学) → 地质学

t: vt. 调音；调节，
en: to make a musical instrument play at the right  pitch

ex.en: Someone’s coming tomorrow to tune the piano.
ex.cn: 明天有人来给钢琴调音。

ph.cn: 走调；不协调；（对某事）没有兴趣

syn: n. 曲调；和谐；心情：accordance, breast, air, concert
vt. 调整；使一致；为…调音：adjust, coordinate, accord, restructure
rm: 转动(turn)旋钮调音(tune)

t: adj. 知道的； 意识到的
en: if you are aware that a situation exists, you realize or know that it exists

ex.en: Mr Braley has been made aware of the need for absolute secrecy.
ex.cn: 布雷利先生被告知需要绝对保密。

ex.en: As you are aware, a fee will be charged annually.
ex.cn: 正如你所知道的那样，每年都要收取一笔费用。

syn: adj. 意识到的；知道的；有…方面知识的；懂世故的：conscious, sensible

t: n. 〔对物件起保护作用的〕罩，盖，套；v. 限制〔尤指金钱〕
en: a protective covering that you put on the end or top of an object

ex.en: Make sure you put the cap back on the pen.
ex.cn: 一定要把笔帽套上。

ex.en: a bottle cap
ex.cn: 瓶盖

syn: n. [机]盖；帽子：hat, operculum
vi. 脱帽致意：uncap

t: n. 奖；评判；
en: something such as a prize or money given to someone to reward them for something they have done

ex.en: The movie has won a number of awards.
ex.cn: 该片获得了多个奖项。

ex.en: an award-winning restaurant
ex.cn: 获奖餐厅

ph.cn: 奥斯卡金像奖；学院奖（美国电影艺术科学院颁发的年度奖项）

syn: vt. 授予；判定：grant, give
n. 奖品；判决：prize, sentence

t: adj. 符合条件的； 合适的
en: an eligible man or woman would be good to marry because they are rich, attractive, and not married

ex.en: Stephen was regarded as an eligible bachelor.
ex.cn: 斯蒂芬被认为是一个钻石王老五。

syn: adj. 合格的，合适的；符合条件的；有资格当选的：qualified, applicable, becoming, shaped, likely
n. 合格者；适任者；有资格者：acceptee
rm: e + lig(=lect选择) + ible → 能被选择出来的 → 符合条件的

t: n. 炉
en: a piece of kitchen equipment on which you cook food in pots and pans, and that contains an  oven

ex.en: a wood-burning stove
ex.cn: 烧木柴的火炉

syn: n. 火炉；[炉窑]窑；温室：furnace, greenhouse

t: n. 惊恐，恐慌；报警器；闹钟；警报；vt. 使惊恐； 使担心
en: a piece of equipment that makes a loud noise to warn you of danger

ex.en: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
ex.cn: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

ex.en: Car alarms are always going off in the street.
ex.cn: 街上总有汽车警报器在响。

syn: n. 警报，[安全]警告器；惊慌：panic, tocsin
vt. 警告；使惊恐：exercise, alert, warn
rm: al + arm(武器) → 受了惊吓， 拿起武器 → 惊恐

t: n. 评估， 评价
en: a statement or opinion judging the worth, value, or condition of something

ex.en: What is needed in such cases is a calm appraisal of the situation.
ex.cn: 在此类情况下需要的是对形势的冷静估计。

ph.cn: 房地产评估；不动产评估

syn: n. 评价；[经管]估价（尤指估价财产，以便征税）；[数]估计：evaluation, valuation, estimation, computation, assessment, calculation
rm: ap(给， 向) + prais(价格) + al → 给定价 → 评价

t: n. 杂草
en: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted that prevents crops or garden flowers from growing properly

ex.en: the constant battle against weeds
ex.cn: 对付杂草的长期斗争

ph.cn: 除草；杂草防除；野草控制

syn: vt. 除草；铲除：shovel
n. [植]杂草，野草；菸草：fireweed, ruderal

t: n. 冰川， 冰河
en: a large mass of ice which moves slowly down a mountain valley

ex.en: Do you think we can glide down this glacier?
ex.cn: 你觉得我们可以从冰河上滑行下去吗？

ex.en: An ice penetrating radar is deployed from a string of four kayaks to survey a section of the Petermann glacier in Greenland.
ex.cn: 一部冰透雷达安装在连成一串的四艘橡皮船上，用来考察格陵兰岛彼得曼冰川的一个截面。

ph.cn: 冰河国家公园；国家冰川公园（美国）

syn: n. 冰河，[地理][水文]冰川：ice floe
rm: glac(冰) + ier → 冰川， 冰河

t: adj. 顺利的； 流畅的； 协调的
en: happening or operating successfully, without any problems

ex.en: The new government has promised a smooth transition of power.
ex.cn: 新政府承诺保证政权的顺利交接。

ph.cn: 光滑表面；光滑面；平滑面
正常运转；平稳运转，稳定运转

syn: adj. 顺利的；光滑的；平稳的：glabrous, favourable
vt. 使光滑；消除（障碍等）；使优雅；缓和：eliminate, avoid, relax

t: n. 土方
en: a large long pile of earth, used in the past to stop attacks

ex.en: To pipe installation is complete and experience the qualified, conducted only after backfill earthwork.
ex.cn: 待涵管道安装完成并经验收合格后，方可进行土方回填。

ex.en: This paper states some treatment methods and relevant precautions of groundwater in earthwork construction.
ex.cn: 论述了在土方施工中几种地下水处理的方法及注意事项。

t: n. 定位； 方向， 方位； 情况介绍； 培训， 训练
en: a period of time during which people are trained and prepared for a new job or course of study

ex.en: This is orientation week for all the new students.
ex.cn: 这是让全体新生熟悉情况的迎新周。

syn: n. 方向；[测]定向；适应；情况介绍；向东方：aspect, way, quarter, guiding, adaptation
rm: 来自orient(vt. 给…定向)

t: v. 打手势；n. 运动；手势
en: the process of moving or the way that someone or something moves

ex.en: She motioned for the locked front doors to be opened.
ex.cn: 她打手势示意把锁着的前门打开。

ph.cn: 运动控制，拖动控制；动作控制，移动控制

syn: n. 动作；移动；手势；请求；意向：removal, intention, move, shift, asking
vi. 运动；打手势：do sport, do morning exercise
rm: mot(移动) + ion → 运动

t: adj. 有限的
en: not very great in amount, number, ability etc

ex.en: My knowledge of the business is limited.
ex.cn: 我对这一行了解有限。

ex.en: The organization has very limited resources.
ex.cn: 这家机构资源非常有限。

ph.cn: 有限公司；（英）股份有限公司（等于limited-liability company）
有限责任；有限债务责任

syn: adj. [数]有限的：finite, narrow, Ld.

t: n. 蚯蚓； 小人
en: a common type of long thin brown worm that lives in soil

ex.en: That chick pecks out an earthworm from the earth.
ex.cn: 那只小鸡从土里啄出一条蚯蚓。

ex.en: The research made a use of the earthworm with a competition of natural fertilizer to study the influence of the two treatments to the ammonia yield in livestock excrement.
ex.cn: 该试验利用蚯蚓生物处理方法，同自然堆肥作对比试验，研究了两种处理对畜禽粪便氨气产量的影响。

syn: n. [无脊椎]蚯蚓：fishworm, angleworm, Hode, rainworm
rm: earth(地上) + worm(蚯蚓； 小人物) → 蚯蚓； 小人

t: v. 匹配， 相称；n. 火柴；比赛，竞赛；对手，敌手
en: if one thing matches another, or if two things match, they look attractive together because they are a similar colour, pattern etc

ex.en: We painted the cabinets green to match the rug.
ex.cn: 我们把柜子刷成绿色，和地毯相配。

ex.en: Do you think this outfit matches?
ex.cn: 你认为这套衣服配吗？

syn: vt. 使比赛；使相配；敌得过，比得上；相配；与…竞争：equal, rival
vi. 比赛；匹配；相配，相称；相比：suit, balance

t: n. 缺点， 瑕疵， 毛病
en: a bad or weak part of someone’s character

ex.en: His worst fault is his arrogance.
ex.cn: 他最大的缺点是傲慢。

ex.en: I may have my faults , but ingratitude is not one of them.
ex.cn: 我可能有我的缺点，但我决不会忘恩负义。

syn: n. 故障；[地质]断层；错误；缺点；毛病；（网球等）发球失误：error, deficiency, defect, mistake, trouble
vi. 弄错；产生断层：mistake, err in

t: vi&n. 相互作用， 相互影响
en: the way in which two people or things affect each other

ex.en: ...the interplay of political, economic, social and cultural factors.
ex.cn: ...政治、经济，社会和文化因素的互相影响。

syn: n. 相互影响，相互作用：interaction effect, reciprocity
rm: inter(在…之间) + play(担任角色) → 相互作用

t: v. 分裂； 破碎；n. 碎片， 小部分， 片断
en: to break something, or be broken into a lot of small separate parts – used to show disapproval

ex.en: the dangers of fragmenting the Health Service
ex.cn: 医疗保健服务分崩离析的危险

syn: n. 碎片；片断或不完整部分：debris, chip
rm: frag(打碎) + ment(名词后缀) → 碎片， 片断

t: n. 回答， 答复； 反应， 响应
en: something that is done as a reaction to something that has happened or been said

ex.en: His immediate response was one of disbelief.
ex.cn: 他的第一反应是不相信。

ex.en: Emmett’s new exhibition has met with a favourable response from critics.
ex.cn: 埃米特的新展览得到评论家的好评。

syn: n. 响应；反应；回答：reaction, behavior, reception, reply, answer
rm: re(再， 又) + spons(允诺， 约定) + e → 回答； 反应

t: n. 花岗岩， 花岗石
en: a very hard grey rock, often used in building

ex.en: A pile of sand is loose, but it mixed with cement, stone, water, the toughness than granite.
ex.cn: 一堆沙子是松散的，可是它和水泥、石子、水混合后，比花岗岩还坚韧。——王杰。

ex.en: Engineerss had to dig and blast through 73 different kinds of rock, some as hard as granite and others as soft as sugar.
ex.cn: 施工人员挖出并炸掉的岩石足有73种之多，有的岩石硬的花岗岩，有的岩石软的像糖果。

syn: n. [岩]花岗岩；坚毅；冷酷无情：moorstone
rm: gran(=grain颗粒) + ite → 颗粒状石头 → 花岗岩， 花岗石

t: n. 种类； 类别； 范畴
en: a group of people or things that are all of the same type

ex.en: people in the over-45 age category
ex.cn: 属45岁以上年龄组的人

ex.en: Seats are available in eight of the ten price categories .
ex.cn: 座位共有10种票价，现有8种可售。

ph.cn: 产品类别；产品目录；积范畴

syn: n. 种类，分类；[数]范畴：variety, classification, kind, manner, sort, nature

t: adj. 竞争的，对抗的；n. 竞争者，竞争对手；可与匹敌的人；vt. 与…竞争； 与…匹敌， 比得上； 竞争， 对抗
en: a person, group, or organization that you compete with in sport, business, a fight etc

ex.en: He is, in effect, my rival.
ex.cn: 实际上他是我的竞争对手。

syn: n. 对手；[劳经]竞争者：equal, comparative, opponent, match, adversary
vt. 与…竞争；比得上某人：match, compete against
rm: 对手(rival)隔河(river)相望， 分外眼红
